entries.description: A close-fitting one-piece covering [torso](#torso) and limbs, [patterned](#patterned) with stripes.

entries.name: single_leg_bodysuit
entries.description: A one-piece skintight [suit](#suit) that covers one leg fully and leaves the other bare, usually cut high at the hip. Common on [stage](#stage), dance and superhero costumes.

entries.name: aqua_bodysuit
entries.description: A one-piece [suit](#suit) [clinging](#clinging) over [torso](#torso) and limbs in blue-green. Pilot suits, hero costumes and skin-tight [fantasy](#fantasy) wear are the usual settings.

entries.name: hooded_jumpsuit
entries.description: A one-piece garment covering [torso](#torso) and [legs](#legs) with a [hood](#hood) joined at the [neck](#neck). Cuts run from workwear [overalls](#overalls) to sporty tracksuit [shapes](#shapes).

entries.name: blue_unitard
entries.description: A tight blue one-piece covering the [torso](#torso) and both [legs](#legs) while leaving the [feet](#feet) uncovered. A [leotard](#leotard), by [comparison](#comparison), stops at the hips.

entries.name: pink_jumpsuit
entries.description: A one-piece garment joining top and trousers, here in pink. It covers everything from [workshop](#workshop) coveralls and flight suits to [fashion](#fashion) pieces.

entries.name: white_unitard
entries.description: A white [unitard](#unitard), a one-piece stretch garment covering the [torso](#torso) and [legs](#legs) together. Dance, [gymnastics](#gymnastics), and superhero costumes all rely on it.

entries.name: lace-trimmed_leotard
entries.description: A [leotard](#leotard) bordered with [lace](#lace) at the leg openings, neckline or waist. The body of the garment stays solid [fabric](#fabric).

entries.name: purple_jumpsuit
entries.description: A purple one-piece garment joining a top and trousers at the waist. Covers work [overalls](#overalls), flight suits, and [fashion](#fashion) jumpsuits alike.

entries.name: partial_bodysuit
entries.description: A skin-tight [suit](#suit) covering only part of the body, one arm and the [torso](#torso), or the [legs](#legs) but not the chest, leaving the rest bare or in ordinary [clothes](#clothes).

entries.name: underwear
entries.description: Garments worn beneath outer clothing against the skin: bras, [panties](#panties), [briefs](#briefs), [boxers](#boxers) and [lingerie](#lingerie). Tag the specific piece as [well](#well).

entries.name: panties
entries.description: Women's underpants covering the [crotch](#crotch), with a narrow waistband and [no](#no) leg sections. Underwear with [legs](#legs) is [boyshort_panties](#boyshort_panties) or [bike_shorts](#bike_shorts); add the colour [tag](#tag) where the colour is clear.

entries.name: white_panties
entries.description: Plain white [underwear](#underwear) on a female character, often drawn with a small red [bow](#bow) at the front. By far the most common panty color in ecchi art, where it reads as especially innocent; add the base [panties](#panties) [tag](#tag) alongside.

entries.name: black_panties
entries.description: Panties that read as predominantly black, whether glimpsed under a raised [skirt](#skirt), worn on their own or showing through thin [fabric](#fabric). The cut is a separate matter, so add the style [tag](#tag) alongside.

entries.name: underwear_only
entries.description: A character dressed in nothing but [underwear](#underwear) such as [panties](#panties), a [bra](#bra) or [lingerie](#lingerie); legwear may stay on. Not used for swimsuits; add [bottomless](#bottomless) for a bra-only [figure](#figure) and [topless](#topless) for a panties-only one.

entries.name: thong
entries.description: Underwear with only a narrow strip between the buttocks, leaving the cheeks bare. Add [panties](#panties) or a swimwear [tag](#tag) as fitting.

entries.name: pink_panties
entries.description: Panties that are mostly pink. Only the dominant colour counts; a small print or a trim in another [shade](#shade) does not change the [tag](#tag).

entries.name: striped_panties
entries.description: Panties [patterned](#patterned) with stripes, including the classic blue-and-white shimapan style. Implies [panties](#panties) and [striped_clothes](#striped_clothes).

entries.name: bow_panties
entries.description: Panties [carrying](#carrying) a [bow](#bow), usually a small one at the front centre or ties knotted at the hips. A bow on the [bra](#bra) is [bow_bra](#bow_bra).

entries.name: side-tie_panties
entries.description: Panties held together by strings knotted into bows at either hip, called himopan in Japan. Use [side-tie_peek](#side-tie_peek) when only the strings show below a [skirt](#skirt).

entries.name: panties_under_pantyhose
entries.description: Panties worn as the inner layer and seen through or beneath the wearer's own [pantyhose](#pantyhose). Worn on the outside instead, they are [panties_over_pantyhose](#panties_over_pantyhose).

entries.name: blue_panties
entries.description: Underwear [briefs](#briefs) coloured blue, seen while [undressing](#undressing), under a raised [skirt](#skirt) or worn on their own. Any cut counts, from [plain](#plain) cotton to [lace](#lace).

entries.name: bloomers
entries.description: Loose knee-length underpants gathered at the leg openings, often trimmed with [frills](#frills) or [ribbon](#ribbon), the Western drawers worn beneath lolita and Victorian dresses. Tight Japanese [gym](#gym) [shorts](#shorts) are [buruma](#buruma) and not these.

entries.name: highleg_panties
entries.description: Panties whose side straps ride very high on the hips, often close to the waistline. Thongs and g-strings frequently take this cut.

entries.name: male_underwear
entries.description: Boxers, [briefs](#briefs) or other undergarments of the kind men wear, on a character or [lying](#lying) about the room. Implies [underwear](#underwear).

entries.name: red_panties
entries.description: Red [panties](#panties), visible under a [skirt](#skirt), in underwear-only scenes, or on their own. Pairs with panties and any style [tag](#tag) such as [lace_panties](#lace_panties).

entries.name: purple_panties
entries.description: Purple [panties](#panties), whether visible through a [pantyshot](#pantyshot), under sheer clothing, or worn alone. Combine with panties and [underwear](#underwear).

entries.name: string_panties
entries.description: Panties whose waistband is a pair of thin cords, typically tied at the hips. The [tag](#tag) says nothing about how much [fabric](#fabric) covers the front or rear; that is what [thong](#thong) or [g-string](#g-string) say.

entries.name: lace-trimmed_panties
entries.description: Panties edged with [lace](#lace) around the waistband, the leg openings or both. Ones made entirely of lace are [lace_panties](#lace_panties).

entries.name: fundoshi
entries.description: The traditional Japanese [loincloth](#loincloth), a strip of [cloth](#cloth) wrapped and knotted at the hips. Worn as [festival](#festival) [dress](#dress) with a [happi](#happi), as swimwear at the [beach](#beach), or as [underwear](#underwear) beneath a [kimono](#kimono) or armour, so [tag](#tag) the context alongside it.

entries.name: print_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with pictures or [shapes](#shapes), bears, cats and [dots](#dots) being typical. Tag [panties](#panties) with them; the print does not make them [multicolored_panties](#multicolored_panties).

entries.name: unworn_panties
entries.description: Panties fully removed and visible in the picture. Not for [panties](#panties) merely pulled down, moved aside or worn around one leg, which are still counted as on the body.

entries.name: frilled_panties
entries.description: Panties trimmed with ruffles along the waistband or the leg openings. Applies whenever the gathered edge [can](#can) be seen, worn normally or otherwise.

entries.name: wet_panties
entries.description: Panties showing a damp [patch](#patch), whether from arousal fluid or from wetting oneself. Add [pussy_juice](#pussy_juice) or [peeing](#peeing) depending on the cause.

entries.name: green_panties
entries.description: Green [panties](#panties), shown under a lifted [skirt](#skirt), as underwear-only [dress](#dress) or otherwise visible. Tag the cut too where it is distinctive, such as [striped_panties](#striped_panties).

entries.name: loincloth
entries.description: A length of [cloth](#cloth) wrapped or tied between the [legs](#legs) to [cover](#cover) the [groin](#groin), worn in ancient, [tribal](#tribal) and [fantasy](#fantasy) [dress](#dress). Japanese [cuts](#cuts) of the same garment are [fundoshi](#fundoshi), a [hanging](#hanging) panel front or [back](#back) is a [pelvic_curtain](#pelvic_curtain), and one built into a full-body garment suggests [tabard](#tabard).

entries.name: panty_peek
entries.description: Only the waistband or the leg elastic of a pair of [panties](#panties) shows from under loose [shorts](#shorts) or other clothing, not the [crotch](#crotch) itself. A glimpse under a [skirt](#skirt) is [pantyshot](#pantyshot), and straps rising above the waistline are [panty_straps](#panty_straps) or [whale_tail_(clothing)](#whale_tail_(clothing)).

entries.name: lowleg_panties
entries.description: Panties with narrow sides that sit very low on the hips, [running](#running) almost horizontally across them. They are usually shown with a bare [midriff](#midriff) above.

entries.name: polka_dot_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with polka [dots](#dots), often white dots on a pastel ground. Tag [panties](#panties) and [polka_dot](#polka_dot) alongside.

entries.name: yellow_panties
entries.description: Panties coloured yellow. Do not use for wetted or stained white [panties](#panties) in [peeing](#peeing) scenes unless the garment itself is fully yellow; [tag](#tag) panties.

entries.name: grey_panties
entries.description: Grey [panties](#panties), shown under a lifted [skirt](#skirt) or as underwear-only [dress](#dress). Tag the cut too where it is distinctive.

entries.name: low-rise_panties
entries.description: Panties cut to sit on the hips rather than at the waist, so the hip bones and lower [belly](#belly) stay bare above them. The [height](#height) of the band is what counts, not how much the leg openings [cover](#cover).

entries.name: lace_panties
entries.description: Panties made wholly of [lace](#lace) rather than merely edged with it. The edged version is [lace-trimmed_panties](#lace-trimmed_panties).

entries.name: panty_straps
entries.description: The side straps of [panties](#panties) or of a [bikini](#bikini) bottom rising above the waistband of trousers or a [skirt](#skirt), seen from the front. Usually the result of [highleg](#highleg) or [thong](#thong) [underwear](#underwear) worn high on the hips; the same thing from behind is [whale_tail_(clothing)](#whale_tail_(clothing)).

entries.name: briefs
entries.description: Short, tight Y-front men's [underwear](#underwear), most often [plain](#plain) white. The long-legged tight version is [boxer_briefs](#boxer_briefs), and the loose short-legged kind is [boxers](#boxers).

entries.name: g-string
entries.description: A thong-style undergarment whose [back](#back) and side pieces are reduced to thin strings, [riding](#riding) higher on the hips than an ordinary [thong](#thong). Broader side straps mean it is a thong rather than this.

entries.name: white_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) in white, whether [briefs](#briefs) or [boxers](#boxers), shown on a male character.

entries.name: stained_panties
entries.description: Panties marked by a [wet](#wet) or dried [stain](#stain), whether from urine, arousal fluid or something else. Tag alongside what caused it when the picture makes that clear.

entries.name: cat_ear_panties
entries.description: Panties with small [fabric](#fabric) [cat](#cat) ears [standing](#standing) up from the waistband, usually part of a cat [lingerie](#lingerie) set. Panties merely printed with a cat's face are [cat_panties](#cat_panties).

entries.name: boxers
entries.description: Loose men's [underwear](#underwear) with short [legs](#legs), shaped much like a small pair of [shorts](#shorts) and often [patterned](#patterned) or striped. The close-fitting long-legged version is [boxer_briefs](#boxer_briefs); a [boxer](#boxer) with [no](#no) s is an athlete.

entries.name: untied_panties
entries.description: Side-tie [panties](#panties) with one or both of their bows come loose, so the garment sags or begins to slip off entirely.

entries.name: black_male_underwear
entries.description: Boxers, [briefs](#briefs) or other [underwear](#underwear) in black worn by a male character. Usually seen with the trousers off, open or pulled down.

entries.name: micro_panties
entries.description: Panties reduced to the bare minimum, covering little beyond the [crotch](#crotch).

entries.name: aqua_panties
entries.description: Panties in an aqua-blue [shade](#shade). Name the cut as [well](#well), such as [thong](#thong) or boyshorts.

entries.name: torn_panties
entries.description: Panties visibly ripped, whether still on the wearer or already removed.

entries.name: boxer_briefs
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) cut long in the leg like [boxers](#boxers) but fitted snugly like [briefs](#briefs). The loose version is boxers, the short Y-front version is briefs, and [boyshort_panties](#boyshort_panties) is the equivalent made for women.

entries.name: diaper
entries.description: An absorbent nappy worn in place of underpants, as by a [baby](#baby) not yet toilet-trained. An adult wearing one in ageplay also takes [adult_baby](#adult_baby).

entries.name: orange_panties
entries.description: Panties that are solid or predominantly orange, seen in a panty shot, in underwear-only scenes or through thin clothing. Add pattern tags where they apply.

entries.name: brown_panties
entries.description: Panties in brown, in cotton, [lace](#lace), [satin](#satin) or [leather](#leather). Any cut counts as long as the garment itself reads brown.

entries.name: plaid_panties
entries.description: Panties in a plaid or tartan pattern. Tag [plaid_clothes](#plaid_clothes) alongside them when the [underwear](#underwear) is visible; a matching [bra](#bra) is [plaid_bra](#plaid_bra).

entries.name: jockstrap
entries.description: Male [underwear](#underwear) of a waistband, a front [pouch](#pouch) and two straps round the [thighs](#thighs), leaving the buttocks bare. It was made for athletic support and is now worn as [fashion](#fashion) or fetish wear too.

entries.name: multi-strapped_panties
entries.description: Panties held at the hips by several straps instead of a single band. A decorative cut, seen on [lingerie](#lingerie) and on [fantasy](#fantasy) outfits.

entries.name: back-print_panties
entries.description: Panties [carrying](#carrying) a picture or shape across the seat, such as a face, a [heart](#heart) or lettering. A pattern [running](#running) over the whole garment, polka [dots](#dots) for example, is ordinary [print_panties](#print_panties) instead.

entries.name: strawberry_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with strawberries. Used as visual shorthand for a naive or childish character.

entries.name: panties_under_buruma
entries.description: Panties visible under a pair of [buruma](#buruma) [gym](#gym) [shorts](#shorts), [peeking](#peeking) from the leg openings or showing through the [cloth](#cloth). Tag [panties](#panties) as [well](#well).

entries.name: satin_panties
entries.description: Panties cut from shiny [satin](#satin), [lying](#lying) smooth against the skin with a bright sheen along the curves.

entries.name: two-tone_panties
entries.description: Panties made up of exactly two colours, usually a body in one [shade](#shade) with waistband or trim in another. More colours than that makes them simply multicoloured.

entries.name: red_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [briefs](#briefs), [boxers](#boxers) or trunks in red. Distinguish it from red swimwear, which is worn into the [water](#water) rather than under [clothes](#clothes).

entries.name: vertical-striped_panties
entries.description: Panties [patterned](#patterned) with stripes [running](#running) up and down rather than around the hips. Frequently paired with a matching striped [bra](#bra) as a set.

entries.name: panties_under_shorts
entries.description: Panties visible under a pair of [shorts](#shorts), from a faint glimpse of the waistband to open exposure where the shorts are tugged down or [torn](#torn) while still on the [legs](#legs). High-cut [string](#string) [panties](#panties) with short shorts count, unless the upper piece is a [bikini](#bikini).

entries.name: blue_male_underwear
entries.description: Blue [underwear](#underwear) of a men's cut, such as [boxers](#boxers), [briefs](#briefs) or trunks. It may sit under clothing or be shown on its own.

entries.name: strapless_bottom
entries.description: A scrap of clothing that covers the [crotch](#crotch) with nothing [running](#running) over the hips, leaving all the surrounding skin bare. Unlike [maebari](#maebari) it stays on as a garment rather than by adhesive.

entries.name: panties_over_pantyhose
entries.description: Panties pulled on above the [pantyhose](#pantyhose) instead of beneath them, so the waistband and leg openings lie over the sheer layer.

entries.name: front-print_panties
entries.description: Panties bearing a picture, [letter](#letter) or shape on the front panel alone. A pattern spread over the whole garment, such as polka [dots](#dots), does not count.

entries.name: heart_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with hearts. Underwear actually cut to a [heart](#heart) [outline](#outline) is not this — [heart_bikini](#heart_bikini) stands in for that.

entries.name: bear_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with a bear's face across the front. They work as shorthand for a childish or determinedly unglamorous character.

entries.name: grey_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) in grey, whether [boxers](#boxers), [briefs](#briefs) or trunks. It is the plainest colour the garment takes, which suits ordinary domestic scenes.

entries.name: c-string
entries.description: A [strapless](#strapless) [thong](#thong) held on by a curved internal frame, so nothing runs round the hips and [no](#no) [tan](#tan) lines are left. A piece with no rear [strap](#strap), or one [lying](#lying) flat against the skin, is more likely a [maebari](#maebari).

entries.name: boyshort_panties
entries.description: Women's [underwear](#underwear) cut like snug little [shorts](#shorts), covering the hips and the top of the [thighs](#thighs). It answers to [boxer_briefs](#boxer_briefs) on the men's side and is often paired with a [camisole](#camisole) [indoors](#indoors) or a [sports_bra](#sports_bra) for exercise.

entries.name: o-ring_panties
entries.description: Panties whose front and [back](#back) panels are linked by rings rather than sewn [seams](#seams), most often with one [ring](#ring) [riding](#riding) on each hip. The rings are the point of the garment, so they are drawn large and [plain](#plain).

entries.name: sports_panties
entries.description: Plain athletic [briefs](#briefs) without [lace](#lace) or bows, in a single flat colour, with a thick contrasting waistband that sometimes carries lettering. Commonly paired with a matching sports [bra](#bra).

entries.name: multicolored_panties
entries.description: Panties [carrying](#carrying) at least two colours, from a contrasting waistband and trim to a two-tone printed front. A matching [bra](#bra) often repeats the scheme.

entries.name: green_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) in green, whether [boxers](#boxers), [briefs](#briefs) or trunks. Garments meant for the [water](#water) take [green_male_swimwear](#green_male_swimwear) instead.

entries.name: ribbon-trimmed_panties
entries.description: Panties edged with a decorative [ribbon](#ribbon) band along the waist or leg openings. Often matched with a [bra](#bra) trimmed the same way.

entries.name: ribbed_panties
entries.description: Panties made from ribbed knit [fabric](#fabric), so fine vertical lines run across the front and seat. Usually a [plain](#plain) cotton cut rather than [lace](#lace) [lingerie](#lingerie).

entries.name: star_panties
entries.description: Panties [patterned](#patterned) with stars, whether printed all over or [carrying](#carrying) a single one at the front.

entries.name: print_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [briefs](#briefs) or [boxers](#boxers) with a pattern printed on them. Novelty motifs and small repeated [shapes](#shapes) are the usual fare.

entries.name: bikini_briefs
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) cut high on the leg, covering barely more than the pelvis. Snug and brief enough that it collects nicknames like [banana](#banana) [hammock](#hammock) and budgie smuggler.

entries.name: cat_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with a cat's face or whole body as the motif. Keep them apart from [cat_ear_panties](#cat_ear_panties), where [fabric](#fabric) ears are sewn to the waistband instead.

entries.name: wet_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) soaked with [water](#water) so it clings and [can](#can) turn see-through. Describes wetness from an outside source rather than a [stain](#stain) of another kind.

entries.name: t-back
entries.description: Women's [underwear](#underwear) whose rear straps form a T shape where a narrow waistband meets a thin vertical strip. Close to a [g-string](#g-string), and not to be [confused](#confused) with a [whale](#whale) [tail](#tail), where an ordinary waistband simply peeks above trousers.

entries.name: panties_under_bike_shorts
entries.description: Panties showing beneath tight bike [shorts](#shorts), either as raised lines through the [fabric](#fabric) or plainly through [cloth](#cloth) thin enough to see into.

entries.name: yellow_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) in yellow: [boxers](#boxers), [briefs](#briefs) or trunks. Recorded purely for the colour.

entries.name: rabbit_panties
entries.description: Panties printed with a bunny's face or head on the front. The print is usually cartoonish rather than a [realistic](#realistic) [animal](#animal) likeness; tagged alongside the general [print_panties](#print_panties) [tag](#tag).

entries.name: latex_panties
entries.description: Briefs made of glossy rubber rather than [fabric](#fabric). They are typically black, with sharp highlights across the hips.

entries.name: black_fundoshi
entries.description: The Japanese [loincloth](#loincloth) in black, wound about the hips with [cloth](#cloth) [hanging](#hanging) front and [back](#back). Seen at festivals and in traditional and martial settings.

entries.name: embroidered_panties
entries.description: Panties with patterns sewn into the [fabric](#fabric), typically flowers or scrollwork along the waistband or across the front panel. The [stitching](#stitching) is what is being named, not printed decoration.

entries.name: orange_male_underwear
entries.description: Boxers, [briefs](#briefs), trunks or similar men's [underwear](#underwear) in orange. Only the colour is at issue, not the cut.

entries.name: checkered_panties
entries.description: Underwear printed in squares, most often a small [gingham](#gingham). The pattern covers the whole garment rather than appearing only as trim.

entries.name: brown_male_underwear
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) in brown: [briefs](#briefs), [boxers](#boxers) or a trunk cut. The [shade](#shade) describes the main body of the garment rather than the waistband or trim.

entries.name: gold_panties
entries.description: Briefs cut from [gold](#gold) [fabric](#fabric), often with a metallic sheen. One of the colour entries in the [underwear](#underwear) [family](#family).

entries.name: zipper_panties
entries.description: Panties fitted with a [zipper](#zipper) across the front or [crotch](#crotch), a novelty design detail rather than a practical fastening. Frequently drawn partly undone.

entries.name: flower_panties
entries.description: Briefs printed with blossoms, trimmed with them, or shaped from [petals](#petals) outright. Both [plain](#plain) floral prints and [fantasy](#fantasy) petal versions belong here.

entries.name: ribbon-trimmed_underwear
entries.description: Underwear of any kind finished with decorative [ribbon](#ribbon) banding along its edges. Use it when the garment is not specifically identified as a [bra](#bra) or [panties](#panties).

entries.name: purple_male_underwear
entries.description: Briefs, [boxers](#boxers), or trunks in purple, cut for a man. Only the colour and cut are at issue, not who is actually wearing them.

entries.name: unworn_male_underwear
entries.description: Boxers, [briefs](#briefs) or similar men's [underwear](#underwear) are shown entirely off the body. Not for underwear only pushed aside or pulled down while still worn; the women's equivalents are [unworn_bra](#unworn_bra) and [unworn_panties](#unworn_panties).

entries.name: panties_under_swimsuit
entries.description: Panties worn beneath a [swimsuit](#swimsuit), their waistband or leg openings showing past or through the swimwear. Usually a [sign](#sign) the character is not really dressed for the [water](#water).

entries.name: pink_male_underwear
entries.description: Briefs, [boxers](#boxers) or trunks cut for men and coloured pink. Worn under clothing or shown on their own.

entries.name: fur-trimmed_panties
entries.description: Panties edged with fur at the waistband or leg openings. Cut from [pelt](#pelt) itself they are fur_panties, a different garment.

entries.name: american_flag_panties
entries.description: Underwear [carrying](#carrying) the stars and stripes, printed across the whole garment or laid out with the star [field](#field) over the front. A fixture of patriotic pin-ups.

entries.name: bra
entries.description: The garment that cups and supports the [breasts](#breasts), shown worn on its own, under an open top, or [lying](#lying) about as an object. Add [underwear](#underwear), and the style where it is clear, such as [sports_bra](#sports_bra), [strapless_bra](#strapless_bra) or [lace_bra](#lace_bra).

entries.name: black_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) or comparable upper-body [lingerie](#lingerie) in black, glimpsed under open clothing or worn openly. Dim lighting [can](#can) make a grey bra look black, so [judge](#judge) the intended colour.

entries.name: sports_bra
entries.description: A snug [cropped](#cropped) top that supports the chest during exercise while leaving the [midriff](#midriff) bare. Worn openly during workouts, so it isn't treated as [underwear](#underwear) despite the name.

entries.name: white_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) colored white, glimpsed through an open [shirt](#shirt), in an underwear-only scene, or spotted in a [wardrobe](#wardrobe).

entries.name: pasties
entries.description: Small adhesive covers [stuck](#stuck) straight onto the [nipples](#nipples) while the rest of the chest stays bare. Heart and star [shapes](#shapes) have tags of their own; the [breasts](#breasts) are exposed but the nipples are not.

entries.name: sarashi
entries.description: A long cotton strip wound tightly around the chest or abdomen. Older anime delinquents wear it around the [belly](#belly) under an open [shirt](#shirt); the far more common modern form binds only the [breasts](#breasts) like a [tube](#tube) top with the [midriff](#midriff) bare, seen on [kendo](#kendo) girls and fighters.

entries.name: pink_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) or comparable upper-body [lingerie](#lingerie) in pink, worn under clothing or on its own. A pink sports bra takes its own [tag](#tag) beside this one.

entries.name: bow_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) that fastens at the front with a [bow](#bow), or wears one as its main ornament between the cups. A bow on the [panties](#panties) instead is [bow_panties](#bow_panties).

entries.name: lace-trimmed_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) with [lace](#lace) edging along the cups or the band. One built entirely from lace is [lace_bra](#lace_bra) instead.

entries.name: blue_bra
entries.description: A blue [bra](#bra) or other blue upper-body [lingerie](#lingerie). It may be glimpsed under open clothing or worn on its own.

entries.name: black_sports_bra
entries.description: A black sports [bra](#bra), cut for exercise with a wide band and full shoulder straps. It often stands in as a top in its own right, leaving the [midriff](#midriff) bare.

entries.name: heart_pasties
entries.description: Heart-shaped covers [stuck](#stuck) over the [nipples](#nipples) with the rest of the [breasts](#breasts) bare, so nothing else is worn on top.

entries.name: frilled_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) whose cups, band or straps carry gathered ruffles as decoration. Often drawn as half of a matching set with [frilled_panties](#frilled_panties); the trim is ruffled [fabric](#fabric), not flat [lace](#lace).

entries.name: bra_strap
entries.description: Only the shoulder straps of a [bra](#bra) [can](#can) be seen, generally [slipping](#slipping) out from an off-shoulder top, a [tube](#tube) top or a [strapless](#strapless) [dress](#dress). If the garment is largely or wholly visible, use bra instead.

entries.name: red_bra
entries.description: A red [bra](#bra) or similar upper-body [lingerie](#lingerie), glimpsed under an open [shirt](#shirt), through sheer [fabric](#fabric), or worn on its own. Combine with lingerie when it is part of a matching set.

entries.name: bra_visible_through_clothes
entries.description: The shape or colour of a [bra](#bra) reads through a top because the [fabric](#fabric) is sheer or has been soaked. Pair it with bra and with see-through or [wet_clothes](#wet_clothes), depending on why the fabric gives it away.

entries.name: purple_bra
entries.description: A purple [bra](#bra), whether glimpsed under an open top, showing through [fabric](#fabric), or worn on its own. Combine with bra and [underwear](#underwear).

entries.name: bandaids_on_nipples
entries.description: Ordinary sticking plasters used to [cover](#cover) the [nipples](#nipples) of an otherwise bare chest, frequently crossed in an X. Reserve it for real plasters; purpose-made nipple covers are [pasties](#pasties).

entries.name: unworn_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) is shown [lying](#lying) or held in view while its would-be wearer goes without it. A bra that is still on but [unfastened](#unfastened) is tagged [open_bra](#open_bra) instead.

entries.name: bra_peek
entries.description: Just a sliver of [bra](#bra) shows, [caught](#caught) at a [gaping](#gaping) [collar](#collar), under a raised hem or through an armhole. When most of the garment is in view, [plain](#plain) bra covers it, and straps alone are [bra_strap](#bra_strap).

entries.name: white_sports_bra
entries.description: A white athletic [bra](#bra) worn under other clothing or by itself as [sportswear](#sportswear). Tag [sports_bra](#sports_bra) alongside it; where it is the only top and the framing is about exposure, add a suggestive [tag](#tag) separately.

entries.name: green_bra
entries.description: A green [bra](#bra) or comparable upper-body [lingerie](#lingerie) piece, worn as [plain](#plain) [underwear](#underwear) or as a deliberate lingerie look. The athletic cut belongs to [green_sports_bra](#green_sports_bra).

entries.name: striped_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) with a striped pattern.

entries.name: lace_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) cut entirely from [lace](#lace), the openwork showing across the cups. One that merely carries a lace edging is [lace-trimmed_bra](#lace-trimmed_bra).

entries.name: strapless_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) without shoulder straps, supported by a wide band and shaped cups. A [bandeau](#bandeau) or [tube](#tube) top has [no](#no) cups and is not one.

entries.name: yellow_bra
entries.description: A yellow [bra](#bra), visible under open clothing or worn alone. Tag bra as [well](#well).

entries.name: grey_bra
entries.description: A grey [bra](#bra), seen as [plain](#plain) [underwear](#underwear) or as [lingerie](#lingerie). The athletic cut belongs to [grey_sports_bra](#grey_sports_bra).

entries.name: belt_bra
entries.description: A [leather](#leather) [belt](#belt) strapped across the chest to serve as a [bra](#bra), [buckle](#buckle) and all or without one. It shows up as fetish and [fantasy](#fantasy) wear rather than as ordinary [underwear](#underwear).

entries.name: grey_sports_bra
entries.description: A grey sports [bra](#bra), worn for exercise or as a [casual](#casual) top under an open [jacket](#jacket). It has the wide band and full coverage of athletic wear.

entries.name: print_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) with a printed design, whether animals, hearts or a repeating pattern. A print is not the same as [multicolored_bra](#multicolored_bra), which needs several base colours.

entries.name: polka_dot_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) in polka-dotted [fabric](#fabric), seen when the top is open or absent. A matching bottom in the same pattern is [polka_dot_panties](#polka_dot_panties).

entries.name: blue_sports_bra
entries.description: A blue elasticated [bra](#bra) built for exercise, flatter and broader than an ordinary one. It is often worn on its own as a crop top.

entries.name: cross_pasties
entries.description: Nipple covers cut as an X or a [cross](#cross), frequently improvised from black electrical [tape](#tape), on a chest that is otherwise bare. A variety of [pasties](#pasties).

entries.name: training_bra
entries.description: A soft, simple first [bra](#bra) for a young or still-developing girl, styled much like a sports bra. Often paired with [flat_chest](#flat_chest) given the wearer's age.

entries.name: two-tone_sports_bra
entries.description: A sports [bra](#bra) made in exactly two colours. Implies [sports_bra](#sports_bra).

entries.name: star_pasties
entries.description: Star-shaped [pasties](#pasties) [stuck](#stuck) directly over the [nipples](#nipples) of an otherwise bare chest, covering just enough to avoid full nudity. A common substitute for a [bra](#bra) in [idol](#idol) and [swimsuit](#swimsuit) art.

entries.name: front-fastening_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) that closes between the cups rather than at the [back](#back), its fastening plainly visible at the centre of the chest. Handy in art because it [can](#can) be undone with one hand.

entries.name: breast_padding
entries.description: Pads, tissues or other [stuffing](#stuffing) packed into a [bra](#bra) or top to make the bust look fuller. It covers the pads themselves, the act of stuffing, and the joke of somebody being [caught](#caught) at it.

entries.name: string_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) held on by thin cords rather than broad straps or a solid band, often tied at the [neck](#neck) or [back](#back). The swimwear counterpart is [string_bikini](#string_bikini).

entries.name: brown_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) in brown, [plain](#plain), [lace](#lace) or leather-look. Add bra.

entries.name: red_sports_bra
entries.description: A red sports [bra](#bra), the supportive athletic top worn during exercise or shown as [underwear](#underwear). Tagged with [sports_bra](#sports_bra); a [bikini](#bikini) top is not this.

entries.name: aqua_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) or similar upper [lingerie](#lingerie) in a blue-green [shade](#shade). Name the style as [well](#well), such as [sports_bra](#sports_bra) or bralette.

entries.name: plaid_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) in plaid-patterned [fabric](#fabric), usually visible when a top is open or removed. A matching bottom in the same pattern is [plaid_panties](#plaid_panties).

entries.name: micro_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) reduced to little more than two small patches over the [nipples](#nipples) and the straps [holding](#holding) them in place. The [underwear](#underwear) counterpart of a [micro_bikini](#micro_bikini).

entries.name: front-hook_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) whose cups are joined by a [hook](#hook) [sitting](#sitting) between the [breasts](#breasts). Opening it needs [no](#no) reach around the [back](#back), which is why art favours it.

entries.name: tape_on_nipples
entries.description: Adhesive [tape](#tape) [stuck](#stuck) across the [nipples](#nipples) in place of a [bra](#bra) or ordinary [pasties](#pasties), sometimes crossed into an X and sometimes a single [plain](#plain) strip. The [breasts](#breasts) are otherwise left bare.

entries.name: orange_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) or comparable piece of upper [lingerie](#lingerie) in orange. Cut and style make [no](#no) difference; only the colour does.

entries.name: bralines
entries.description: The [seams](#seams) and [strap](#strap) lines of a [bra](#bra) stand out through tight outer clothing as raised ridges. The [fabric](#fabric) stays opaque here, unlike [bra_visible_through_clothes](#bra_visible_through_clothes) where a sheer or [wet](#wet) top gives it away.

entries.name: pink_sports_bra
entries.description: A pink [bra](#bra) of stretch [fabric](#fabric) built for exercise, cut like a short crop top with broad bands. Often worn on its own as activewear.

entries.name: front-tie_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) held closed by a knot or [bow](#bow) tied between the cups. Not to be muddled with the front-tie [bikini](#bikini) top, which counts as swimwear.

entries.name: vertical-striped_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) [patterned](#patterned) with stripes [running](#running) up and down the cups rather than ringing them. The direction sets it apart from the horizontal variant, and it often [matches](#matches) a striped pair of [panties](#panties).

entries.name: black_pasties
entries.description: Small black patches [stuck](#stuck) over the [nipples](#nipples) with the rest of the chest left bare. Because nothing supports or encloses the [breasts](#breasts), they are distinct from a [bra](#bra) or a [bikini](#bikini) top.

entries.name: green_sports_bra
entries.description: A green sports [bra](#bra), the wide-banded top worn for exercise. It is usually paired with [shorts](#shorts) or [leggings](#leggings) in [gym](#gym) and [running](#running) scenes.

entries.name: ribbon-trimmed_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) edged with a decorative [ribbon](#ribbon) band, usually along the top of the cups or the underband. A common finish on [lingerie](#lingerie) sets that match trimmed [panties](#panties).

entries.name: yellow_sports_bra
entries.description: A yellow sports [bra](#bra), the close-fitting band-style top made for exercise. Often shown on its own with [shorts](#shorts) or [leggings](#leggings).

entries.name: purple_sports_bra
entries.description: A purple pull-on [bra](#bra) cut for exercise, with wide bands and full coverage. Often worn openly with [shorts](#shorts) or [leggings](#leggings) rather than hidden under a top.

entries.name: torn_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) [torn](#torn) at the [cup](#cup), the [strap](#strap) or the band.

entries.name: two-tone_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) made up of exactly two colours, whether [split](#split) by [cup](#cup), band or trim. Anything with a third colour counts as simply multicoloured.

entries.name: orange_sports_bra
entries.description: An orange sports [bra](#bra), the supportive pull-on style worn for exercise, usually with [shorts](#shorts) or [leggings](#leggings).

entries.name: bra_slip
entries.description: A [cup](#cup) or band of the [bra](#bra) shows at the edge of the outer clothing, escaping a loose [collar](#collar), an open [shirt](#shirt) or a slipped shoulder. The body stays covered throughout.

entries.name: ribbon_as_bra
entries.description: Ribbon wound across the chest so that it stands in for a [bra](#bra), covering the [nipples](#nipples) and little else. The [wrapping](#wrapping) leaves most of the [breasts](#breasts) bare.

entries.name: embroidered_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) whose cups or band carry decorative [stitching](#stitching), most often floral. The needlework is the point — [plain](#plain) [lace](#lace) edging on its own does not qualify.

entries.name: shelf_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) whose cups stop below the [breasts](#breasts), propping them up while the [nipples](#nipples) and upper curve stay bare. Refers only to this specific piece of [lingerie](#lingerie), not to a built-in support panel sewn into a top or [swimsuit](#swimsuit). Implies bra.

entries.name: satin_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) of smooth lustrous [satin](#satin), its sheen setting it apart from cotton, [lace](#lace) or [mesh](#mesh).

entries.name: multicolored_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) [carrying](#carrying) two or more colours, from contrasting cups to trim set against a different ground. Matching [panties](#panties) often repeat the same scheme.

entries.name: adhesive_bra
entries.description: Cups that [stick](#stick) straight to the skin, with [no](#no) shoulder straps and no band around the [back](#back). Made for backless dresses in life, they are usually drawn worn on their own or under something very revealing.

entries.name: bridgeless_bra
entries.description: A stiff [bra](#bra) whose cups are not joined in the middle, so bare skin runs unbroken from the [collarbone](#collarbone) down to the [navel](#navel). The cut exists to work under deep necklines.

entries.name: brown_sports_bra
entries.description: A brown sports [bra](#bra), the wide-banded compression top worn for exercise. It covers more of the chest than an ordinary bra and is often worn as a top in its own right.

entries.name: striped_sports_bra
entries.description: A sports [bra](#bra) [patterned](#patterned) with stripes, [running](#running) either around the body or from top to bottom. Implies [sports_bra](#sports_bra).

entries.name: lace-trimmed_camisole
entries.description: A thin-strapped [camisole](#camisole) edged with [lace](#lace) at the neckline, the hem or both. It is worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) and equally as a layering top.

entries.name: fur-trimmed_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) edged with fur along the cups or the band. A bra cut from [pelt](#pelt) itself is fur_bra, a separate design.

entries.name: multi-strapped_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) crossed by extra straps over the chest, the [ribs](#ribs) or the shoulders beyond the pair needed to hold it up. The strapping is decoration rather than [structure](#structure).

entries.name: bra_on_head
entries.description: A brassiere is draped over somebody's head or hooked across their face rather than worn where it belongs. Panties used the same way have their own [tag](#tag).

entries.name: strawberry_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) printed with strawberries or trimmed with [strawberry](#strawberry) motifs. Reads as sweet, girlish [underwear](#underwear).

entries.name: vertical-striped_sports_bra
entries.description: A sports [bra](#bra) [patterned](#patterned) with stripes [running](#running) up and down its front rather than around the band. Usually part of [gym](#gym) or athletic [dress](#dress).

entries.name: latex_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) made of glossy rubber instead of [cloth](#cloth), moulded tight over the chest. It normally belongs to a matching set.

entries.name: wet_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) soaked with [water](#water) so the [fabric](#fabric) darkens and clings, occasionally showing what lies beneath. Distinct from the same garment worn dry.

entries.name: torn_sports_bra
entries.description: A sports [bra](#bra) ripped across the band or through a [cup](#cup), [split](#split) at a seam from wear or a struggle. Distinguishes [damaged](#damaged) athletic [underwear](#underwear) from an intact one.

entries.name: lingerie
entries.description: Decorative, alluring [underwear](#underwear) made with [lace](#lace), [frills](#frills), [silk](#silk) or sheer [fabric](#fabric). Not every visible [bra](#bra) or pair of [panties](#panties) qualifies; [plain](#plain) everyday pieces are simply underwear.

entries.name: corset
entries.description: A stiffened, laced garment drawn tight around the waist and [stomach](#stomach), worn under clothing or, more often in art, over it. Usually [underbust](#underbust), though overbust versions exist; a [bodice](#bodice) [reaching](#reaching) over the [breasts](#breasts) with arm holes is a different garment.

entries.name: garter_belt
entries.description: A narrow band worn around the waist with straps [hanging](#hanging) from it to clip onto [thighhighs](#thighhighs) and hold them up. Only [tag](#tag) it when the [belt](#belt) itself shows; if the straps alone are visible, [garter_straps](#garter_straps) is the tag and the two are never used together.

entries.name: petticoat
entries.description: A ruffled and often layered underskirt worn beneath a [skirt](#skirt) or [dress](#dress), both to stop it [riding](#riding) up and to puff it out. Letting the [lace](#lace) hem show below the skirt is a mark of lolita [fashion](#fashion).

entries.name: bridal_garter
entries.description: A frilled elastic band worn round the thigh purely for decoration, as in the [wedding](#wedding) custom, [holding](#holding) nothing up. Straps that actually support [thighhighs](#thighhighs) are [legwear_garter](#legwear_garter), and a [plain](#plain) unfrilled band is [thigh_strap](#thigh_strap).

entries.name: babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose, [sleeveless](#sleeveless) nightdress worn as [lingerie](#lingerie), hung from thin straps with the seam high under the bust and a sheer [skirt](#skirt) ending around the upper thigh. The front is often slit open over the [midriff](#midriff), and [lace](#lace), [frills](#frills) or bows finish the edges.

entries.name: black_corset
entries.description: A black [corset](#corset) laced round the waist and [ribs](#ribs), worn over a [dress](#dress) or [shirt](#shirt) in gothic and lolita [fashion](#fashion), or on its own as [lingerie](#lingerie).

entries.name: bustier
entries.description: A firm [lingerie](#lingerie) top that cups and lifts the [breasts](#breasts) and continues down over the [ribs](#ribs), normally stopping above the [navel](#navel). Shorter and softer than a [corset](#corset); a band worn beneath the breasts instead is an [underbust](#underbust).

entries.name: cat_lingerie
entries.description: A cat-themed [underwear](#underwear) set: the [bra](#bra) carries a frilled edge and a kitten-shaped [opening](#opening) over the [cleavage](#cleavage), and the side-tied [panties](#panties) have ears at the waistband. A [bell](#bell) [collar](#collar) and cat-patterned [thighhighs](#thighhighs) usually come with it.

entries.name: negligee
entries.description: A loose, sheer [dressing](#dressing) [gown](#gown) of [lingerie](#lingerie) [fabric](#fabric), often finished with [lace](#lace) or bows and worn in the [bedroom](#bedroom). Older ones reach the [floor](#floor), while later [cuts](#cuts) grew short enough to become the [babydoll](#babydoll).

entries.name: chemise
entries.description: A loose [sleeveless](#sleeveless) slip [hanging](#hanging) straight from the shoulders past the waist, worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) or an undergarment. It has [no](#no) [buttons](#buttons) or fasteners; the shorter, flarier nightwear piece is a [babydoll](#babydoll).

entries.name: brown_corset
entries.description: A brown [corset](#corset), most often [leather](#leather) or laced [fabric](#fabric), worn over a [blouse](#blouse) or as outerwear in [fantasy](#fantasy) and [steampunk](#steampunk) looks. Add corset.

entries.name: white_corset
entries.description: A white [corset](#corset) laced around the [torso](#torso), worn as a [bodice](#bodice) over a [blouse](#blouse) or as [lingerie](#lingerie).

entries.name: black_garter_belt
entries.description: A black garter [belt](#belt) [sitting](#sitting) around the hips, with straps [hanging](#hanging) down to hold stockings up. The straps on their own are [black_garter_straps](#black_garter_straps).

entries.name: red_corset
entries.description: A red laced or boned [bodice](#bodice) that cinches the waist, worn over or in place of [underwear](#underwear). It appears in [lingerie](#lingerie) sets, gothic outfits and period [dress](#dress) alike.

entries.name: white_babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose [lingerie](#lingerie) slip in white, [falling](#falling) from the bust to the upper thigh. Usually worn over [panties](#panties) and often drawn sheer.

entries.name: black_babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose [lingerie](#lingerie) slip in black, flaring from just under the bust and [reaching](#reaching) about the hips. Often sheer and edged with [lace](#lace).

entries.name: white_garter_belt
entries.description: A white [belt](#belt) [sitting](#sitting) on the hips with straps [hanging](#hanging) down to clip onto stockings. Almost always drawn as part of a matching [lingerie](#lingerie) set.

entries.name: bridal_lingerie
entries.description: White or ivory [lingerie](#lingerie) made to go with [wedding](#wedding) attire: [lace](#lace), [ribbon](#ribbon), a garter and sometimes a small [veil](#veil). It is worn under the [gown](#gown) or kept [back](#back) for the wedding [night](#night).

entries.name: blue_corset
entries.description: A blue laced or boned [bodice](#bodice) [pulling](#pulling) the waist in, worn as [underwear](#underwear) or over other [clothes](#clothes). Front hooks or [back](#back) lacing are usually visible.

entries.name: panties_over_garter_belt
entries.description: The [panties](#panties) sit on top of the garter [belt](#belt) rather than under it, so they [can](#can) come off without unclipping the straps. Usually part of a full [lingerie](#lingerie) set.

entries.name: purple_corset
entries.description: A stiffened purple [bodice](#bodice) laced or hooked tight around the waist and [ribs](#ribs). Worn as [underwear](#underwear), over a [dress](#dress), or as part of a [costume](#costume).

entries.name: black_bustier
entries.description: A structured, boned top in black shaping the bust and waist, worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) or as an outer garment. It runs further down the body than a [bra](#bra).

entries.name: pink_babydoll
entries.description: A short loose nightdress in pink that flares from a fitted bust and stops around the hip. Usually sheer and worn with matching [panties](#panties).

entries.name: pink_corset
entries.description: A stiffened laced [bodice](#bodice) in pink drawing in the waist, worn as [underwear](#underwear) or over other [clothes](#clothes). The boning and the lacing are what separate it from a [plain](#plain) bodice.

entries.name: frilled_babydoll
entries.description: A short loose [babydoll](#babydoll) nightdress trimmed with ruffles at the bust and hem. It sits somewhere between [sleepwear](#sleepwear) and [lingerie](#lingerie).

entries.name: lace-trimmed_garter_belt
entries.description: A garter [belt](#belt) of solid or sheer [cloth](#cloth) finished with [lace](#lace) at its edges. One woven wholly from lace has its own [tag](#tag).

entries.name: blue_babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose nightdress in blue ending around the hip, usually sheer and trimmed with [lace](#lace). It hangs away from the body instead of [clinging](#clinging) like a slip.

entries.name: white_chemise
entries.description: A white [chemise](#chemise), the thin loose slip worn against the skin under a [dress](#dress) or as a [nightshirt](#nightshirt). Historical settings draw it with a [drawstring](#drawstring) neckline and short puffed sleeves.

entries.name: green_corset
entries.description: A green [corset](#corset) laced tight at the waist and boned to shape the [torso](#torso). It may sit hidden under other [clothes](#clothes) or be shown as the outermost garment.

entries.name: studded_garter_belt
entries.description: A garter [belt](#belt) trimmed with metal [studs](#studs), [sitting](#sitting) at the hips with straps [running](#running) down to the stockings.

entries.name: frilled_corset
entries.description: A laced [corset](#corset) finished with ruffled edging at the bust, hips or both. Worn as [lingerie](#lingerie), or laced over a [blouse](#blouse) as part of gothic and lolita [dress](#dress).

entries.name: grey_corset
entries.description: A grey [corset](#corset) laced around the [torso](#torso) and boned to shape the waist. It may be hidden under clothing or worn openly.

entries.name: purple_babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose nightdress in sheer purple [fabric](#fabric), cut to fall away just below the bust. Worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) rather than as outerwear.

entries.name: red_garter_belt
entries.description: A red band worn around the hips with straps [hanging](#hanging) from it to hold up stockings. Part of a [lingerie](#lingerie) set, normally shown with matching legwear.

entries.name: red_babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose nightdress in red that falls to about hip length, gathered under the bust and often trimmed with [lace](#lace). Worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) rather than as outerwear.

entries.name: white_bustier
entries.description: A white [bustier](#bustier), a stiffened [strapless](#strapless) [bodice](#bodice) that [shapes](#shapes) the waist and lifts the chest. Worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) or as the top half of a formal outfit.

entries.name: teddy_(lingerie)
entries.description: A one-piece undergarment shaped much like a [swimsuit](#swimsuit), joining a [bra](#bra) [cup](#cup) and a brief in a single run of [lace](#lace) or [silk](#silk), and normally [carrying](#carrying) [no](#no) straps down the [legs](#legs).

entries.name: lace_garter_belt
entries.description: A garter [belt](#belt) woven wholly from [lace](#lace). The version in solid or sheer [cloth](#cloth) with a lace edging takes the lace-trimmed spelling.

entries.name: slip_showing
entries.description: The hem of a [petticoat](#petticoat) worn under a [skirt](#skirt) or [dress](#dress) [peeking](#peeking) out below it. Usually only visible when the outer garment is raised, blown up, or seen from a low angle.

entries.name: white_negligee
entries.description: A white [negligee](#negligee), a light and often sheer nightdress on thin straps. It falls to the thigh or knee and is worn as [bedroom](#bedroom) wear.

entries.name: black_negligee
entries.description: A sheer, loose nightdress in black, cut long and light and usually trimmed with [lace](#lace). Worn as [lingerie](#lingerie) rather than as practical [sleepwear](#sleepwear).

entries.name: black_garter
entries.description: A black band worn high on the thigh, either decorative or [holding](#holding) a stocking up. Often lace-trimmed and part of bridal or [lingerie](#lingerie) sets.

entries.name: yellow_corset
entries.description: A yellow [corset](#corset) laced around the [torso](#torso), worn beneath or over other clothing.

entries.name: frilled_underwear
entries.description: Underwear of unspecified kind [carrying](#carrying) ruffled trim. Where the garment is plainly [panties](#panties) or a [bra](#bra), the specific frilled [tag](#tag) says more.

entries.name: satin_underwear
entries.description: Underwear made of glossy [satin](#satin) where the particular garment is not clear, or where several satin pieces are worn together.

entries.name: girdle
entries.description: A stiff elasticated undergarment worn over the waist and hips to shape the [figure](#figure), often with suspender clips [hanging](#hanging) from its lower edge. Related to the [corset](#corset) but shorter and softer.

entries.name: frilled_garter_belt
entries.description: A garter [belt](#belt) whose waistband or [hanging](#hanging) straps are trimmed with ruffles. Belongs to [lingerie](#lingerie) sets and burlesque-flavoured costumes.

entries.name: green_babydoll
entries.description: A green [babydoll](#babydoll): the loose short nightdress that stops around the hips. A colour variant of the [lingerie](#lingerie) piece.

entries.name: yellow_babydoll
entries.description: A yellow [babydoll](#babydoll), the short loose nightdress that falls to about the hips.

entries.name: orange_corset
entries.description: An orange [corset](#corset) laced tight around the [torso](#torso), worn as [underwear](#underwear) or openly as part of the outfit.

entries.name: grey_babydoll
entries.description: A grey [babydoll](#babydoll), the short loose nightdress cut to about the hips. It hangs from thin straps and is usually sheer or trimmed with [lace](#lace).

entries.name: brown_babydoll
entries.description: A [babydoll](#babydoll) in brown: a short loose nightdress [falling](#falling) [no](#no) further than the hips, usually hung from thin straps. Colour variant of the [lingerie](#lingerie) piece.

entries.name: orange_babydoll
entries.description: An orange [babydoll](#babydoll), the loose short nightdress ending around the hips with a fitted bust.

entries.name: pajamas
entries.description: Loose, comfortable [clothes](#clothes) made for [sleeping](#sleeping) in, generally a matching set of a top with light trousers, [shorts](#shorts) or capris. Nightgowns and negligees have tags of their own.

entries.name: nightgown
entries.description: A loose [hanging](#hanging) garment for [sleeping](#sleeping) in, worn almost always by women. Its length runs anywhere from hip to [floor](#floor), with any neckline or sleeve; a very short one is a [babydoll](#babydoll).

entries.name: sleepwear
entries.description: Clothes for [bed](#bed) that fit [no](#no) more specific [tag](#tag); [pajamas](#pajamas), nightgowns, negligees and jinbei have their own. Usually pictured in a [bedroom](#bedroom) setting.

entries.name: sleep_mask
entries.description: A soft eye [cover](#cover) worn to block out light while [sleeping](#sleeping), drawn over the eyes or pushed up onto the [forehead](#forehead).

entries.name: pink_pajamas
entries.description: Sleepwear in pink, usually a matching top and trousers worn to [bed](#bed). A pink [nightgown](#nightgown) or [nightshirt](#nightshirt) takes its own garment [tag](#tag).

entries.name: blue_pajamas
entries.description: A blue sleep set of matching top and trousers. Buttoned fronts and contrasting piping are common; a single long [gown](#gown) worn to [bed](#bed) is a [nightgown](#nightgown) instead.

entries.name: onesie
entries.description: A loose one-piece [lounging](#lounging) [suit](#suit) of fleece or cotton covering body and [legs](#legs), frequently hooded. Worn as pyjamas or as [casual](#casual) wear; animal-shaped ones overlap with [kigurumi](#kigurumi).

entries.name: loungewear
entries.description: Loose, comfortable clothing meant for idling about [indoors](#indoors), such as soft tops and [sweatpants](#sweatpants). It is distinct from [pajamas](#pajamas), which are for [sleeping](#sleeping) in.

entries.name: white_nightgown
entries.description: A loose white [gown](#gown) worn for [sleeping](#sleeping), usually long and soft. It reads as innocent or ghostly depending on the setting.

entries.name: white_pajamas
entries.description: A white pajama set, usually a buttoned top with matching loose trousers. Seen in bedtime, [lounging](#lounging) and [hospital](#hospital) scenes alike.

entries.name: bathrobe
entries.description: A loose soft [robe](#robe) wrapped across the front and tied at the waist, thrown on after a [bath](#bath) or shower. A wizard's or ceremonial robe is something else entirely.

entries.name: polka_dot_pajamas
entries.description: Sleepwear [patterned](#patterned) with round [dots](#dots), usually a matching button top and loose trousers. A fixture of bedtime and [morning](#morning) scenes.

entries.name: striped_pajamas
entries.description: Sleepwear marked with stripes, usually a matching button-front top and trousers set. Implies [pajamas](#pajamas) and [striped_clothes](#striped_clothes).

entries.name: black_nightgown
entries.description: A [gown](#gown) worn to [bed](#bed) in black, [falling](#falling) from the shoulders to the knee or lower. Plainer and more covering than a [negligee](#negligee).

entries.name: green_pajamas
entries.description: Green [sleepwear](#sleepwear), most often a buttoned top with matching loose trousers. It belongs to [bedroom](#bedroom), early-morning and [sleepover](#sleepover) scenes.

entries.name: yellow_pajamas
entries.description: Yellow nightwear, usually a matching [shirt](#shirt) and trousers. Bedrooms and [sleepy](#sleepy) [morning](#morning) scenes are where it turns up.

entries.name: print_pajamas
entries.description: Pyjamas printed with a motif of any kind, from small repeated [shapes](#shapes) to one large picture. A print alone does not make them multicoloured.

entries.name: pink_robe
entries.description: A long loose [robe](#robe) in pink, wrapped or belted rather than tailored to fit. It covers bathrobes as [well](#well) as ceremonial and [fantasy](#fantasy) gowns.

entries.name: purple_pajamas
entries.description: A purple two-piece [sleeping](#sleeping) outfit of loose top and trousers. Bedtime and [lounging](#lounging) scenes are where it shows up.

entries.name: pink_nightgown
entries.description: A loose pink [gown](#gown) worn for [sleeping](#sleeping), [falling](#falling) anywhere from mid-thigh to the ankle. It is nightwear rather than a [dress](#dress) for going out.

entries.name: black_pajamas
entries.description: Sleepwear in black, either a two-piece top-and-trousers set or a one-piece. Reach for it when the character is dressed for [bed](#bed) rather than [lounging](#lounging) in everyday [clothes](#clothes).

entries.name: hooded_pajamas
entries.description: Nightwear with a [hood](#hood) sewn on, frequently [carrying](#carrying) ears or an [animal](#animal) face. The effect is deliberately cosy and childlike.

entries.name: vertical-striped_pajamas
entries.description: Pyjamas striped lengthwise from shoulder to hem, the classic nightwear pattern. Usually drawn as a matching top and trousers in two alternating colours.

entries.name: frilled_nightgown
entries.description: A nightdress finished with ruffles at the hem, sleeves or neckline. Belongs to [bedroom](#bedroom), waking-up and other [sleepwear](#sleepwear) scenes.

entries.name: red_pajamas
entries.description: A red [sleeping](#sleeping) set, typically a buttoned top with matching loose trousers. Worn in [bedroom](#bedroom), [morning](#morning) and [sleepover](#sleepover) scenes.

entries.name: orange_pajamas
entries.description: Nightwear in orange, the matching set or only one half of it. Button-front, pullover and [shorts](#shorts) styles all qualify.

entries.name: nightshirt
entries.description: A long loose [shirt](#shirt) worn to [bed](#bed), usually [falling](#falling) somewhere between thigh and knee. Nothing goes over it and often very little underneath.

entries.name: blue_nightgown
entries.description: A loose [sleeping](#sleeping) [gown](#gown) in blue, [hanging](#hanging) anywhere from mid-thigh to the ankles. It is one continuous garment, so a matching sleep [shirt](#shirt) and trousers are [pajamas](#pajamas) instead.

entries.name: grey_pajamas
entries.description: Grey [sleepwear](#sleepwear), a top with matching loose trousers. It belongs to [bedroom](#bedroom), early-morning and [sleepover](#sleepover) scenes.

entries.name: purple_nightgown
entries.description: A loose purple [gown](#gown) worn for [sleeping](#sleeping), usually [falling](#falling) to the knee or below. Bedroom and just-woken scenes are its natural habitat.

entries.name: brown_pajamas
entries.description: A brown [sleeping](#sleeping) set, normally a loose top with matching trousers. Piping, a soft [fabric](#fabric) and a [plain](#plain) button front are the usual drawing cues.

entries.name: night_clothes
entries.description: Garments put on for [sleeping](#sleeping), whether pyjamas, a [nightgown](#nightgown) or a loose oversized [shirt](#shirt). It covers [sleepwear](#sleepwear) as a class rather than one particular cut.

entries.name: japanese_clothes
entries.description: Any traditional Japanese garment, from [kimono](#kimono) and [yukata](#yukata) to [hakama](#hakama), [haori](#haori), [happi](#happi) and jinbei, along with the sashes, footwear and hair pieces that go with them. Modern Japanese [fashion](#fashion), [school](#school) uniforms and lolita styles are excluded.

entries.name: kimono
entries.description: The traditional Japanese [robe](#robe): long, wide sleeves, the front wrapped left over right and held shut by a broad [obi](#obi) [sash](#sash). Sandals, split-toe [socks](#socks) and hair ornaments often complete it, and merely Japanese-looking clothing does not qualify.

entries.name: obi
entries.description: The broad, long [sash](#sash) that closes a [kimono](#kimono), knotted at the [back](#back) and often richly [patterned](#patterned). It also holds robe-style tops shut, and an ornament frequently sits on it off to one side of the front.

entries.name: hakama
entries.description: A [pleated](#pleated) traditional Japanese garment tied over a [kimono](#kimono), worn either as wide trousers or as a divided [skirt](#skirt) with front and [back](#back) panels [reaching](#reaching) the waist. Worn historically by [samurai](#samurai), [miko](#miko), martial artists and Shinto priests, and still common at [graduation](#graduation) ceremonies. Tag the specific shape too: [hakama_skirt](#hakama_skirt) or [hakama_pants](#hakama_pants).

entries.name: hakama_skirt
entries.description: A [hakama](#hakama) worn as a single [pleated](#pleated) [skirt](#skirt) with [no](#no) leg division, the form usual for [miko](#miko) and for women's [graduation](#graduation) [dress](#dress). Add [hakama_short_skirt](#hakama_short_skirt) when it is cut short.

entries.name: white_kimono
entries.description: A white [kimono](#kimono), [yukata](#yukata) or [furisode](#furisode), including bridal [shiromuku](#shiromuku) and [shrine](#shrine) wear. Japanese-flavored outfits that aren't actually kimono-shaped don't count.

entries.name: nontraditional_miko
entries.description: A modernised shrine-maiden outfit: [hakama](#hakama) shortened into a [pleated](#pleated) [skirt](#skirt), [sleeveless](#sleeveless) or detached-sleeve tops, [thighhighs](#thighhighs) and heeled [sandals](#sandals), often borrowing from lolita or [school](#school) [fashion](#fashion). Such outfits are not tagged [miko](#miko), which is kept for the traditional garb.

entries.name: yukata
entries.description: A light, informal [kimono](#kimono) worn for [summer](#summer) festivals and [fireworks](#fireworks), or slipped on after a soak at a hot-spring inn. Every colour and print of it folds under the kimono [tag](#tag) [family](#family), so pair the two together.

entries.name: blue_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in blue, with [yukata](#yukata), [furisode](#furisode) and other kimono-style garments [folded](#folded) in. The [obi](#obi) and other [accessories](#accessories) keep their own colours.

entries.name: black_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in black, taking in [yukata](#yukata), [furisode](#furisode) and other kimono-cut garments. Formal black ones often carry [family](#family) crests at the shoulders and [back](#back).

entries.name: print_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono), [yukata](#yukata) or [furisode](#furisode) printed with a stylised motif such as flowers, hearts, animals or [waves](#waves). Tag kimono and, where the motif fits, [floral_print](#floral_print).

entries.name: red_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in red, including a [yukata](#yukata) or [furisode](#furisode) of the same colour. A red [obi](#obi) worn over a kimono of another colour is not enough on its own for this [tag](#tag).

entries.name: haori
entries.description: A light hip- or thigh-length [jacket](#jacket) worn open over a [kimono](#kimono), often with a decorative cord tied across the chest. Historically a man's garment; the pale blue one with white mountain-stripe sleeves marks a Shinsengumi member. It is not a [kataginu](#kataginu).

entries.name: pink_kimono
entries.description: A kimono-style Japanese garment in pink, [yukata](#yukata) and [furisode](#furisode) included. When the pink [cloth](#cloth) carries a design, add the pattern [tag](#tag) such as [floral_print](#floral_print).

entries.name: red_hakama
entries.description: Red [hakama](#hakama), the [pleated](#pleated) trouser-skirt of Japanese [dress](#dress). This colour is the classic lower half of a [miko](#miko) outfit, worn with a white [kimono](#kimono) top.

entries.name: short_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) cut with its hem at or above the knee, a modern or [fantasy](#fantasy) variant of the traditional ankle-length garment. Implies kimono.

entries.name: purple_kimono
entries.description: A purple [kimono](#kimono), including [yukata](#yukata) and [furisode](#furisode) styles. Combine with kimono and the pattern, such as [floral_print](#floral_print), and with [obi](#obi) when the [sash](#sash) is prominent.

entries.name: hakama_short_skirt
entries.description: A [hakama](#hakama) [skirt](#skirt) shortened to anywhere from knee length down to a [microskirt](#microskirt). At [miniskirt](#miniskirt) length it is often paired with [thighhighs](#thighhighs) for the [zettai_ryouiki](#zettai_ryouiki) look.

entries.name: muneate
entries.description: The [leather](#leather) chest [guard](#guard) strapped on by women practising Japanese [archery](#archery), keeping the bowstring from striking the breast as the [bow](#bow) is loosed. It is worn over the [kyuudou](#kyuudou) outfit.

entries.name: tasuki
entries.description: A cord or [ribbon](#ribbon) looped over the shoulders to bind [back](#back) [kimono](#kimono) or [yukata](#yukata) sleeves, keeping them clear of the hands during chores or play.

entries.name: green_kimono
entries.description: A green [kimono](#kimono), with [yukata](#yukata) and [furisode](#furisode) counted under the same [tag](#tag). Record the specific style and the [obi](#obi) colour separately.

entries.name: kariginu
entries.description: A Japanese [robe](#robe) whose sleeves hang from the shoulder seam only, leaving an open slit down each shoulder. Hunting [dress](#dress) to begin with, it became informal noble wear, and the [tag](#tag) takes in the suikan and similar robes too.

entries.name: chest_sarashi
entries.description: Sarashi [cloth](#cloth) wound only around the chest like a [tube](#tube) top, leaving the [midriff](#midriff) bare. It is a stylised version rather than the traditional full-torso wrap, and [kendo](#kendo) girls and fighters wear it constantly.

entries.name: obijime
entries.description: The slender cord tied round the middle of a woman's [obi](#obi) and through its knot, flat or rounded and often finished with tassels. A rounded, padded one reads as more ceremonial than a flat one.

entries.name: floral_print_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) covered in a [flower](#flower) pattern, chrysanthemums or [cherry](#cherry) blossom across a [furisode](#furisode) or a [yukata](#yukata). It counts as a print kimono as [well](#well) as a floral print.

entries.name: sleeveless_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) with [no](#no) attached sleeves. The garment must actually be a kimono; Japanese-flavoured outfits do not qualify.

entries.name: furisode
entries.description: A formal [kimono](#kimono) marked by very long [hanging](#hanging) sleeves, cut from fine brightly coloured [silk](#silk). Traditionally the [dress](#dress) of unmarried women at ceremonies and new year.

entries.name: yellow_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in yellow, including [yukata](#yukata) and [furisode](#furisode) cut in the same style. Tag kimono as [well](#well).

entries.name: frilled_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) with rows of ruffles worked into it, usually at the [collar](#collar), sleeve openings or hem. Yukata, [furisode](#furisode) and other kimono-shaped tops fall under the same [tag](#tag) when they carry ruffles.

entries.name: obiage
entries.description: A scarf-like band of [cloth](#cloth) tucked in just above the [obi](#obi) on a woman's [kimono](#kimono), with only a strip of it left showing. By tradition the younger the wearer, the more of it is on view.

entries.name: blue_hakama
entries.description: Blue [hakama](#hakama), the [pleated](#pleated) Japanese trousers or divided [skirt](#skirt) worn over a [kimono](#kimono). Martial arts, [shrine](#shrine) [dress](#dress) and formal [school](#school) outfits are where they appear.

entries.name: orange_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in orange, [counting](#counting) [yukata](#yukata), [furisode](#furisode) and other kimono-style garments. An orange [obi](#obi) on its own is not enough.

entries.name: black_hakama
entries.description: Hakama in black, the wide [pleated](#pleated) Japanese trousers or [skirt](#skirt) worn over a [kimono](#kimono). Standard in [shrine](#shrine), martial arts and formal [school](#school) [dress](#dress).

entries.name: grey_kimono
entries.description: A grey [kimono](#kimono), with [yukata](#yukata) and [furisode](#furisode) counted under the same [tag](#tag). Tag the [obi](#obi) and the specific style separately.

entries.name: meiji_schoolgirl_uniform
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) worn under a [hakama](#hakama) [skirt](#skirt) at the waist, usually finished with laced [boots](#boots) and sometimes a hair [bow](#bow) - Japanese schoolgirl [dress](#dress) from the turn of the twentieth century. Still worn at some [graduation](#graduation) ceremonies today; rolled-up sleeves with a [tasuki](#tasuki) [sash](#sash) suggest a [waitress](#waitress) outfit instead.

entries.name: brown_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in brown, including [yukata](#yukata) and [furisode](#furisode) of that colour. Add kimono, plus yukata or [japanese_clothes](#japanese_clothes) where they apply.

entries.name: hakama_pants
entries.description: A [hakama](#hakama) cut as baggy [pleated](#pleated) trousers rather than a [skirt](#skirt). The traditional form worn by [samurai](#samurai), [kendo](#kendo) and kyudo practitioners and Shinto priests.

entries.name: kappougi
entries.description: A sleeved Japanese [apron](#apron) that covers the whole front like a loose [gown](#gown), tied on over a [kimono](#kimono) for [cooking](#cooking) and housework. A [cloth](#cloth) knotted round the head often goes with it.

entries.name: checkered_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono), [yukata](#yukata) or [furisode](#furisode) in a chequerboard pattern, the ichimatsu design. A certain green and black swordsman's [haori](#haori) is the version most [people](#people) picture.

entries.name: sideless_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) cut away at the sides of the chest so the flanks and often the [sideboob](#sideboob) show, in extreme examples covering little more than the [nipples](#nipples). The garment must actually be a kimono; generic Japanese-styled clothing does not qualify.

entries.name: budget_sarashi
entries.description: A chest wrap too narrow or too short to [cover](#cover) the [torso](#torso) properly, leaving [cleavage](#cleavage), [underboob](#underboob) or the [midriff](#midriff) on show while still [bound](#bound) tight. Wrapping that has come loose or half unwound is [undone_sarashi](#undone_sarashi) instead.

entries.name: striped_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono), or a related garment such as a [yukata](#yukata) or [furisode](#furisode), [patterned](#patterned) with stripes. Implies kimono and [striped_clothes](#striped_clothes).

entries.name: fur-trimmed_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) or kimono-styled top edged with fur, generally a [winter](#winter) or new-year variation. The fur usually rides the [collar](#collar) and sleeve openings.

entries.name: layered_kimono
entries.description: A many-layered court [kimono](#kimono) in the Heian manner, such as the twelve-layer juunihitoe, each layer's colour showing at [collar](#collar), sleeve and hem. Robes of around five layers count as [well](#well).

entries.name: happi
entries.description: A straight-sleeved Japanese [festival](#festival) [coat](#coat) with a thick contrasting band [running](#running) down each front edge, [reaching](#reaching) past the waist and worn open or tied with a [cloth](#cloth) [belt](#belt). Indigo and brown are traditional; the padded indoor [winter](#winter) [jacket](#jacket) is [hanten_(clothes)](#hanten_(clothes)).

entries.name: bath_yukata
entries.description: A light cotton [yukata](#yukata) worn to and from the [bath](#bath), the kind an inn or hot-spring resort lends its guests. It hangs loosely tied and is generally [plain](#plain) or simply striped.

entries.name: hakama_shorts
entries.description: A [hakama](#hakama) tailored as [shorts](#shorts), with the pleats and waist ties of the traditional garment but [legs](#legs) ending above the knee.

entries.name: kimono_skirt
entries.description: A short kimono-style garment that flares out from the waist like a [skirt](#skirt). It is not the same as a [hakama](#hakama) skirt, which is cut as wide [pleated](#pleated) trousers.

entries.name: multicolored_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono), [yukata](#yukata) or [furisode](#furisode) whose [cloth](#cloth) shows two or more separate colours. The [tag](#tag) covers the whole [family](#family) of kimono-styled garments.

entries.name: kesa
entries.description: The oblong panel of ornamented [cloth](#cloth) a Buddhist [priest](#priest) drapes over one shoulder on top of the [robe](#robe). It marks out monks and priests in Japanese settings.

entries.name: green_hakama
entries.description: Green [hakama](#hakama), the wide [pleated](#pleated) Japanese trousers or divided [skirt](#skirt) tied over a [kimono](#kimono). Common on [miko](#miko), martial artists and formal traditional [dress](#dress).

entries.name: hanten_(clothes)
entries.description: A short traditional Japanese [jacket](#jacket), nowadays usually the cotton-padded kind thrown on [indoors](#indoors) against the [cold](#cold) by men and women alike. The longer gown-like dotera is often mixed up with it, and the unpadded [festival](#festival) [coat](#coat) is [happi](#happi).

entries.name: uchikake
entries.description: The [ornate](#ornate) outer [kimono](#kimono) a [bride](#bride) wears at a traditional Japanese [wedding](#wedding), usually white and paired with a tsunokakushi or [wataboushi](#wataboushi) [hood](#hood). An all-white version is called a [shiromuku](#shiromuku).

entries.name: shihakusho
entries.description: A [plain](#plain) black [robe](#robe) worn as a [death](#death) or [mourning](#mourning) garment, most [familiar](#familiar) as the standard uniform of Soul Reaper-type characters in fiction.

entries.name: aqua_kimono
entries.description: A [kimono](#kimono) in aqua blue, the [tag](#tag) [reaching](#reaching) [yukata](#yukata), [furisode](#furisode) and other kimono-cut garments. Add the specific one where it is clear.

entries.name: pink_hakama
entries.description: Hakama in pink, the [pleated](#pleated) Japanese trouser-skirt tied at the waist over a [kimono](#kimono) top. Shrine maiden outfits reach for this colour most often.

entries.name: purple_hakama
