entries.description: A [fabric](#fabric) hair tie whose [cloth](#cloth) carries a pattern or picture instead of being one flat colour. Any motif qualifies, from [dots](#dots) and checks to characters. Use it alongside the [plain](#plain) [scrunchie](#scrunchie) [tag](#tag).

entries.name: striped_scrunchie
entries.description: A [fabric](#fabric) hair tie gathered on elastic, made from striped [cloth](#cloth). Implies [scrunchie](#scrunchie) and [striped_clothes](#striped_clothes).

entries.name: no_hairband
entries.description: A [hairband](#hairband) belonging to a character's design does not appear at all. If it has merely come off the head but is still visible, [unworn_hairband](#unworn_hairband) applies instead.

entries.name: aqua_headband
entries.description: A blue-green band worn across the [forehead](#forehead), tied or elasticated. Keep it apart from a [hairband](#hairband), which sits further [back](#back) over the [crown](#crown).

entries.name: gold_headband
entries.description: A [gold](#gold) band [running](#running) across or around the head to keep the hair off the face. Plainer than a [circlet](#circlet) and firmer than a [cloth](#cloth) [hairband](#hairband).

entries.name: lace_hairband
entries.description: A narrow strip of [lace](#lace) worn across the head as a band. A solid [hairband](#hairband) merely finished with lace along its edge is a different [tag](#tag).

entries.name: plaid_hairband
entries.description: A [hairband](#hairband) covered in tartan [cloth](#cloth), worn over the [crown](#crown) of the head. Pattern aside, an otherwise ordinary hairband.

entries.name: winged_hair_tie
entries.description: A winged ornament [sitting](#sitting) exactly where the hair is gathered and [bound](#bound). It marks the tie point of a [ponytail](#ponytail) or of [twintails](#twintails).

entries.name: winged_hairband
entries.description: A [hairband](#hairband) [carrying](#carrying) a wing on one or both sides, worn above the ears. It is common on magical girls and on designs echoing a messenger god.

entries.name: multicolored_scrunchie
entries.description: The fabric-covered elastic hair tie made up in two or more colours rather than one. Being small, it usually echoes colours from elsewhere in the outfit.

entries.name: grey_scrunchie
entries.description: A grey fabric-covered elastic hair tie, worn in the hair or slipped around a wrist. It usually holds a [ponytail](#ponytail) or a bun.

entries.name: unworn_scrunchie
entries.description: A [scrunchie](#scrunchie) is in the picture but not [holding](#holding) any hair, [resting](#resting) free on a surface, held between fingers or [lying](#lying) beside a brush.

entries.name: hair_ornament
entries.description: Any purely decorative accessory worn in the hair: clips, flowers, [beads](#beads), bells, sticks. Bows and ribbons that tie the hair are not counted here; they take [hair_bow](#hair_bow) or [hair_ribbon](#hair_ribbon).

entries.name: hair_flower
entries.description: One or more flowers, real or artificial, worn in the hair. Flowers ringing the whole head are a [head_wreath](#head_wreath) instead.

entries.name: hair_tubes
entries.description: Cylindrical ornaments slid over separate locks of hair, keeping those strands apart from the rest. A [signature](#signature) look of shrine-maiden characters such as Hakurei Reimu.

entries.name: x_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like an X, often a pair of crossed clips. Distinct from the cross-shaped hair ornament, which takes the Christian [cross](#cross) shape; [tag](#tag) [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament) alongside.

entries.name: star_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a star, worn in the hair.

entries.name: heart_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin) or other ornament shaped as a [heart](#heart) worn in the hair, whatever it is made of.

entries.name: butterfly_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament shaped like a [butterfly](#butterfly), fastened into the hair so that it looks perched there. One of the most common ornament [shapes](#shapes), worn singly or in a scatter.

entries.name: hair_bell
entries.description: A small [bell](#bell) worn in the hair as an ornament, usually on a [ribbon](#ribbon) or hair tie.

entries.name: food-themed_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like something edible, a [strawberry](#strawberry) clip or a [candy](#candy) [pin](#pin) for instance. It covers the many foods that never got an ornament [tag](#tag) of their own.

entries.name: bun_cover
entries.description: A [fabric](#fabric) [cover](#cover) or ornament fitted over a hair bun, often as a matching pair on double buns. Chinese-styled outfits use them most.

entries.name: feather_hair_ornament
entries.description: One or more [feathers](#feathers) worn in the hair as decoration, clipped or tied into it. Feathers growing from a [bird](#bird) girl's own head are [feather_hair](#feather_hair).

entries.name: frog_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament cut as a small [frog](#frog). Best known as half of a frog-and-snake pair worn by one Touhou [shrine](#shrine) maiden, but any frog-shaped hair piece qualifies.

entries.name: horn_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair accessory shaped as a pair of [horns](#horns), so the wearer looks horned without having any. It comes off with the hairstyle.

entries.name: horn_ornament
entries.description: Any decoration worn on the [horns](#horns): bows, ribbons, rings, charms or jewellery. It is the [umbrella](#umbrella) [tag](#tag) over [horn_bow](#horn_bow), [horn_ribbon](#horn_ribbon) and [horn_ring](#horn_ring).

entries.name: rabbit_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a [rabbit](#rabbit) or a rabbit's face, worn in the hair. A full ear-shaped [headband](#headband) instead is [rabbit_ear_hairband](#rabbit_ear_hairband).

entries.name: snake_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a [snake](#snake), best known from Kochiya Sanae, who wears it with a [frog](#frog) one. Tag beside [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament).

entries.name: leaf_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament cut in the shape of a [leaf](#leaf) and worn in the hair, a motif tied to foxes and [tanuki](#tanuki). A loose leaf [resting](#resting) on the head is [leaf_on_head](#leaf_on_head), and a woven [ring](#ring) of leaves is [laurel_crown](#laurel_crown).

entries.name: crescent_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament shaped like a [crescent](#crescent) [moon](#moon), set into the hair. A recurring [signature](#signature) on lunar and witch-themed designs.

entries.name: cross_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip made in the shape of a Christian crucifix. An X- or plus-shaped one takes [x_hair_ornament](#x_hair_ornament) instead.

entries.name: cube_hair_ornament
entries.description: Small cube-shaped [beads](#beads) or blocks worn in the hair. Usually threaded onto a hair tie or clipped in beside the face.

entries.name: frilled_hair_tubes
entries.description: The tube-shaped ornaments that hold [sidelocks](#sidelocks) in place, here finished with ruffles at their ends. Plain ones are simply [hair_tubes](#hair_tubes); the ruffles are what make this the specific variant.

entries.name: sphere_hair_ornament
entries.description: Round [beads](#beads) or balls fixed in the hair, worn singly or in matching pairs on ties and clips, and frequently seen [holding](#holding) [twintails](#twintails) or buns in place.

entries.name: wing_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament or [pin](#pin) shaped like one or two [wings](#wings). Tag [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament) alongside it; actual wings growing from the head are [head_wings](#head_wings) instead.

entries.name: skull_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a [skull](#skull), a gothic or Halloween styling touch. Tag beside [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament).

entries.name: anchor_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like an [anchor](#anchor), fixed in the hair. It is a [staple](#staple) of [sailor](#sailor) and ship-themed character designs.

entries.name: tassel_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [tassel](#tassel) worn in the hair as decoration.

entries.name: cat_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip made in the form of a cat's face, or of a whole small [cat](#cat), worn in the hair. Frequently part of a cat-themed outfit.

entries.name: pom_pom_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [fluffy](#fluffy) [ball](#ball) worn in the hair as an ornament, on a hair tie, clip or [pin](#pin). Tag [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament) and [pom_pom_(clothes)](#pom_pom_(clothes)) alongside.

entries.name: musical_note_hair_ornament
entries.description: Hair jewellery cut in the shape of a [note](#note), clef, dynamic mark or other musical symbol, worn as a clip or [pin](#pin). Any notation [sign](#sign) counts, not only the note itself.

entries.name: hairpods
entries.description: Rigid, rounded covers of metal or similar hard material worn over the hair at the sides of the head, like hard bun covers. Anya from Spy [x](#x) Family wears a well-known pair.

entries.name: carrot_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a [carrot](#carrot), one of the food-shaped hair ornaments. Worn most often by rabbit-themed characters.

entries.name: hair_beads
entries.description: Strings of small [beads](#beads) worn in the hair as decoration or to bind a [ponytail](#ponytail) or braids. Pairs of large balls on an elastic are [hair_bobbles](#hair_bobbles) instead.

entries.name: bone_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip cut in the shape of a [bone](#bone), or a real one pushed through the hair to hold it. Tribal, cavegirl and [monster](#monster) designs wear them most.

entries.name: triangle_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair accessory shaped like a [triangle](#triangle), usually a small flat clip or charm. Add the more specific [hairclip](#hairclip) [tag](#tag) as [well](#well) when that is what holds it in place.

entries.name: single_hair_ring
entries.description: One ring-shaped ornament threaded around a strand or [tail](#tail) of hair, rather than a matched pair.

entries.name: horseshoe_ornament
entries.description: A decoration shaped like a [horseshoe](#horseshoe), worn in the hair, on clothing or as jewellery. Horse-girl designs are full of them.

entries.name: bat_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) cut in the shape of a bat, favoured by gothic, [vampire](#vampire) and Halloween designs. It is the ornament that is tagged, not a live bat perched on the head.

entries.name: shark_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament shaped like a [shark](#shark).

entries.name: clover_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped as a [clover](#clover) [leaf](#leaf), whether it carries three leaflets or four. The playing-card club shape belongs to [club_hair_ornament](#club_hair_ornament) instead.

entries.name: character_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped after one particular character, such as a mascot's head worn in the hair. Merchandise-styled designs use them constantly.

entries.name: snowflake_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a snowflake, typical of ice- and winter-themed character designs. Distinct from loose [snowflakes](#snowflakes) [drifting](#drifting) through the air.

entries.name: bandaid_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or ornament made in the shape of an adhesive plaster and worn in the hair. It is decoration, not a [dressing](#dressing) over anything.

entries.name: fish_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or hair ornament made in the shape of a [fish](#fish), worn in the hair as a themed accessory.

entries.name: bear_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a bear's face or a whole small [bear](#bear). It is a cute accessory, quite separate from bear ears.

entries.name: single_hair_tube
entries.description: One cylindrical [tube](#tube) encasing a [lock](#lock) of hair, as opposed to the paired [hair_tubes](#hair_tubes) worn by [shrine](#shrine) maidens.

entries.name: d-pad_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip cut in the shape of a game controller's directional pad, [pinned](#pinned) into the hair. One of the gaming-themed ornaments.

entries.name: sunflower_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament shaped like a [sunflower](#sunflower). Implies [hair_flower](#hair_flower) and sunflower.

entries.name: moon_(ornament)
entries.description: A decoration cut in the shape of the [moon](#moon), worn in the hair or fixed to an outfit. Crescent-shaped ornaments are covered by the [crescent](#crescent) tags instead.

entries.name: candy_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip made in the form of a sweet, wrapped drops with twisted ends included. One of the food-shaped hair ornaments.

entries.name: strawberry_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a [strawberry](#strawberry).

entries.name: ring_hair_extensions
entries.description: Hair extensions attached through a [ring](#ring) ornament or a short [chain](#chain), so they act as both accessory and added length. Distinct from a hair-ring hairstyle, which needs [no](#no) extension.

entries.name: letter_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) worn in the hair cut in the shape of an [alphabet](#alphabet) [letter](#letter), frequently the character's own [initial](#initial).

entries.name: dice_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a die or a cluster of them, worn as a clip or decoration.

entries.name: pearl_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [string](#string) of pearls or a pearl-studded piece worn in the hair, frequently draped over a bun or an [updo](#updo) in formal and bridal styles.

entries.name: spaceship_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a spaceship or [rocket](#rocket), worn as a novelty decoration in the hair.

entries.name: cherry_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a single [cherry](#cherry) or as a pair joined at the stems. One of the food-shaped ornaments, and a favourite of spring-themed designs.

entries.name: diamond_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament cut as a diamond or rhombus, [pinned](#pinned) in as a clip or hung as a decoration. One of the shape-named ornaments.

entries.name: ring_hair_ornament
entries.description: A ring-shaped ornament worn in the hair. A ring-shaped hairstyle itself is [hair_rings](#hair_rings), and a [ring](#ring) that bundles a [lock](#lock) of hair rather than [decorating](#decorating) it is a hair_tube.

entries.name: egg_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like an [egg](#egg), either whole in its [shell](#shell) or cooked with the yolk showing. One of the food-themed hair ornaments.

entries.name: smokestack_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a ship's or [factory](#factory) funnel, worn by shipgirl characters in Kantai Collection and similar series.

entries.name: horn_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) or band worn around a horn, often metal and sometimes several to a horn. Demons, dragons and [oni](#oni) wear them most.

entries.name: shell_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament shaped like a [seashell](#seashell). Implies [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament).

entries.name: coin_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament in the shape of a [coin](#coin), often a [gold](#gold) disc [dangling](#dangling) from a clip or a cord.

entries.name: four-leaf_clover_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a four-leaf [clover](#clover), worn as a lucky charm. The ordinary three-leaf version stays under [clover_hair_ornament](#clover_hair_ornament).

entries.name: sparkle_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [sparkle](#sparkle) or a twinkling burst of light. Idol and magical-girl designs favor it for the way it catches light.

entries.name: horn_flower
entries.description: One or more flowers are worn on the [horns](#horns), tucked at the base or fastened along their length. Flowers set in the hair belong to [hair_flower](#hair_flower) instead.

entries.name: starfish_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip made in the shape of a [starfish](#starfish). Part of the [seaside](#seaside) set, usually worn with shells and pearls.

entries.name: floating_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair decoration hovering near the head with [no](#no) clip or [pin](#pin) [holding](#holding) it, part of the character's design rather than of physics. It often sits alongside other detached [accessories](#accessories).

entries.name: planet_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a [planet](#planet), almost always a ringed Saturn since it is the most recognisable. Tag [hair_ornament](#hair_ornament) alongside it.

entries.name: ghost_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a small cartoon [ghost](#ghost). Pairs naturally with Halloween outfits and spooky-cute designs.

entries.name: lightning_bolt_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a stylised [lightning](#lightning) bolt, common on characters with an electric theme.

entries.name: holly_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as [holly](#holly) leaves and berries, worn in the hair. Christmas outfits reach for it constantly.

entries.name: pumpkin_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin), or ornament shaped like a [pumpkin](#pumpkin) and worn in the hair. Add [jack-o'-lantern_hair_ornament](#jack-o'-lantern_hair_ornament) as [well](#well) if it is carved with a face.

entries.name: unworn_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament a character normally wears is out of their hair while still visible in the picture. It counts even when only some of several ornaments have been removed, so long as at least one of them is shown.

entries.name: animal_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) worn in the hair shaped as a [creature](#creature), from cats and rabbits to [fish](#fish), crabs, butterflies and stranger things still. The whole [family](#family) of species-specific ornaments sits beneath it.

entries.name: hexagon_hair_ornament
entries.description: One or more hexagons worn in the hair as a clip or a [pin](#pin). The shape may be solid, jewelled or an open frame.

entries.name: crown_hair_ornament
entries.description: A small [crown](#crown) [pinned](#pinned) into the hair as an ornament rather than seated squarely on the head as real headwear. Often set off to one side.

entries.name: gem_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin) or [comb](#comb) whose head is a jewel. Unlike a [tiara](#tiara) or [circlet](#circlet), it fastens into the hair rather than [sitting](#sitting) across the head as a band.

entries.name: fan_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [miniature](#miniature) folding or flat fan [pinned](#pinned) into the hair as decoration. Common with [kimono](#kimono) and [festival](#festival) [dress](#dress); the fan is worn rather than held.

entries.name: spade_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) worn in the hair shaped as the spade [card](#card) [suit](#suit). Card-motif costumes typically match it with [heart](#heart), club, and diamond pieces.

entries.name: propeller_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like an [aircraft](#aircraft) [propeller](#propeller), blades and hub included. Often worn by characters with an aviation theme.

entries.name: no_hair_ornament
entries.description: The clip, [pin](#pin) or trinket a character usually wears in the hair is missing from the drawing. The hair itself is styled as it always is.

entries.name: screw_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped like a [screw](#screw) or bolt, often paired with other hardware-styled motifs.

entries.name: paw_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or ornament shaped like a paw or a paw print, [pinned](#pinned) into the hair.

entries.name: cloud_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [pin](#pin) or ornament shaped like a [cloud](#cloud) worn in the hair. It often turns up beside stars and moons in the same sky-themed set.

entries.name: grape_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament made in the shape of [grapes](#grapes), one [berry](#berry) or a small [dangling](#dangling) bunch. It belongs to the food-themed ornaments and is often worn with other [fruit](#fruit) pieces.

entries.name: bird_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin) or ornament shaped like a [bird](#bird) and fixed into the hair. It ranges from a tiny perching songbird to a large spread-winged [crest](#crest).

entries.name: whale_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [whale](#whale), worn in the hair. It suits marine and summer-themed outfits.

entries.name: dog_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a dog's head or a whole small [dog](#dog), worn in the hair. One of the many animal-shaped ornaments used on cheerful character designs.

entries.name: fox_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair decoration shaped as a [fox](#fox), either just the face and ears or a whole [miniature](#miniature) [animal](#animal). Shrine and [kitsune](#kitsune) themes bring it out.

entries.name: jack-o'-lantern_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a carved [pumpkin](#pumpkin) [lantern](#lantern), worn in the hair. It turns up on [autumn](#autumn) costumes and [witch](#witch) outfits.

entries.name: panda_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [panda](#panda), either the black-and-white face alone or a whole little [animal](#animal), worn in the hair.

entries.name: winged_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair accessory built around [wings](#wings), such as a winged clip, [hairband](#hairband), or small [hat](#hat). Wings that grow naturally from the head itself are [head_wings](#head_wings) instead.

entries.name: magatama_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament made in the shape of a [magatama](#magatama), the comma-shaped bead of ancient Japan. It usually accompanies traditional Japanese [dress](#dress).

entries.name: tsumami_kanzashi
entries.description: A Japanese hair ornament whose blossoms are built from small squares of [folded](#folded) [silk](#silk). Often hangs in trailing strands and is paired with [kimono](#kimono) for festivals and coming-of-age celebrations.

entries.name: dolphin_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as a [dolphin](#dolphin), worn in the hair. Common on characters with a sea or [swimming](#swimming) theme.

entries.name: pill_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair accessory shaped like a capsule, clipped or [pinned](#pinned) into the hair. Medical- and yami-kawaii-themed outfits reach for it.

entries.name: ear_flower
entries.description: A blossom tucked behind or against the ear and held there by the hair. Decoration rather than part of the hairstyle itself.

entries.name: eyeball_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip made in the shape of an [eyeball](#eyeball), worn in the hair. Common in gothic and horror-flavoured designs.

entries.name: pinwheel_hair_ornament
entries.description: A small [paper](#paper) or plastic [pinwheel](#pinwheel) fixed into the hair as an ornament. Summer [festival](#festival) outfits favour it, usually beside a [yukata](#yukata).

entries.name: crystal_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped as a [crystal](#crystal) or a cut gemstone. Usually faceted and drawn with a [glint](#glint) of light on it.

entries.name: lemon_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) worn in the hair shaped as a [lemon](#lemon) or a lemon slice.

entries.name: rabbit_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a [rabbit](#rabbit) or decorated with rabbit motifs, clipped or [pinned](#pinned) into the hair rather than mounted on a [hat](#hat).

entries.name: grenade_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a hand [grenade](#grenade). It is a favourite finishing touch on military-themed character designs.

entries.name: too_many_hair_ornaments
entries.description: Hair loaded with clips, pins, bows and trinkets in excess, sometimes covering an entire fringe.

entries.name: gear_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) cut in the shape of a cogwheel. Reads as a [steampunk](#steampunk) or mechanic's touch on an otherwise ordinary hairstyle.

entries.name: apple_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped as an [apple](#apple), whole or cut into a wedge, worn in the hair. One of the many food-shaped hair pieces.

entries.name: fork_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or ornament made to look like a [table](#table) [fork](#fork), pushed into the hair. It usually turns up on [cooking](#cooking) and food-themed designs.

entries.name: club_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair accessory shaped like the club [suit](#suit) of a [playing](#playing) [card](#card). Normally part of a card or [casino](#casino) design alongside ornaments for the other three suits.

entries.name: orange_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or ornament worn in the hair shaped as a whole orange or a slice of one. One of the food-shaped ornament designs.

entries.name: peach_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like a [peach](#peach), worn on its own or as a small cluster of [fruit](#fruit) with leaves.

entries.name: yin_yang_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin) or ornament shaped as a yin yang disc and worn in the hair. Frequent on Taoist, fortune-teller and Chinese-themed designs.

entries.name: antler_ornament
entries.description: Decorations fixed to or hung from a character's [antlers](#antlers): baubles, bells, small charms, strings of [beads](#beads). Reindeer and forest-spirit designs use them, especially at Christmas.

entries.name: watermelon_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [watermelon](#watermelon), either the whole [fruit](#fruit) or a red wedge dotted with seeds. A cheerful [summer](#summer) accessory.

entries.name: coral_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [branch](#branch) of [coral](#coral), worn above the ear or at the [temple](#temple). Common on sea-themed and [mermaid](#mermaid) designs.

entries.name: ladybug_ornament
entries.description: A small decorative ladybird worn as an ornament, most often clipped into the hair. The red [shell](#shell) with its black [spots](#spots) makes it easy to pick out.

entries.name: flower_braid
entries.description: A blossom worked into a plait, [sitting](#sitting) among the strands rather than clipped on top of them. Several may run down the length of the [braid](#braid).

entries.name: cake_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [cake](#cake) or a slice of one. Distinct from a cake_hat, which sits on the head as headwear.

entries.name: christmas_tree_hair_ornament
entries.description: A small fir-tree shape worn as a clip or [pin](#pin) in the hair. A seasonal accessory that usually appears beside other holiday trimmings.

entries.name: macaron_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament made in the shape of a [macaron](#macaron), the round [sandwiched](#sandwiched) French confection. It is one of the sweets-themed ornaments popular on cute designs.

entries.name: number_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) cut in the shape of a numeral, worn in the hair. It often stands for a character's rank, team place or a favoured [figure](#figure).

entries.name: eye_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair ornament shaped like an eye or [carrying](#carrying) an eye design, clipped or [pinned](#pinned) into the hair. A flat eye motif, where [eyeball_hair_ornament](#eyeball_hair_ornament) is modelled in the round.

entries.name: ice_cream_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a cone or a [sundae](#sundae), worn in the hair. It belongs to the [family](#family) of food-shaped ornaments that go with sweet-themed outfits.

entries.name: fruit_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [hairpin](#hairpin) or clip shaped as a [fruit](#fruit) — a [strawberry](#strawberry), a [cherry](#cherry), a citrus slice. Sits in the same [family](#family) as the other food-shaped hair pieces.

entries.name: plant_on_head
entries.description: A [sprout](#sprout), [flower](#flower), or small potted [plant](#plant) [sitting](#sitting) atop somebody's head. It often appears to grow directly out of the hair rather than merely [resting](#resting) there.

entries.name: key_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [key](#key), worn in the hair. Ornate antique keys are the usual [model](#model) rather than a [plain](#plain) modern one.

entries.name: snowman_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [snowman](#snowman), usually the stacked two-ball [figure](#figure) complete with [hat](#hat) and [scarf](#scarf).

entries.name: hexagram_hair_ornament
entries.description: A six-pointed star worn in the hair, generally a flat metal or jewelled piece [pinned](#pinned) at the side of the head. The shape rather than the material is what the [tag](#tag) records.

entries.name: musical_note_ornament
entries.description: An ornament cut in the shape of a musical [note](#note), hung on clothing or carried as a small trinket. It marks out a character tied to [music](#music); worn in the hair, [musical_note_hair_ornament](#musical_note_hair_ornament) is the finer [tag](#tag).

entries.name: sun_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin) or ornament worn in the hair and shaped like a [sun](#sun). Distinguish it from a sun print on [fabric](#fabric) or a sun drawn as a free-floating symbol.

entries.name: orca_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like an [orca](#orca) worn in the hair. Popular on [aquarium](#aquarium) and marine-themed designs.

entries.name: paintbrush_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like an artist's brush, tucked into the hair. Suits characters marked out as painters.

entries.name: insect_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair piece cut in the shape of a [bug](#bug), such as a [butterfly](#butterfly), [beetle](#beetle), [bee](#bee) or [dragonfly](#dragonfly), clipped or [pinned](#pinned) into the hair. The insect shape is decoration; a live insect [resting](#resting) in the hair is something else.

entries.name: shooting_star_hair_ornament
entries.description: A star-shaped hair ornament trailing a [tail](#tail) or [pennant](#pennant) behind it, so that it reads as a [falling](#falling) star [pinned](#pinned) into the hair. Implies [star_hair_ornament](#star_hair_ornament).

entries.name: burger_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a hamburger, worn in the hair as decoration.

entries.name: palette_hair_ornament
entries.description: A hair clip modelled on a painter's palette, thumb [hole](#hole) and blobs of colour included. Marks the wearer out as an artist.

entries.name: dango_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [skewer](#skewer) of [dango](#dango) dumplings, worn in the hair. One of the food-shaped ornaments.

entries.name: jellyfish_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [pin](#pin) or clip cut in the shape of a [jellyfish](#jellyfish), its [bell](#bell) against the hair and its [tentacles](#tentacles) [hanging](#hanging) free. It is a summery piece.

entries.name: doughnut_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [doughnut](#doughnut), glazing and [sprinkles](#sprinkles) included. One of the many food-shaped hair ornaments.

entries.name: rainbow_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like an arc of a [rainbow](#rainbow), worn in the hair. The shape of the ornament is what matters, not simply being multicolored.

entries.name: raccoon_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin), or trinket worn in the hair shaped like a [raccoon](#raccoon) or [tanuki](#tanuki). An accessory [pinned](#pinned) into the hairstyle, distinct from a [hood](#hood) or [headband](#headband) with [animal](#animal) ears.

entries.name: octopus_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like an [octopus](#octopus), worn in the hair. The arms are usually splayed out around the fastening so the shape reads at a [glance](#glance).

entries.name: mushroom_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip, [pin](#pin) or bauble shaped like a [mushroom](#mushroom) worn in the hair. The red-and-white toadstool is the usual [choice](#choice), though other caps turn up.

entries.name: duck_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) modelled on a [duck](#duck), often the little yellow bath-toy shape. One of the animal-themed hair ornaments.

entries.name: umbrella_hair_ornament
entries.description: A small [umbrella](#umbrella) or [parasol](#parasol) worn in the hair as a decoration. Usually a [miniature](#miniature) charm on a clip or [pin](#pin) rather than a [working](#working) item.

entries.name: teddy_bear_hair_ornament
entries.description: A small bear-shaped clip or [pin](#pin) fastened into the hair, whether plastic or plush. It belongs to cute, deliberately childlike character designs.

entries.name: head_flag
entries.description: A small [flag](#flag) [standing](#standing) on the head or on headwear, on a short [pole](#pole) or [pinned](#pinned) to a band. Usually a joking [marker](#marker) of nationality or allegiance.

entries.name: crab_hair_ornament
entries.description: A [pin](#pin) or clip shaped like a [crab](#crab), worn at the side of the head. Usually part of a [seaside](#seaside) or [summer](#summer) design.

entries.name: onigiri_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) shaped like a [rice](#rice) [ball](#ball), [seaweed](#seaweed) band and all, worn in the hair. One of the food-shaped ornaments and usually drawn at the side of the head.

entries.name: light_bulb_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) worn in the hair shaped like a light bulb.

entries.name: lime_hair_ornament
entries.description: A clip or [pin](#pin) worn in the hair shaped as a lime or a lime wedge.

entries.name: earrings
entries.description: Jewelry [hanging](#hanging) from or set through the earlobe or another [hole](#hole) in the ear. Where only one is worn, add [single_earring](#single_earring); lobe [jewelry](#jewelry) is never called [ear_piercing](#ear_piercing), which covers the rest of the ear.

entries.name: single_earring
entries.description: One earring worn on one ear, the other ear left bare. A common asymmetric accessory detail.

entries.name: hoop_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as an open [ring](#ring) passing through the earlobe, or [hanging](#hanging) from a second ring. They range from thin and small to broad statement circles.

entries.name: stud_earrings
entries.description: Small [earrings](#earrings) that sit flat against the earlobe, fixed through a [piercing](#piercing) with [no](#no) [dangling](#dangling) part. Implies earrings.

entries.name: ear_ornament
entries.description: An ear accessory that is none of the usual sorts, neither earring nor clip nor [bow](#bow) nor [cover](#cover), often a shrunken piece of hair, [neck](#neck) or arm [jewelry](#jewelry) moved onto the ear. Jewelry through a pierced lobe takes [earrings](#earrings) instead.

entries.name: star_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like a star symbol, whether small [studs](#studs) or [dangling](#dangling) pieces.

entries.name: heart_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as hearts or hung with [heart](#heart) charms. Studs and [dangling](#dangling) pieces both count so long as the shape reads.

entries.name: tassel_earrings
entries.description: Earrings that end in a [hanging](#hanging) [tassel](#tassel).

entries.name: floating_earring
entries.description: An earring that hovers beside the ear without touching it, a design conceit rather than physics. Not for ordinary [earrings](#earrings) [dangling](#dangling) from the lobe.

entries.name: gold_earrings
entries.description: Earrings of [gold](#gold) or gold-coloured metal, hoops, [studs](#studs) and danglers alike. The shape takes a [tag](#tag) of its own, such as [hoop_earrings](#hoop_earrings).

entries.name: floating_earrings
entries.description: A pair of [earrings](#earrings) drawn detached from the lobes, [hanging](#hanging) in the air at either side of the head. Stylised [idol](#idol) and game character designs use them constantly.

entries.name: earclip
entries.description: An ear ornament that grips the ear and needs [no](#no) [piercing](#piercing), frequently a cuff hooked over the rim. Earrings hang from a pierced lobe instead.

entries.name: cross_earrings
entries.description: Earrings made in the shape of a [cross](#cross), from a [plain](#plain) plus to the Christian crucifix form. Frequently worn in one ear only.

entries.name: flower_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut or moulded into the shape of blossoms, from small [studs](#studs) to long [dangling](#dangling) sprays. Roses and other named blooms fall here as [well](#well).

entries.name: ear_tag
entries.description: A flat plastic identification [tag](#tag) [punched](#punched) through the ear, of the kind livestock wear, usually printed with a number. In art it is a common fitting on [cow](#cow) girls and other farm-animal characters.

entries.name: multiple_earrings
entries.description: More than one earring pierced through the same ear. A single stud worn in each ear does not qualify.

entries.name: pearl_earrings
entries.description: Earrings [carrying](#carrying) one or more pearls, whether a single stud at the lobe or a [hanging](#hanging) drop. A standard piece of formal [dress](#dress).

entries.name: sphere_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as round balls, whether a single bead or a [dangling](#dangling) sphere. Tag the shape regardless of color or material.

entries.name: crescent_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like a [crescent](#crescent), [hanging](#hanging) or [studded](#studded), without [running](#running) through the lobe the way a [hoop](#hoop) does. They carry the [moon](#moon) motif into the character's look.

entries.name: feather_earrings
entries.description: Earrings with a feather [hanging](#hanging) from them, a bohemian or [tribal](#tribal) look. The feather may be real plumage or a cut metal shape.

entries.name: triangle_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut into a triangular shape, whether flat geometric [studs](#studs) or [dangling](#dangling) pieces. Tag the material or colour separately when it matters.

entries.name: skull_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like little skulls, a gothic or pirate-flavoured accessory. Tag beside [earrings](#earrings); a single one also takes [single_earring](#single_earring).

entries.name: bow_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as small bows or hung with them, in [ribbon](#ribbon), metal or enamel. They may dangle from the lobe or sit flat against it.

entries.name: teardrop_earrings
entries.description: Earrings ending in a drop-shaped bead or [gem](#gem) that hangs below the ear and tapers to a point. A [staple](#staple) of formal wear and elegant character designs.

entries.name: magatama_earrings
entries.description: Comma-shaped [magatama](#magatama) [beads](#beads) hung as [earrings](#earrings), common on [shrine](#shrine) maidens and other Japanese-themed designs. Each bead keeps the classic curved form rather than a [plain](#plain) drop shape.

entries.name: food-themed_earrings
entries.description: Earrings modelled on any sort of [food](#food) item. It serves as the [umbrella](#umbrella) for foods that have [no](#no) earring [tag](#tag) of their own.

entries.name: crystal_earrings
entries.description: Earrings that look like faceted crystals or diamonds, generally clear or tinted [translucent](#translucent) drops. Cut to catch the light and drawn with a [glint](#glint).

entries.name: snake_earrings
entries.description: Earrings modelled as snakes, either [coiled](#coiled) [studs](#studs) or long bodies [dangling](#dangling) from the lobe. Sometimes a live [snake](#snake) is worked into the design instead.

entries.name: key_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like keys, [hanging](#hanging) from the lobe by the loop at the key's head. Ornate old-fashioned keys are more common than modern ones.

entries.name: pill_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like [medicine](#medicine) capsules, generally two-tone and [hanging](#hanging) from the lobe. A favourite of menhera and yumekawaii outfits.

entries.name: mismatched_earrings
entries.description: Two different [earrings](#earrings) worn together, differing from each other in shape, color or style.

entries.name: pom_pom_earrings
entries.description: Earrings that end in a [fluffy](#fluffy) [ball](#ball) of [yarn](#yarn) or fur, or in something shaped to resemble one. They [swing](#swing) and bounce as the wearer moves.

entries.name: ear_chain
entries.description: A fine [chain](#chain) strung between two piercings in the same ear, normally [running](#running) from high on the rim down to the lobe. Not the same as an earring that simply dangles a chain from one [hole](#hole).

entries.name: diamond_earrings
entries.description: Earrings [carrying](#carrying) a rhombus-shaped stone or charm, [dangling](#dangling) from the lobe or set flush against it. The shape is what matters, whatever the stone actually is.

entries.name: butterfly_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut in the shape of butterflies or hung with a [butterfly](#butterfly) charm. Studs [sitting](#sitting) flat on the lobe and long [dangling](#dangling) pairs both count.

entries.name: anchor_earrings
entries.description: Earrings hung with a small [anchor](#anchor). They go with [sailor](#sailor) and nautical outfits, usually beside a striped top or a sailor [collar](#collar).

entries.name: tooth_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as a [tooth](#tooth) or [fang](#fang), real or imitation, [hanging](#hanging) from the lobe. Only add a tooth [tag](#tag) when the shape is genuinely the focus.

entries.name: ribbon_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like small bows or [hanging](#hanging) [ribbon](#ribbon) loops. They may be metal castings of a [bow](#bow) or actual [fabric](#fabric) tied through the ear.

entries.name: sun_earrings
entries.description: Earrings whose [pendant](#pendant) or stud is shaped like a [sun](#sun), often a disc with rays around it, common on characters with a solar or [summer](#summer) theme.

entries.name: heart_ear_ornament
entries.description: A [heart](#heart) worn at the ear as an earring, a stud or a clip-on piece.

entries.name: bell_earrings
entries.description: Earrings whose [pendant](#pendant) is a [bell](#bell), either the open [church](#church) shape or a round jingle bell. Shrine, [cat](#cat) and [festival](#festival) designs reach for them often.

entries.name: shell_earrings
entries.description: Earrings made from real seashells or moulded to look like them, worn as [studs](#studs) or drops. A [staple](#staple) accessory for mermaids and [beach](#beach) outfits. Implies [earrings](#earrings) and [shell](#shell).

entries.name: hanafuda_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped or painted like Japanese [flower](#flower) cards, [hanging](#hanging) from the lobe as small illustrated rectangles. They may be worn as a matched pair or as a single one.

entries.name: silver_earrings
entries.description: Earrings made of a silvery metal, from [plain](#plain) [studs](#studs) to long [dangling](#dangling) pieces. Only the color of the metal matters here, not the shape.

entries.name: cherry_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like a pair of cherries joined at the stem, [swinging](#swinging) from the lobe. A playful [summer](#summer) piece that pairs with other fruit-shaped [accessories](#accessories).

entries.name: rectangular_earrings
entries.description: Earrings whose [hanging](#hanging) or stud element is a flat oblong rather than a [hoop](#hoop), drop, or stone. The straight-edged shape gives them a modern, geometric look.

entries.name: chain_earrings
entries.description: Earrings from which one or more strands of [chain](#chain) hang below the lobe. A chain strung between two points on the same ear is an ear chain and has its own [tag](#tag).

entries.name: lightning_bolt_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut in the shape of a stylised [lightning](#lightning) bolt.

entries.name: rabbit_earrings
entries.description: Earrings with a small [rabbit](#rabbit) [figure](#figure) or head [hanging](#hanging) from them. Small enough that the shape usually only reads clearly up close.

entries.name: jack-o'-lantern_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as carved [pumpkin](#pumpkin) lanterns, each with its grinning cut-out face. They are a [staple](#staple) of [autumn](#autumn) and Halloween outfits.

entries.name: leaf_earrings
entries.description: Earrings whose [pendant](#pendant) is shaped as a [leaf](#leaf), from a [plain](#plain) [silhouette](#silhouette) to a detailed sprig. They pair with woodland and seasonal outfits.

entries.name: pendant_earring
entries.description: An earring with a piece [hanging](#hanging) below the fitting and free to [swing](#swing), rather than one [sitting](#sitting) flat against the lobe.

entries.name: spade_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut in the shape of a spade from a deck of cards, usually solid black. A natural pairing for gambling- or card-themed outfits.

entries.name: crown_earrings
entries.description: Earrings [cast](#cast) as [miniature](#miniature) crowns, [studded](#studded) in or [hanging](#hanging) from the ear. A regal accent, generally paired with other royal motifs.

entries.name: snowflake_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut into the six-armed shape of a snowflake, worn as [studs](#studs) or as small [hanging](#hanging) charms.

entries.name: strawberry_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like strawberries, red with a small green [crown](#crown) of leaves.

entries.name: inverted_cross_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as crosses hung the wrong way up, with the short arm at the bottom. They belong to gothic and occult outfits.

entries.name: clover_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut to a [clover](#clover) [outline](#outline), most often the four-leaf version. Usually small [studs](#studs) or drops in metal or coloured enamel.

entries.name: jingle_bell_earrings
entries.description: Earrings built from little round bells of the slit-and-pellet kind, ringing whenever the head turns. Winter and cat-themed outfits favour them.

entries.name: cat_earrings
entries.description: Earrings cut or moulded as a [cat](#cat), sometimes a whole body and sometimes only a head with pointed ears. They hang from the lobe like any other novelty [pendant](#pendant).

entries.name: planet_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like planets, often a ringed Saturn [dangling](#dangling) from the earlobe. Part of the general space-themed accessory [family](#family).

entries.name: lemon_earrings
entries.description: Earrings modelled on a whole [lemon](#lemon) or a cut slice, usually bright yellow and worn with [summer](#summer) outfits.

entries.name: bullet_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like cartridges, [hanging](#hanging) from the lobe. They tend to accompany [military](#military), [delinquent](#delinquent) or gun-themed outfits.

entries.name: no_earrings
entries.description: Earrings that form part of a character's standard design are absent, leaving the earlobes bare. Nothing else about the look need change.

entries.name: bat_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as bats, usually [hanging](#hanging) with the [wings](#wings) spread wide. A [staple](#staple) of [vampire](#vampire) designs and Halloween costumes.

entries.name: ghost_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as little ghosts, typically a rounded body with a wavy hem. They turn up most often in Halloween artwork.

entries.name: unworn_earring
entries.description: An earring is visible in the picture without being in an ear, held between fingers, laid on a dresser or fallen loose. Common in [dressing](#dressing) and [undressing](#undressing) scenes.

entries.name: yin_yang_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like the black-and-white yin yang disc, worn as a pair or singly. The swirled halves are what identify them.

entries.name: wing_earrings
entries.description: Earrings [cast](#cast) as a single wing or a matched pair, [hanging](#hanging) from the earlobes. A wing motif elsewhere on the head belongs to a hair ornament instead.

entries.name: sword_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like [miniature](#miniature) swords, [hanging](#hanging) point-down from the ear. Common on warrior-themed or edgy character designs.

entries.name: lantern_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped like small [hanging](#hanging) lanterns. They belong to [festival](#festival) [dress](#dress) and to Chinese New Year outfits.

entries.name: dice_earrings
entries.description: Earrings shaped as small cubic [dice](#dice), pips and all. They hang from the lobe as a [gambling](#gambling) or games motif.

entries.name: orange-shaped_earrings
entries.description: Earrings made in the shape of the citrus [fruit](#fruit), either whole little oranges or cut wedges. One of the food-shaped jewellery designs.

entries.name: necklace
entries.description: A [chain](#chain) or [string](#string) worn loosely around the [neck](#neck). One [carrying](#carrying) a jewel or charm as its centrepiece is a [pendant](#pendant), and one that fits snugly is a [choker](#choker).

entries.name: pendant
entries.description: An ornament [hanging](#hanging) from a [necklace](#necklace) as its centrepiece, such as a [gem](#gem), a [cross](#cross) or a [locket](#locket). The [chain](#chain) by itself is necklace, and a hanging charm that is not neckwear is [charm_(object)](#charm_(object)).

entries.name: cross_necklace
entries.description: A [cross](#cross) hung from a [chain](#chain) at the [neck](#neck), from a small delicate [pendant](#pendant) to a [heavy](#heavy) rosary-style piece. Lends the outfit a devotional or gothic [note](#note).

entries.name: bead_necklace
entries.description: Beads threaded on a [string](#string) and worn around the [neck](#neck), from pearl-like strands to chunky wooden or plastic ones. Prayer [beads](#beads) worn this way count too.

entries.name: magatama
entries.description: A curved, comma-shaped bead, traditionally of jade, from ancient Japan and worn on a cord as a [pendant](#pendant) or charm. It carries associations with Shinto and with the imperial regalia.

entries.name: neck_ring
entries.description: A stiff ornament worn about the [neck](#neck), such as a torc or a rigid metal band. Unlike a [necklace](#necklace) it holds its shape rather than [hanging](#hanging) loose.

entries.name: pearl_necklace
entries.description: Pearls threaded on a [string](#string) and fastened behind the [neck](#neck), anywhere from a short [choker](#choker) length to a long [rope](#rope). The unrelated sexual sense of the phrase is not what this [tag](#tag) records.

entries.name: dog_tags
entries.description: Military identification plates on a [chain](#chain) around the [neck](#neck), worn with a uniform or simply as an accessory. Nothing to do with the [tag](#tag) on an actual [dog](#dog).

entries.name: chain_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) built from links that [can](#can) be made out individually, or one whose material, [gold](#gold) for instance, implies that [construction](#construction).

entries.name: gold_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) of [gold](#gold) or gold-coloured metal, from a bare [chain](#chain) to a [pendant](#pendant) or a broad [collar](#collar) piece.

entries.name: heart_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) whose front [pendant](#pendant) or centre stone is a [heart](#heart). A [hanging](#hanging) heart with [no](#no) visible [chain](#chain) may be [heart_pendant](#heart_pendant) instead.

entries.name: whistle_around_neck
entries.description: A [whistle](#whistle) on a cord or [lanyard](#lanyard) [hanging](#hanging) from the character's [neck](#neck), the mark of a PE [teacher](#teacher), [coach](#coach), [lifeguard](#lifeguard) or [referee](#referee).

entries.name: magatama_necklace
entries.description: A cord or [chain](#chain) hung with one or more [magatama](#magatama), the comma-shaped [beads](#beads) of [old](#old) Japanese ornament, drilled through the [fat](#fat) end. Usually given to [shrine](#shrine) [dress](#dress) and to characters with a Shinto flavour.

entries.name: carrot_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) hung with a carrot-shaped [pendant](#pendant), generally a single orange charm on a short cord. A [signature](#signature) accessory of [rabbit](#rabbit) girls.

entries.name: star_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) with a star-shaped [pendant](#pendant) or charm [hanging](#hanging) from it.

entries.name: key_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) whose [pendant](#pendant) is a [key](#key), hung on a [chain](#chain) or a cord. It counts as both a key and a necklace.

entries.name: tooth_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) strung with [teeth](#teeth) or [fangs](#fangs), a look typical of [tribal](#tribal) warriors and rugged adventurers.

entries.name: flower_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) strung from real blossoms, as with a [lei](#lei), or worked with [flower](#flower) motifs in metal and stone. It hangs at the chest rather than [sitting](#sitting) at the throat.

entries.name: multiple_necklaces
entries.description: Several necklaces layered around one [neck](#neck), usually chains of differing length [hanging](#hanging) one below another. They may be a matched set or an unrelated mix.

entries.name: anchor_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) whose [pendant](#pendant) is a small [anchor](#anchor). An anchor on a close-fitting band at the throat is [anchor_choker](#anchor_choker) instead.

entries.name: amulet
entries.description: A protective charm worn at the throat, usually hung from a [necklace](#necklace). Its charm-like shape is what sets it apart from a purely decorative [pendant](#pendant).

entries.name: medallion
entries.description: A medal-shaped piece of [jewelry](#jewelry) worn as a [pendant](#pendant) on a [chain](#chain) or cord, purely decorative rather than earned as an award.

entries.name: shell_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) strung with one or more shells, typical of [beach](#beach) outfits and [mermaid](#mermaid) designs. Implies necklace and [shell](#shell).

entries.name: heart_pendant
entries.description: A [pendant](#pendant) formed as a [heart](#heart), [hanging](#hanging) from a [chain](#chain) or a cord. When the [necklace](#necklace) as a whole is the point, [heart_necklace](#heart_necklace) applies too.

entries.name: skull_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) strung with skulls or skull-shaped [beads](#beads), the mundamala of Kali and similar figures. Tag beside necklace.

entries.name: crescent_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) hung with a [crescent](#crescent) [moon](#moon) [pendant](#pendant), at the throat or lower on the chest. Frequently paired with star and night-sky motifs.

entries.name: pendant_watch
entries.description: A [watch](#watch) carried on a [chain](#chain) around the [neck](#neck). It is nearly indistinguishable from a [pocket](#pocket) watch, so use it only where the chain is clearly fastened at the neck.

entries.name: ring_necklace
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) threaded onto a [chain](#chain) or cord and worn around the [neck](#neck) instead of on a finger. Frequently used to signal a keepsake or an absent partner.

entries.name: unworn_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) appears in the picture without being around anybody's [neck](#neck), [coiled](#coiled) on a surface, held up or [hanging](#hanging) from a [hook](#hook).

entries.name: lei
entries.description: The Hawaiian garland of blossoms looped over the [neck](#neck), or a close variation on it. It marks luau, holiday and [tropical](#tropical) scenes.

entries.name: bone_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) strung with bones, [teeth](#teeth) or [claws](#claws), worn by [tribal](#tribal), feral and shamanic characters. Hide and fur clothing tends to come with it.

entries.name: silver_necklace
entries.description: A [chain](#chain) or [pendant](#pendant) worn at the throat in silver or a similar pale metal. Length varies from a short chain to a piece [hanging](#hanging) over the chest.

entries.name: locket
entries.description: A [pendant](#pendant) that opens on a hinge to reveal a small [portrait](#portrait), or a pair of them, inside. Worn on a [chain](#chain) to keep somebody close; do not confuse it with a [lock](#lock), which fastens things shut.

entries.name: yaopei
entries.description: Traditional Chinese ornaments suspended from the [sash](#sash) or waist of [hanfu](#hanfu): jade discs, carved pendants, strings of [beads](#beads) and long tassels. They [swing](#swing) at hip level and range from a single small piece to an elaborate assembly.

entries.name: feather_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) hung with one or several [feathers](#feathers) as its pendants. Frequent on [tribal](#tribal), shamanic and bohemian designs.

entries.name: butterfly_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) whose [pendant](#pendant) takes the shape of a [butterfly](#butterfly), [hanging](#hanging) at the throat or lower on the chest. The [chain](#chain) itself is ordinary; the charm is what names it.

entries.name: cross_pendant
entries.description: A [cross](#cross) [hanging](#hanging) from a cord or [chain](#chain) worn at the [neck](#neck). Depending on the character it reads as a statement of faith or as [plain](#plain) jewellery.

entries.name: ankh_necklace
entries.description: A looped Egyptian [cross](#cross) hung from a [chain](#chain) or cord at the throat. Egyptian-themed designs use it, as do goth and occult outfits.

entries.name: diamond_necklace
entries.description: A [chain](#chain) hung with diamonds or diamond-cut stones, worn at the throat or lower on the chest. Formal and [evening](#evening) jewellery, and often the centrepiece of an outfit.

entries.name: changmingsuo
entries.description: A Chinese longevity [lock](#lock): a flat silver ornament shaped like a [padlock](#padlock), hung round a child's [neck](#neck) to ward off misfortune. Large ones are the centrepiece of Miao silver work.

entries.name: crystal_necklace
entries.description: A [crystal](#crystal) or raw gemstone hung on a [chain](#chain) or cord at the [neck](#neck). Reads as jewellery or as a magical focus depending on the setting.

entries.name: bullet_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) strung with one or more cartridges as its [pendant](#pendant), worn against the chest.

entries.name: rope_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) made of twisted cord or braided [rope](#rope) rather than metal [chain](#chain). Often worn with pendants in nautical or rustic outfits.

entries.name: snowflake_pendant
entries.description: A snowflake-shaped charm [hanging](#hanging) from a [chain](#chain) or cord at the throat, frequently rendered in silver or a clear stone to read as [ice](#ice).

entries.name: pentagram_necklace
entries.description: A [necklace](#necklace) hung with a five-pointed star, usually set inside a [circle](#circle). It reads as occult or witchy [dress](#dress).

entries.name: bracelet
entries.description: A band, [chain](#chain) or [string](#string) of [beads](#beads) worn round the wrist as decoration, in metal, [leather](#leather), [cloth](#cloth) or plastic. Add [jewelry](#jewelry); a stiff armoured band is [bracer](#bracer), and a [fabric](#fabric) or sport one is [wristband](#wristband) or [wrist_cuffs](#wrist_cuffs).

entries.name: ring
entries.description: A band of metal worn on a finger, [plain](#plain) or set with a stone. Covers [wedding](#wedding) rings and signet rings alike.

entries.name: armlet
entries.description: A decorative band, usually metal and sometimes set with stones, worn around the upper arm. A [bracelet](#bracelet) sits at the wrist and a [cloth](#cloth) band is an [armband](#armband).

entries.name: anklet
entries.description: A bracelet-like piece of [jewelry](#jewelry) worn round the ankle, usually a fine [chain](#chain) or a slim [bangle](#bangle). A [plain](#plain) [strap](#strap) or [ribbon](#ribbon) in the same place is [ankle_strap](#ankle_strap) or [ankle_ribbon](#ankle_ribbon).

entries.name: bangle
entries.description: A stiff [ring](#ring) of metal, wood or plastic slipped over the wrist, often worn several at a time. It counts as a [bracelet](#bracelet), but a [flexible](#flexible) [chain](#chain) or strung [beads](#beads) does not count as a bangle.

entries.name: wedding_ring
entries.description: A band worn on the [ring](#ring) finger of the left hand, or a ring otherwise clearly meant as one, including a proposal ring. Add [ornate_ring](#ornate_ring) if it carries gemstones.

entries.name: thighlet
entries.description: A metal band, usually [gold](#gold) or silver, worn around the thigh as [jewelry](#jewelry). A [fabric](#fabric) or [leather](#leather) band is [thigh_strap](#thigh_strap), and a frilly elastic one is [bridal_garter](#bridal_garter).

entries.name: lower_leg_bracelet
entries.description: A band or [chain](#chain) worn as ornament around the calf, [sitting](#sitting) [well](#well) above the ankle. An ornament at the ankle itself is an [anklet](#anklet).

entries.name: multiple_rings
entries.description: A character wearing several finger rings at once, on one hand or across both. Common on flashy or wealthy designs; a single band uses [ring](#ring) by itself.

entries.name: upper_leg_bracelet
entries.description: A band of jewellery worn around the thigh rather than the ankle or wrist, often a [chain](#chain) or metal [ring](#ring). Common on dancers, [fantasy](#fantasy) outfits and swimwear looks.

entries.name: spiked_bracelet
entries.description: A wrist [bracelet](#bracelet) [studded](#studded) with [spikes](#spikes), a [staple](#staple) of [punk](#punk) [fashion](#fashion) and of certain fighter designs such as Chun-Li's. Tag each visible [spiked](#spiked) band.

entries.name: bead_bracelet
entries.description: Beads strung on a cord and looped around the wrist, from a [plain](#plain) wooden prayer strand to a bright craft piece.

entries.name: gold_bracelet
entries.description: A [bracelet](#bracelet) of [gold](#gold) or gold-coloured metal at the wrist, as a solid [bangle](#bangle), a linked [chain](#chain) or a [plain](#plain) band.

entries.name: ankle_cuffs
entries.description: Decorative [cuffs](#cuffs) worn round the ankles, the lower half of the set that gives a bunny [suit](#suit) its [wrist_cuffs](#wrist_cuffs). Not the same as ankle garters, and metal [restraints](#restraints) belong to [shackles](#shackles).

entries.name: ankle_ribbon
entries.description: A decorative [ribbon](#ribbon) tied round one or both ankles, [sitting](#sitting) much where an [anklet](#anklet) would. Tag the colour of the ribbon as [well](#well).

entries.name: thumb_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) worn on the thumb rather than another finger. Often seen on archers or worn as a [fashion](#fashion) accessory.

entries.name: gold_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) of [gold](#gold) worn on a finger, [wedding](#wedding) bands included. It may be a [plain](#plain) band or carry a stone, and a hand raised to show it off is the usual framing.

entries.name: pearl_bracelet
entries.description: A [bracelet](#bracelet) strung from pearls and worn at the wrist. Often part of a set with [pearl_necklace](#pearl_necklace) or [pearl_earrings](#pearl_earrings).

entries.name: multiple_bracelets
entries.description: A character wearing several bracelets, stacked up one wrist or [split](#split) between both arms. Bangles, beaded bands and [cuffs](#cuffs) all count toward the total.

entries.name: spiked_armlet
entries.description: A band worn around the upper arm that carries one or more [spikes](#spikes). A punk-styled variant of the ordinary [armlet](#armlet).

entries.name: claw_ring
entries.description: A long pointed [ring](#ring) shaped like an [animal](#animal) claw, sheathing the finger to the first or second knuckle and sometimes jointed. It also covers the nail guards worn with Ming and Qing dynasty [dress](#dress).

entries.name: gold_armlet
entries.description: A [gold](#gold) [ring](#ring) or cuff [sitting](#sitting) high on the upper arm rather than at the wrist. Ancient, divine and [fantasy](#fantasy) [costume](#costume) lean on it heavily.

entries.name: middle_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) worn specifically on the middle finger, noted apart from bands worn on other fingers. Often a [plain](#plain) band or a large statement piece rather than a [wedding](#wedding) ring.

entries.name: toe_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) worn on a toe instead of a finger. Often paired with [barefoot](#barefoot) or [sandals](#sandals).

entries.name: flower_bracelet
entries.description: A [bracelet](#bracelet) made of flowers, or [carrying](#carrying) one as its decoration, worn at the wrist. A [ring](#ring) of blooms around the [neck](#neck) is a [flower](#flower) [necklace](#necklace) instead.

entries.name: studded_bracelet
entries.description: A [wristband](#wristband) or [bracelet](#bracelet) set with rows of metal [studs](#studs). Implies bracelet.

entries.name: ornate_ring
entries.description: A finger [ring](#ring) bearing a gemstone, engraving or other decoration rather than being a [plain](#plain) band.

entries.name: legband
entries.description: A [plain](#plain) band worn round the thigh or calf, the leg's answer to an [armband](#armband), with [no](#no) [buckle](#buckle) or [hanging](#hanging) [strap](#strap). Use [garter_straps](#garter_straps) or [leg_belt](#leg_belt) for those.

entries.name: barefoot_sandals_(jewelry)
entries.description: Foot [jewelry](#jewelry) shaped like a sandal that has [no](#no) sole at all, typically an [anklet](#anklet) linked to a toe [ring](#ring) by a [chain](#chain) across the instep. Also called a foot chain; do not confuse it with stirrup legwear or with [sandals](#sandals) worn without [socks](#socks).

entries.name: gold_thighlet
entries.description: An ornamental [gold](#gold) band circling the thigh, worn on bare skin or over legwear. Dancers, warriors and [fantasy](#fantasy) costumes wear them, often as a pair.

entries.name: unworn_jewelry
entries.description: Any piece of jewellery is visible in the picture without being worn: rings, bracelets, chains or gems spread on a surface, held out or [spilling](#spilling) from a [box](#box).

entries.name: wrist_belt
entries.description: A narrow [belt](#belt) with a [buckle](#buckle) worn around the wrist in place of an ordinary [bracelet](#bracelet). The buckle and its [punched](#punched) holes are what set it apart from a [plain](#plain) band.

entries.name: ankle_garter
entries.description: A frilled elastic band [sitting](#sitting) round the ankle, [holding](#holding) nothing up and worn purely for looks. Plainer, stiffer [ankle_cuffs](#ankle_cuffs) are a separate thing and should not be [confused](#confused) with it.

entries.name: ankleband
entries.description: A [plain](#plain) band round the ankle, in [cloth](#cloth) or [leather](#leather) rather than [chain](#chain) or metal. Simpler than an [anklet](#anklet), and a common finish on [barefoot](#barefoot) or [tribal](#tribal) designs.

entries.name: puppet_rings
entries.description: Metal bands worn along the fingers for [working](#working) a [marionette](#marionette), usually a full set on one or both hands. Strings may run visibly from them, or be left undrawn entirely.

entries.name: spiked_anklet
entries.description: A band around the ankle set with [studs](#studs) or points. Reads as [punk](#punk) or metal styling, and often [matches](#matches) a [collar](#collar) and [cuffs](#cuffs) worn elsewhere.

entries.name: gold_anklet
entries.description: A [gold](#gold) band or fine [chain](#chain) circling the ankle, sometimes hung with small bells. Dancers, princesses and costumes drawing on Middle Eastern [dress](#dress) wear them.

entries.name: pinky_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) worn on the little finger rather than any other. Which finger it sits on is the whole of the distinction.

entries.name: silver_bracelet
entries.description: A band or [chain](#chain) worn around the wrist in a grey, silvery metal. Sits at the wrist proper rather than higher on the arm.

entries.name: bead_anklet
entries.description: A [string](#string) of [beads](#beads) worn around the ankle on cord or elastic. It usually goes with bare [feet](#feet) or [sandals](#sandals).

entries.name: chain_bracelet
entries.description: A wrist ornament built from metal links instead of formed as a solid band. Where the [chain](#chain) carries on to a [ring](#ring) on the finger, hand chains covers that arrangement.

entries.name: ankle_bell
entries.description: A small [bell](#bell) worn at the ankle, threaded onto an [anklet](#anklet) or tied on with cord or [ribbon](#ribbon). Dancers, [shrine](#shrine) maidens and pet-play designs all wear them.

entries.name: star_bracelet
entries.description: A [bracelet](#bracelet) hung with star charms or set with star-shaped ornaments along the band. Common on [idol](#idol) and magical-girl outfits.

entries.name: spiked_thighlet
entries.description: A band worn high on the thigh and set with [spikes](#spikes), the leg counterpart to a [spiked](#spiked) [armband](#armband). Usually worn as a matching pair.

entries.name: ankle_scrunchie
entries.description: A gathered [fabric](#fabric) [ring](#ring), the sort meant for [tying](#tying) hair, worn round the ankle instead. Unlike an ankle garter it is a [plain](#plain) bunched band with [no](#no) frill.

entries.name: fur_bracelet
entries.description: A band of fur worn at the wrist. Fantasy designs often pair it with a matching [collar](#collar) or [armlet](#armlet).

entries.name: ankle_flower
entries.description: A blossom, real or artificial, fixed to a band worn round the ankle. Summer, [tropical](#tropical) and [wedding](#wedding) designs favour it.

entries.name: flower_ring
entries.description: A finger [ring](#ring) whose setting takes the shape of a blossom, or one plaited from real stems in the [field](#field). Jewelled versions and [daisy](#daisy) chains both count.

entries.name: frilled_bracelet
entries.description: A wrist band built from gathered [fabric](#fabric) instead of metal, [beads](#beads) or [leather](#leather). It normally [matches](#matches) a frilly [dress](#dress), [maid](#maid) outfit or lolita coordinate rather than [standing](#standing) alone as [jewelry](#jewelry).

entries.name: single_ankle_cuff
entries.description: One band fastened around an ankle while the other leg wears nothing. Reads as decoration on [fantasy](#fantasy) and [dancer](#dancer) outfits, and as a leftover restraint in other contexts.

entries.name: leglet
entries.description: An ornamental band around the leg, usually high on the thigh, made of metal and sometimes set with stones. Worn as low as the calf it still counts; at the ankle it becomes an [anklet](#anklet).

entries.name: snake_armband
entries.description: A band worn around the upper arm shaped as a [snake](#snake) coiling about the limb, usually in [gold](#gold) or silver. It carries [strong](#strong) Egyptian and classical associations.

entries.name: pearl_anklet
entries.description: A strand of pearls fastened round the ankle, single or looped several times. A delicate, formal counterpart to a [chain](#chain) or beaded [anklet](#anklet).

entries.name: skull_ring
entries.description: A finger [ring](#ring) whose face is carved or [cast](#cast) as a [skull](#skull). Heavy metal styling, common on rockers and rogues.

entries.name: butterfly_ring
entries.description: A finger [ring](#ring) with a [butterfly](#butterfly) worked into its setting, the [wings](#wings) [spreading](#spreading) across the knuckle. Usually the only decoration the ring carries.

entries.name: finger_ribbon
entries.description: A [ribbon](#ribbon) tied around a finger, worn as ornament or knotted there as a reminder. It sometimes carries on to a second person, [tying](#tying) two hands together.

entries.name: flower_anklet
entries.description: A band around the ankle [carrying](#carrying) a [flower](#flower) or a flower-shaped charm. It goes with [beach](#beach), [festival](#festival) and [summer](#summer) outfits.

entries.name: jewelry
entries.description: Any decorative piece worn on the body, made of metal, gemstones, [shell](#shell) or [beads](#beads): [earrings](#earrings), necklaces, rings, bracelets and the rest. It is the [umbrella](#umbrella) [tag](#tag), so add the specific piece as [well](#well).

entries.name: brooch
entries.description: A decorative [pin](#pin) or [clasp](#clasp), frequently set with a stone, fastened at a [collar](#collar), on a [scarf](#scarf), at a cloak's shoulder or down the front of a [dress](#dress). Add [jewelry](#jewelry); a [plain](#plain) functional pin [badge](#badge) is badge.

entries.name: beads
entries.description: Small pierced pieces of [glass](#glass), stone, wood or plastic, threaded together or sewn onto [fabric](#fabric). They turn up in jewellery, rosaries and hair [decorations](#decorations), or loose; add the specific item such as [bead_necklace](#bead_necklace) or [prayer_beads](#prayer_beads).

entries.name: forehead_jewel
entries.description: A [gem](#gem) fixed to the middle of the [forehead](#forehead), or to the forehead of a [mask](#mask), in the manner of a [bindi](#bindi). Fantasy royalty and [dancer](#dancer) designs wear it often.

entries.name: chest_jewel
entries.description: A [gem](#gem) set into or [resting](#resting) on the chest, generally at the upper sternum, belonging to the [costume](#costume) or the body rather than [hanging](#hanging) from a [chain](#chain). Core crystals in certain [fantasy](#fantasy) games made the feature [familiar](#familiar).

entries.name: heart_brooch
entries.description: A [brooch](#brooch) shaped as a [heart](#heart) or [carrying](#carrying) one, [pinned](#pinned) at a [collar](#collar), a [ribbon](#ribbon) or the chest.

entries.name: tie_clip
entries.description: A small metal bar or [pin](#pin) fastening a [necktie](#necktie) to the [shirt](#shirt) front. Mostly functional, but decorative ones count as [jewelry](#jewelry); add necktie.

entries.name: crescent_pin
entries.description: A [pin](#pin) or [brooch](#brooch) shaped like a [crescent](#crescent), fastened to clothing. A recurring element of several lunar and naval-themed outfits.

entries.name: lots_of_jewelry
entries.description: The [figure](#figure) is loaded with rings, chains, bangles and [earrings](#earrings) all at once, so that the sheer quantity of ornament becomes part of the design. It suits regal, wealthy or deliberately gaudy characters.

entries.name: belly_chain
entries.description: A jewellery [chain](#chain) worn round the waist, also called a waist chain. It is closely tied to [belly](#belly) dancers and often forms part of a [harem](#harem) outfit.

entries.name: flower_ornament
entries.description: A [flower](#flower) worn as an accessory anywhere on the person. Reach for the narrower [tag](#tag) when one exists: [hair_flower](#hair_flower), [flower_earrings](#flower_earrings), [flower_necklace](#flower_necklace), [corsage](#corsage), [boutonniere](#boutonniere), [head_wreath](#head_wreath) or [lei](#lei).

entries.name: blue_brooch
entries.description: A blue [brooch](#brooch) [pinned](#pinned) at the [collar](#collar), on the chest or onto a [ribbon](#ribbon). A sapphire-like stone in a metal setting is the usual form.

entries.name: lapel_pin
entries.description: A small [pin](#pin) fixed to the lapel of a [jacket](#jacket) or [blazer](#blazer), either as decoration or to show membership of something. Larger emblems take a [badge](#badge) [tag](#tag).

entries.name: star_brooch
entries.description: A [brooch](#brooch) shaped like, or decorated with, a star and [pinned](#pinned) to clothing.

entries.name: flower_brooch
entries.description: A [brooch](#brooch) shaped like a [flower](#flower) or decorated with one, [pinned](#pinned) at a [collar](#collar), a lapel or a [ribbon](#ribbon). A real [bloom](#bloom) pinned to clothing is a [corsage](#corsage) rather than this.

entries.name: jewel_under_eye
entries.description: One or more gems fixed to the skin just below an eye, usually over the cheekbone. It is a decorative accent [stuck](#stuck) or set on, not a mark or a [tattoo](#tattoo).

entries.name: head_chain
entries.description: A fine [chain](#chain) worn around the head in place of a band, [hanging](#hanging) loose and often set with gems. Thicker steel versions are [chain_headband](#chain_headband) or chain_hairband.

entries.name: nipple_jewelry
entries.description: Decorative pieces such as chains, gems or [dangling](#dangling) ornaments fixed at the [nipples](#nipples), usually through piercings but sometimes by sleeves or clips. A [plain](#plain) undecorated [piercing](#piercing) does not qualify.

entries.name: police_badge
entries.description: A metal [badge](#badge) identifying its wearer as a [police](#police) officer, [pinned](#pinned) to a uniform or held up. Tag police alongside it.

entries.name: wing_brooch
entries.description: A [brooch](#brooch) shaped like a wing, or one of another shape flanked by a pair of [wings](#wings). Tag brooch alongside it.

entries.name: red_brooch
entries.description: A [brooch](#brooch) set with a red stone or made from red material, [pinned](#pinned) at the [collar](#collar) or chest.

entries.name: butterfly_brooch
entries.description: A [brooch](#brooch) shaped as or decorated with a [butterfly](#butterfly), [pinned](#pinned) at the [collar](#collar), the chest or a [ribbon](#ribbon).

entries.name: corsage
