It often signals [otoko_no_ko](#otoko_no_ko) or [futanari](#futanari); where the [outline](#outline) is unmistakable use [covered_penis](#covered_penis), and add [erection_under_clothes](#erection_under_clothes) when it is hard.

entries.name: crotch_seam
entries.description: The [stitching](#stitching) at the [crotch](#crotch) of a garment drawn prominently: a vertical line in [pantyhose](#pantyhose), a horizontal one in [panties](#panties). A [cameltoe](#cameltoe) [can](#can) look similar but is the shape of the body showing through, not a seam.

entries.name: erection_under_clothes
entries.description: A stiff [penis](#penis) presses against trousers, [underwear](#underwear) or a [skirt](#skirt) so that its [outline](#outline) reads through the [cloth](#cloth). The penis itself is not uncovered.

entries.name: erection_in_panties
entries.description: An [erection](#erection) pushes against [panties](#panties), tenting the [fabric](#fabric) and printing its shape through it. The [underwear](#underwear) stays on and nothing is bared.

entries.name: see-through_shirt
entries.description: A [shirt](#shirt) of sheer material or rendered [transparent](#transparent), often by [water](#water), so the body or [underwear](#underwear) underneath shows through.

entries.name: see-through_sleeves
entries.description: Sleeves of sheer material that show the arms through them, either detached from the rest of the garment or made of a different [fabric](#fabric), as with raglan sleeves.

entries.name: asymmetrical_docking
entries.description: Two girls press their [breasts](#breasts) together with a visible mismatch, in size or in how they line up. The even version is [symmetrical_docking](#symmetrical_docking).

entries.name: bursting_breasts
entries.description: Breasts too large for the clothing over them, forcing a [blouse](#blouse) open between its [buttons](#buttons), popping fastenings loose or [spilling](#spilling) over a tight neckline. Wardrobe failures from any other cause, such as a [bikini](#bikini) top coming untied, are not this.

entries.name: see-through_cleavage
entries.description: A garment that would normally [cover](#cover) the chest carries a sheer panel over the [cleavage](#cleavage), showing it through the [fabric](#fabric).

entries.name: transparent_cleavage
entries.description: The line between the [breasts](#breasts) shows through sheer [fabric](#fabric) rather than through an actual [opening](#opening) in the garment. A subtler variant of ordinary [cleavage](#cleavage) that relies on the material rather than the cut.

entries.name: see-through_dress
entries.description: A [dress](#dress) made of sheer or [transparent](#transparent) material, or turned see-through by [water](#water).

entries.name: see-through_silhouette
entries.description: The [outline](#outline) of a body shows through a [translucent](#translucent) object, usually clothing or a curtain, with enough light behind it. For an entirely [transparent](#transparent) character, see [invisible_man](#invisible_man) instead.

entries.name: vibrator_under_clothes
entries.description: A [vibrator](#vibrator) hidden beneath clothing, commonly to conceal its use in public. If it is dildo-shaped, also [tag](#tag) [dildo_under_clothes](#dildo_under_clothes); a remote or [egg](#egg) unit may be stowed in [thighhighs](#thighhighs) or a thigh [strap](#strap).

entries.name: pantylines
entries.description: The [outline](#outline) of [panties](#panties) showing through tight clothing such as [leggings](#leggings), a [pencil](#pencil) [skirt](#skirt) or snug trousers. It does not apply where the panties are genuinely visible through sheer [fabric](#fabric) or [pantyhose](#pantyhose).

entries.name: see-through_legwear
entries.description: Very sheer stockings, [pantyhose](#pantyhose), or [thighhighs](#thighhighs) with little colour of their own, so the skin underneath shows through.

entries.name: rei_no_himo
entries.description: A chest [ribbon](#ribbon) that passes under the [breasts](#breasts) and ties to the upper arms, plainly there to hold them up rather than merely decorate. Also used for the same design on other characters and in parodies; a ribbon tied under the bust without supporting it does not qualify.

entries.name: see-through_skirt
entries.description: A [skirt](#skirt) of sheer or [transparent](#transparent) material, revealing the [legs](#legs) or [underwear](#underwear) beneath.

entries.name: see-through_leotard
entries.description: A [leotard](#leotard) sheer enough that the skin beneath it shows.

entries.name: breasts_on_glass
entries.description: Breasts are squashed against a pane of [glass](#glass), a [window](#window) or a [transparent](#transparent) [floor](#floor), usually seen from the far side. Add [against_glass](#against_glass) and [breast_press](#breast_press), plus [breasts_on_table](#breasts_on_table) when the surface is a glass tabletop.

entries.name: see-through_veil
entries.description: A [veil](#veil) thin enough that the face behind it reads clearly. Bridal veils are tagged separately rather than here.

entries.name: spread_pussy_under_clothes
entries.description: The [pussy](#pussy) is being held open beneath [panties](#panties) or other clothing so the [fabric](#fabric) shows its shape without exposing it directly. Add [spread_pussy](#spread_pussy) too if any part becomes visible.

entries.name: vibrator_under_panties
entries.description: A [vibrator](#vibrator) worn inside the [panties](#panties), often visible as a [bulge](#bulge) or cord. Typical of [bdsm](#bdsm) or public [exhibitionism](#exhibitionism) scenes; add [dildo_under_panties](#dildo_under_panties) if the [toy](#toy) is dildo-shaped.

entries.name: see-through_jacket
entries.description: A [jacket](#jacket) of [transparent](#transparent) or sheer material, such as a clear [raincoat](#raincoat) or a [mesh](#mesh) jacket.

entries.name: covered_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) whose shape [can](#can) clearly be made out under clothing such as tight trousers or swimwear. When only a shapeless lump shows, use [bulge](#bulge); when it is exposed, use penis.

entries.name: undersized_breast_cup
entries.description: The cups of a [bra](#bra), [leotard](#leotard) or bunny [suit](#suit) are far too small for the wearer, so the chest spills past them while the garment otherwise sits correctly. The point is the mismatch between garment and bust rather than a [wardrobe](#wardrobe) [failure](#failure); for swimwear cut this way, [micro_bikini](#micro_bikini) is the better [tag](#tag).

entries.name: covered_testicles
entries.description: Testicles whose shape shows distinctly under clothing. If the lump could be either [testicles](#testicles) or [penis](#penis), [bulge](#bulge) is the better [tag](#tag); bare ones take testicles.

entries.name: see-through_panties
entries.description: Panties of sheer [fabric](#fabric) that leave what they [cover](#cover) plainly visible. Lace or [mesh](#mesh) panels count when they sit over the [crotch](#crotch) rather than only trimming the edges.

entries.name: see-through_bodysuit
entries.description: A [bodysuit](#bodysuit) of thick but [transparent](#transparent) material covering [torso](#torso) and limbs, usually given a sheen so it reads as worn at all. A thin sheer version is [bodystocking](#bodystocking), and bare skin is easily mistaken for one.

entries.name: covered_clitoris
entries.description: Cloth or [tape](#tape) lies over the [clitoris](#clitoris), yet the small bump it raises [can](#can) still be picked out. It often comes with a [cameltoe](#cameltoe), and answers to the [bulge](#bulge) seen on men.

entries.name: see-through_sarong
entries.description: A sheer wrap knotted at the hip over a [swimsuit](#swimsuit), doing nothing to conceal the [legs](#legs) beneath.

entries.name: covered_anus
entries.description: The shape of the [anus](#anus) [can](#can) be made out under tight clothing rather than being bared. Skin-tight suits and leotards are the usual cause.

entries.name: covered_pussy
entries.description: The vulva's shape reads through close-fitting clothing while staying covered. Swimsuits, leotards and thin [underwear](#underwear) are the usual cause.

entries.name: see-through_one-piece_swimsuit
entries.description: A one-piece [swimsuit](#swimsuit) made of [transparent](#transparent) [fabric](#fabric), sometimes turning clear only once it is [wet](#wet).

entries.name: see-through_bikini
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) cut partly or wholly from [transparent](#transparent) [cloth](#cloth). Some versions only turn clear once the [fabric](#fabric) is soaked.

entries.name: covered_groin
entries.description: The contour of the [groin](#groin) [can](#can) be read through clothing, with nothing exposed. Tight trousers and swimwear produce it most often.

entries.name: see-through_thighhighs
entries.description: Thighhighs of sheer [fabric](#fabric), the skin tone showing through along the whole leg. Distinct from opaque stockings, which hide the leg completely.

entries.name: tucked_money
entries.description: Banknotes wedged into clothing or against the body, typically slipped into a waistband, a stocking or [cleavage](#cleavage). The [gesture](#gesture) recalls tipping a [stripper](#stripper) or performer.

entries.name: bursting_pectorals
entries.description: A man's chest defeating the outfit put on it: [fabric](#fabric) stretched drum-tight, muscle overhanging a neckline, or fastenings tearing free. Damage from anything but the [pectorals](#pectorals) falls outside the [tag](#tag).

entries.name: see-through_shawl
entries.description: A [shawl](#shawl) of gauzy, [transparent](#transparent) [cloth](#cloth) draped across the shoulders or looped over the arms.

entries.name: bursting_ass
entries.description: Clothing strained past its limit by buttocks too big for it, splitting at the [seams](#seams), [riding](#riding) up or looking about to give way. Torn [shorts](#shorts) alone do not qualify — the size of the rear has to be the visible cause.

entries.name: see-through_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) of sheer [fabric](#fabric) that does not hide what sits behind the cups.

entries.name: see-through_gloves
entries.description: Gloves of sheer [fabric](#fabric), the fingers and [back](#back) of the hand visible through them.

entries.name: see-through_dress_layer
entries.description: A layered [dress](#dress) with an extra [transparent](#transparent) layer [running](#running) over both [bodice](#bodice) and [skirt](#skirt). Where only the lower half carries the sheer layer, use [see-through_skirt_layer](#see-through_skirt_layer) instead.

entries.name: see-through_skirt_layer
entries.description: A layered [skirt](#skirt) [carrying](#carrying) one [transparent](#transparent) layer over the rest. If the sheer layer also runs up over the [bodice](#bodice) it becomes [see-through_dress_layer](#see-through_dress_layer) instead.

entries.name: panties_visible_through_clothes
entries.description: The [outline](#outline) or colour of [panties](#panties) reads through an outer garment thin enough to see into, with nothing lifted or removed. Strong light behind a [skirt](#skirt) or [dress](#dress) is the usual cause.

entries.name: see-through_raincoat
entries.description: A [raincoat](#raincoat) of clear vinyl, of the kind often paired with a [transparent](#transparent) [umbrella](#umbrella). Whatever is worn beneath shows in full, which explicit work exploits; a merely thin [poncho](#poncho) does not count.

entries.name: large_bulge
entries.description: A pronounced swelling of the genitals showing through clothing. It goes with heavily muscled and beastly designs, and may simply indicate a partial [erection](#erection).

entries.name: see-through_babydoll
entries.description: A short, loose nightdress in sheer [fabric](#fabric), [transparent](#transparent) from the bust down. The [bodice](#bodice) is usually more solid, so the transparency begins below the chest.

entries.name: wet_spot
entries.description: A damp [patch](#patch) showing through [fabric](#fabric), most often on [underwear](#underwear) or bedding, where fluid has soaked in. Read as evidence of arousal or of what has already happened.

entries.name: see-through_camisole
entries.description: A thin, strappy top cut from sheer [fabric](#fabric), worn as an outer layer rather than as [underwear](#underwear).

entries.name: tanline_peek
entries.description: A strip of untanned skin showing where clothing has slipped or been lifted, revealing where a [swimsuit](#swimsuit) normally sits. The [contrast](#contrast) between the pale band and the darker skin around it is the whole point.

entries.name: see-through_pants
entries.description: Trousers cut from sheer material, the [legs](#legs) readable through the [cloth](#cloth). Usually loose [harem](#harem) or wide-leg [shapes](#shapes) rather than anything close-fitting.

entries.name: see-through_coat
entries.description: A [coat](#coat) of sheer or clear material, letting whatever is worn under it show through.

entries.name: spread_anus_under_clothes
entries.description: Fingers hold the [anus](#anus) open while clothing still covers the area, either [reaching](#reaching) beneath the [fabric](#fabric) or showing its shape through it. Exposure implied without the garment coming off.

entries.name: see-through_headwear
entries.description: A [hat](#hat), [hood](#hood), or other head covering of [translucent](#translucent) or clear material, whatever colour it happens to be tinted.

entries.name: see-through_cape
entries.description: A [cape](#cape) of gauzy or fully [transparent](#transparent) material [hanging](#hanging) from the shoulders, leaving the [back](#back) and arms in view.

entries.name: unlikely_accident
entries.description: A [wardrobe](#wardrobe) mishap staged so improbably it could not plausibly happen by physics alone, inviting the viewer to wonder how it occurred. Known in Japanese as a happening, the joke rests entirely in its impossibility.

entries.name: purple_pasties
entries.description: Small purple adhesive covers [stuck](#stuck) over the [nipples](#nipples) with nothing else on the chest. They conceal the areola while leaving the rest of the breast bare.

entries.name: bulge_lift
entries.description: Clothing pushed up from beneath by an [erection](#erection) so the [fabric](#fabric) tents away from the body. Nothing is uncovered — the raised shape is the whole of it.

entries.name: towel_slip
entries.description: A [towel](#towel) wrapped around the body works loose and begins to [slide](#slide) down, with full exposure only a moment away. A classic wardrobe-malfunction moment rather than actual nudity.

entries.name: see-through_sports_bra
entries.description: A sports [bra](#bra) of sheer material, or an ordinary one gone [transparent](#transparent) with [sweat](#sweat) or [water](#water).

entries.name: see-through_midriff
entries.description: A sheer panel set across the [stomach](#stomach) of an otherwise opaque garment, frequently leaving the [navel](#navel) visible through it.

entries.name: see-through_capelet
entries.description: A short shoulder [cape](#cape) made of sheer [cloth](#cloth), ending somewhere around the upper arm. Its transparency leaves the shoulders and whatever is worn beneath it in view.

entries.name: see-through_shorts
entries.description: Shorts of sheer [fabric](#fabric), leaving the hips and upper [legs](#legs) in view along with whatever, if anything, is worn beneath them.

entries.name: see-through_bridal_gauntlets
entries.description: Long, fingerless arm coverings of sheer [cloth](#cloth), [running](#running) from the wrist up past the elbow.

entries.name: see-through_apron
entries.description: An [apron](#apron) cut from sheer or wholly [transparent](#transparent) [fabric](#fabric), so whatever sits behind it stays in view.

entries.name: vibrator_bulge
entries.description: Clothing pushed outward by a [vibrator](#vibrator) held against or seated inside the wearer. The [device](#device) itself stays hidden; only its shape presses through the [fabric](#fabric).

entries.name: bulge_peek
entries.description: A clothed [bulge](#bulge) showing at the edge of a garment, past a hem or over a waistband. The genitals stay covered and only their [outline](#outline) comes into view.

entries.name: erection_under_towel
entries.description: A [towel](#towel) wrapped round the hips is pushed up from beneath by an [erection](#erection), [giving](#giving) the shape without showing anything. A [bath](#bath) and hot-spring situation.

entries.name: panty_bulge
entries.description: The shape of a [penis](#penis) pressing out against the front of a pair of [panties](#panties). The wearer stays covered; the same [outline](#outline) under any other garment is [bulge](#bulge).

entries.name: penis
entries.description: A male sexual organ drawn exposed in the picture. Add the tags for its state, size, type and any censoring; hidden under clothing it is [bulge](#bulge) or [erection_under_clothes](#erection_under_clothes) instead.

entries.name: erection
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) drawn hard, [standing](#standing) up or out. Use it wherever a stiff penis is visible on any character; one showing only as a shape beneath clothing is [erection_under_clothes](#erection_under_clothes).

entries.name: large_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) above average for the character, [reaching](#reaching) about the [navel](#navel) when erect but not past the length of the forearm. Anything longer is [huge_penis](#huge_penis).

entries.name: veiny_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) drawn with prominent bulging [veins](#veins) along the shaft, a very common way of emphasising an [erection](#erection), nearly always paired with other genital detail tags.

entries.name: male_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair on a male character, usually above an exposed [penis](#penis). The female case has its own [tag](#tag), and [plain](#plain) [pubic_hair](#pubic_hair) covers either.

entries.name: huge_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) out of all proportion to the body, longer or thicker than the forearm but smaller than the [torso](#torso). Past torso size it becomes [gigantic_penis](#gigantic_penis); the [ladder](#ladder) runs small, large, huge, gigantic.

entries.name: looking_at_penis
entries.description: A character's gaze aimed straight at a [penis](#penis), typically without any dramatic reaction. It commonly accompanies [fellatio](#fellatio) and [handjob](#handjob) scenes.

entries.name: small_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) shorter than average for an adult, as a [guide](#guide) [no](#no) longer than the character's middle finger. Frequent on shota and [otoko_no_ko](#otoko_no_ko) characters; the scale runs to [large_penis](#large_penis) and [huge_penis](#huge_penis).

entries.name: foreskin
entries.description: The [penis](#penis) is uncircumcised and its foreskin is visible, whether sheathing the glans or drawn [back](#back) off it. Retracted foreskins are the norm in Japanese art, so a prominent one is the rarer case.

entries.name: disembodied_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) [hanging](#hanging) in [midair](#midair) with [no](#no) body behind it, [fading](#fading) out at the base or plainly detached, so no male [figure](#figure) has to be drawn at all. A partner simply [cropped](#cropped) out of frame does not qualify.

entries.name: animal_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) of [animal](#animal) form, canine with a knot, equine, feline and the rest, on whatever kind of character. Add the specific type where the shape is clear enough to name.

entries.name: flaccid
entries.description: A soft, non-erect [penis](#penis) [hanging](#hanging) rather than [standing](#standing). It covers a slack [bulge](#bulge) under clothing as [well](#well); the stiff state is [erection](#erection).

entries.name: horse_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) of equine shape, with a flared head and often a medial [ring](#ring), on an [animal](#animal), anthro or humanoid character. A subtype of [animal_penis](#animal_penis).

entries.name: penis_size_difference
entries.description: Two or more penises, or bulges, in one picture with one plainly larger than another, drawn for [comparison](#comparison) or for [humiliation](#humiliation).

entries.name: phimosis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) whose [foreskin](#foreskin) stays over the head even when erect, unable to draw [back](#back) fully. Tag it whenever the prepuce is drawn covering the glans during an [erection](#erection); the word also covers a clitoral [hood](#hood) that will not retract.

entries.name: dark_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) noticeably darker than the rest of the body, or clearly [dark](#dark) where [no](#no) body is attached to it. Men of every complexion tend to be darker there, and art often pushes the [contrast](#contrast) further.

entries.name: twitching_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) shown pulsing or jerking, marked by short lines around the shaft. Signals arousal, anticipation or an approaching climax.

entries.name: knotted_penis
entries.description: A canine-type [penis](#penis) with the bulbous swelling at its base that locks a mating pair together. When it is lodged inside a partner the act is [knotting](#knotting).

entries.name: medium_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) drawn at an ordinary, unexaggerated size, marking the middle point between [small_penis](#small_penis) and [large_penis](#large_penis). Used mainly to place proportion on that scale rather than to draw attention to it.

entries.name: girthy_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) whose shaft is as thick as its head or thicker. It describes width alone; length is covered by [large_penis](#large_penis) and [huge_penis](#huge_penis), and [veiny_penis](#veiny_penis) [can](#can) be added on top.

entries.name: smegma
entries.description: A pale, cloudy residue collecting beneath the [foreskin](#foreskin). Depictions play up its thickness and implied [smell](#smell), and it is usually paired with an uncut, unwashed [penis](#penis).

entries.name: dog_penis
entries.description: A canine [penis](#penis), recognisable by its pointed tip and the bulbous knot at the base, on an [animal](#animal) or on a character built with one.

entries.name: gigantic_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) so far out of proportion to its owner that it [matches](#matches) the [torso](#torso) in length or thickness. One step above [huge_penis](#huge_penis) on the scale that runs from small to gigantic.

entries.name: tucked_penis
entries.description: The [penis](#penis) and [testicles](#testicles) pushed [back](#back) between the [thighs](#thighs) so the [groin](#groin) reads as flat. Also covers a seated character whose genitals are simply hidden behind a [chair](#chair); genitals concealed inside clothing instead take [covered_penis](#covered_penis).

entries.name: half-erect
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) that is partly hard: it may be as thick as a full [erection](#erection) but does not stand up on its own. Distinct from [flaccid](#flaccid), which is fully soft and usually smaller.

entries.name: extra_penises
entries.description: One character with more than a single [penis](#penis), set side by side or stacked. Common on monsters and in hyper-styled art.

entries.name: penis_measuring
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) being measured, with a [ruler](#ruler) or a [tape](#tape), or against marks drawn on a partner's [belly](#belly) to show how far it would reach.

entries.name: spiked_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) bearing barbs, [studs](#studs), or keratin [spines](#spines), as seen on a number of real mammals. Drawn on feral, anthro, and [monster](#monster) characters to mark the [anatomy](#anatomy) as non-human.

entries.name: bouncing_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) swings or jolts with the body's movement, usually on a character being penetrated or moving hard. Animation or motion lines make the movement visible.

entries.name: sock_on_penis
entries.description: A sock pulled over an erect [penis](#penis), used as makeshift [cover](#cover) or played for a joke. The absurdity of the substitution is usually the whole point.

entries.name: penis_out_of_frame
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) takes part in the scene while its owner's hips fall outside the picture, so only the length inside the frame is drawn.

entries.name: penis_sheath
entries.description: A covering worn over the [penis](#penis) alone, whether a decorative case or a practical wrap.

entries.name: implied_erection
entries.description: An [erection](#erection) understood from context without the [penis](#penis) being drawn, kept out of sight by clothing, framing or something in the way. Posture and a partner's reaction usually settle the [reading](#reading).

entries.name: penis_chart
entries.description: A labelled [chart](#chart) setting several characters' penises side by side to compare their size, or how much they ejaculate, laid out like a reference sheet.

entries.name: no_penis
entries.description: A man's [crotch](#crotch) is in [plain](#plain) view but nothing has been drawn there, neither [penis](#penis) nor scrotum, leaving the area blank.

entries.name: morning_wood
entries.description: An [erection](#erection) a character has on waking or while still asleep, involuntary and normally still under the bedding. The tenting of the sheets is often all that is drawn.

entries.name: veiny_crotch
entries.description: Visible [veins](#veins) run across the [groin](#groin) and the skin around the genitals, emphasised as a mark of arousal or of very low body [fat](#fat).

entries.name: glowing_penis
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) that emits light rather than [catching](#catching) it. Alien, demonic and energy-bodied characters are drawn this way.

entries.name: penis_face
entries.description: A face drawn onto a [penis](#penis), either inked on within the scene or added as a cartoon flourish. Not the same as a penis [resting](#resting) against somebody's face.

entries.name: pussy
entries.description: The female genitals are visible: the vulva with its labia and [clitoris](#clitoris), or the [vaginal](#vaginal) [opening](#opening) itself. Covers any depiction, [censored](#censored) or not; add [uncensored](#uncensored), censored, or [spread_pussy](#spread_pussy) as it applies.

entries.name: pubic_hair
entries.description: Hair growing in the [crotch](#crotch) area, on a character of any [sex](#sex). Pair with [male_pubic_hair](#male_pubic_hair) or [female_pubic_hair](#female_pubic_hair) for which, and with [excessive_pubic_hair](#excessive_pubic_hair) when it grows especially thick; showing it usually pushes a picture into explicit territory.

entries.name: cleft_of_venus
entries.description: The vulva drawn as a simple closed slit between the outer labia. It stops applying once the inner labia show or the [pussy](#pussy) is spread; where only tight [fabric](#fabric) takes that shape it is [cameltoe](#cameltoe), and the two hold together only through see-through [cloth](#cloth).

entries.name: female_pubic_hair
entries.description: Visible pubic hair on a woman. Futanari characters count here as [well](#well), with or without a vulva, rather than under the male variant.

entries.name: spread_pussy
entries.description: The labia held open to reveal the [vaginal](#vaginal) [opening](#opening), whether by fingers or a [device](#device) such as a [speculum](#speculum). When [fabric](#fabric) hides it entirely, use [spread_pussy_under_clothes](#spread_pussy_under_clothes); openness with nothing [holding](#holding) it open is [gaping](#gaping) instead.

entries.name: clitoris
entries.description: The clitoris drawn at the top of the vulva as a small pink nub. A long [list](#list) of narrower tags covers its states and treatments, among them [clitoral_hood](#clitoral_hood), [erect_clitoris](#erect_clitoris) and [clitoris_piercing](#clitoris_piercing).

entries.name: partially_visible_vulva
entries.description: Underwear or other clothing narrow enough that the sides or rear of the vulva show past the [fabric](#fabric), often because it has ridden up into a [wedgie](#wedgie). Once the vulva is uncovered outright, [pussy](#pussy) covers it.

entries.name: fat_mons
entries.description: A prominent, puffy mound above the genitals where the pubic hair grows. Visible when bare or as a rounded [bulge](#bulge) under tight clothing.

entries.name: spreading_own_pussy
entries.description: A character holds her own labia open with her own fingers, a narrower case of [spread_pussy](#spread_pussy) where nobody else and [no](#no) [device](#device) does the [spreading](#spreading).

entries.name: pussy_peek
entries.description: Only a small portion of the vulva shows, [slipping](#slipping) into view past [panties](#panties), a [swimsuit](#swimsuit), or a hemline. Use [pussy](#pussy) instead once the genitals are fully exposed.

entries.name: uterus
entries.description: The womb drawn in the picture, usually shown as a [cross-section](#cross-section) or [x-ray](#x-ray) view during [sex](#sex), or worked into a womb-tattoo motif. Also appears in pregnancy scenes.

entries.name: clitoral_hood
entries.description: The fold of skin covering the [clitoris](#clitoris), drawn as a distinct feature of the vulva. Used where it is actually rendered rather than merely implied.

entries.name: stray_pubic_hair
entries.description: A single loose pubic hair [resting](#resting) somewhere on a character's body, most often [stuck](#stuck) to the face or [lips](#lips). It usually signals that rough [fellatio](#fellatio) just took place.

entries.name: colored_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair in an unnatural colour such as pink, green or white. Natural black or brown does not count, nor does hair too faint to notice, and where it merely differs from the head hair use [mismatched_pubic_hair](#mismatched_pubic_hair).

entries.name: no_pussy
entries.description: A woman's [crotch](#crotch) is shown bare with [no](#no) vulva drawn, smooth in the manner of a [doll](#doll). It is normally an omission rather than a stated design.

entries.name: urethra
entries.description: The small urinary [opening](#opening) drawn visibly, almost always on a vulva above the [vaginal](#vaginal) [entrance](#entrance) in a [close-up](#close-up) view. Rarely tagged when drawn on a [penis](#penis) instead.

entries.name: ovum
entries.description: An [egg](#egg) cell shown in the picture, usually inside a cutaway or see-through view of the womb during an [impregnation](#impregnation) scene, sometimes with sperm closing in on it.

entries.name: cervix
entries.description: The mouth of the [uterus](#uterus) at the far end of the vagina is visible. It shows up in [cross-section](#cross-section) and [x-ray](#x-ray) views of penetration or of spread genitals.

entries.name: fertilization
entries.description: A cutaway shows sperm cells [reaching](#reaching) and entering an [egg](#egg). Impregnation belongs beside it; two egg cells meeting instead is [female_fertilization](#female_fertilization).

entries.name: black_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair drawn black, generally matching a [dark](#dark) head of hair. Use it only where the hair itself is visible, together with [pubic_hair](#pubic_hair).

entries.name: sparse_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair drawn thin, wispy, or trimmed down to a small area, [well](#well) short of a natural full growth. Sits at the opposite end of the scale from [excessive_pubic_hair](#excessive_pubic_hair).

entries.name: presenting_own_pussy
entries.description: The character opens or angles her own vulva toward the viewer, fingers often [holding](#holding) it spread. Done unaided, unlike [presenting_another](#presenting_another).

entries.name: blonde_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair in blonde, usually on a character whose head hair [matches](#matches). Use it only where the hair is actually drawn, together with [pubic_hair](#pubic_hair).

entries.name: mismatched_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair colored differently from the hair on the head - the [carpet](#carpet) not matching the [curtains](#curtains).

entries.name: excessive_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair unusually thick, bushy or untended, sometimes escaping from under a [swimsuit](#swimsuit) or [panties](#panties). Hair [running](#running) up towards the [navel](#navel) is [navel_hair](#navel_hair); the sparse opposite is [sparse_pubic_hair](#sparse_pubic_hair).

entries.name: erect_clitoris
entries.description: The [clitoris](#clitoris) drawn stiffened and [standing](#standing) out, the counterpart of an [erection](#erection). What is shown ranges from a small nub to a pronounced protrusion.

entries.name: long_labia
entries.description: Labia drawn noticeably long or protruding, whether naturally so or because they are being pulled. A closed slit with nothing showing is [cleft_of_venus](#cleft_of_venus) instead.

entries.name: half-spread_pussy
entries.description: Only one side of the vulva is being pulled open while the other lies at rest. Not for a vulva held from one side but spread fully; that is [plain](#plain) [spread_pussy](#spread_pussy).

entries.name: presenting_pussy
entries.description: A character deliberately displays their vulva to the viewer or a partner, often with [legs](#legs) spread or fingers [pulling](#pulling) it open. Tag [pussy](#pussy) and [presenting](#presenting); [spread_pussy](#spread_pussy) applies when it is held open.

entries.name: spreading_another's_pussy
entries.description: One character uses their fingers to hold open a second character's labia, rather than that person [spreading](#spreading) themselves.

entries.name: pubic_stubble
entries.description: Short regrowth in the pubic area showing that the hair was recently shaved. Needs visible [stubble](#stubble); a smoothly bare [crotch](#crotch) with [no](#no) texture does not qualify.

entries.name: white_pubic_hair
entries.description: Hair in the pubic region drawn white, usually matching a white-haired character. Applies only when the area is actually shown; combine it with [pubic_hair](#pubic_hair).

entries.name: blue_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair drawn blue, as a rule matching blue hair on the head. The [groin](#groin) has to be bare enough for it to be visible at all.

entries.name: red_pubic_hair
entries.description: Ginger or auburn hair at the [groin](#groin), usually drawn to match red hair on the head. Only visible where the area is uncovered.

entries.name: purple_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair drawn in purple, generally matching the character's head hair. A colour detail rather than a statement about grooming.

entries.name: hymen
entries.description: The thin membrane at the [entrance](#entrance) of the vagina, drawn either whole or [torn](#torn) and [bleeding](#bleeding) to mark a first time. Pictures treat an unbroken one as proof of virginity, which real [anatomy](#anatomy) does not support.

entries.name: ovaries
entries.description: The pair of [organs](#organs) that make [egg](#egg) cells, joined to the womb by the fallopian tubes. Almost always drawn in an anatomical cutaway or see-through view of the [belly](#belly), usually in impregnation-themed work.

entries.name: brown_pubic_hair
entries.description: Brown hair at the [crotch](#crotch), visible wherever nothing covers it. The [shade](#shade) normally follows the character's head hair.

entries.name: mole_on_pussy
entries.description: A beauty spot on or immediately beside the vulva, which means the area has to be uncovered for it to be seen. One of the [mole](#mole) placements that lands on intimate [anatomy](#anatomy).

entries.name: green_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair coloured green, as a rule matching green hair on the head. The area must actually be visible rather than merely suggested.

entries.name: dark_labia
entries.description: Labia coloured markedly darker than the skin around them, [running](#running) brown to black. Set deliberately against the pink shades that stand for youth, and used only where the vulva is fully in view.

entries.name: pink_pubic_hair
entries.description: Hair at the [groin](#groin) coloured pink, generally matching a pink head of hair. Visible only where the area is bare.

entries.name: shaped_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair trimmed into a deliberate [figure](#figure), a [heart](#heart) or a star for instance, rather than left as a [plain](#plain) [patch](#patch) or strip.

entries.name: grey_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair coloured grey, generally matching silver or grey hair on the head. It implies nothing about age; most characters wearing it simply have grey hair.

entries.name: mons_pubis
entries.description: The padded swell of [flesh](#flesh) above the vulva, over the pubic [bone](#bone), which fills out at puberty and is where pubic hair grows. Drawn as a soft mound whether shaved or not.

entries.name: fallopian_tubes
entries.description: The pair of tubes [running](#running) from the [ovaries](#ovaries) to the womb, shown in a cutaway or a [diagram](#diagram) of the reproductive tract.

entries.name: colored_pussy
entries.description: A vulva drawn in an unusual colour instead of a natural skin tone. Common on monsters, slimes and other non-human bodies.

entries.name: orange_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair in a ginger or orange [shade](#shade), usually chosen to match the hair on the head. Visible only where the [crotch](#crotch) is uncovered.

entries.name: heart-shaped_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair trimmed to a [heart](#heart) [outline](#outline) above the [crotch](#crotch), a groomed shape rather than natural growth.

entries.name: vaginal_prolapse
entries.description: Inner [tissue](#tissue) of the vagina or [uterus](#uterus) has slipped down and out of the body, in extreme depictions [hanging](#hanging) entirely outside it. Compare [anal_prolapse](#anal_prolapse) for the equivalent condition at the rear.

entries.name: looking_at_pussy
entries.description: The eyes are on an exposed vulva, a partner's or the character's own. It records where the gaze goes rather than any act being performed.

entries.name: huge_clitoris
entries.description: The [clitoris](#clitoris) is drawn far larger than usual, sometimes resembling a small erect [penis](#penis). Testosterone produces this in life, which some pictures reference directly.

entries.name: cloaca
entries.description: A single vent [serving](#serving) as both genital and excretory [opening](#opening), as birds, reptiles and amphibians have, drawn on a feral or anthro character. Not for ordinary human-style genitals or for a [penis](#penis) [sheath](#sheath).

entries.name: blue_pussy
entries.description: Female genitals coloured blue rather than any [flesh](#flesh) tone, typical of aliens, monsters and blue-skinned characters. It states the colour of [anatomy](#anatomy) that is on show.

entries.name: pussy_press
entries.description: The vulva is pushed against a surface or object, flattening or splaying the outer labia depending on the direction of the pressure. Common when a character grinds against [glass](#glass), a [table](#table) edge, or a partner's tip.

entries.name: female_fertilization
entries.description: Two [egg](#egg) cells are drawn meeting and joining, usually as an internal cutaway during [tribadism](#tribadism). A pure [fantasy](#fantasy) conceit with [no](#no) real counterpart.

entries.name: aqua_pubic_hair
entries.description: Hair at the [groin](#groin) in a blue-green [shade](#shade), normally matching an unnatural head colour. Only the colour is recorded here.

entries.name: shaving_crotch
entries.description: Pubic hair being removed with a [razor](#razor) and lather at the [groin](#groin). Marks the act of [shaving](#shaving) itself rather than the bare result. Implies shaving.

entries.name: yellow_pubic_hair
entries.description: Pubic hair of a yellow [shade](#shade), matching bright blonde or unnaturally yellow head hair.

entries.name: anus
entries.description: The anus is visible in the picture. Where only its edge shows past [underwear](#underwear) use [anus_peek](#anus_peek), and add the relevant censoring [tag](#tag) when a bar or mosaic covers it.

entries.name: spread_anus
entries.description: The [anus](#anus) held open wide, usually by hand, exposing the rectal [opening](#opening). Different from [gaping](#gaping), where it stays open without anything [holding](#holding) it.

entries.name: spread_ass
entries.description: The buttocks pulled apart, by the character's own hands or someone else's, to reveal the [anus](#anus). Add [spread_anus](#spread_anus) as [well](#well) when the anus itself is held open.

entries.name: gaping
entries.description: An [anus](#anus) or [pussy](#pussy) that stays open by itself, typically shown after [sex](#sex). An orifice held open mid-penetration by an unseen partner is a different thing and belongs with [invisible_penis](#invisible_penis) and the spread tags.

entries.name: anus_peek
entries.description: Only the edge of the [anus](#anus) shows, appearing past the leg of [underwear](#underwear) or through sheer [fabric](#fabric). A fully exposed one is simply anus.

entries.name: perineum
entries.description: The strip of skin between the genitals and the [anus](#anus), colloquially the taint, visible in spread or from-below views. Usually tagged alongside anus and [pussy](#pussy) or [testicles](#testicles).

entries.name: anal_hair
entries.description: Hair drawn growing around the [anus](#anus). Most illustrations leave it out, even ones that render pubic hair carefully.

entries.name: puckered_anus
entries.description: The [anus](#anus) drawn tightly clenched and pushed outward in a [ring](#ring), sometimes called a [doughnut](#doughnut) shape. A detail of how the exposed anus is drawn rather than an act in itself.

entries.name: presenting_own_anus
entries.description: The character spreads or angles their own rear so the [anus](#anus) is exposed to the viewer. An offering pose made without anybody's help.

entries.name: dark_anus
entries.description: An [anus](#anus) coloured a marked brown to black, or simply darker than the skin around it on an unusual complexion. As with anus, used only where it is plainly in view.

entries.name: prolapse
entries.description: Interior [tissue](#tissue) of the rectum or vagina pushed out past its [opening](#opening). Art typically shows it as the aftermath of an especially large insertion or of [gaping](#gaping), with separate spellings for the [anal](#anal) and [vaginal](#vaginal) forms.

entries.name: spreading_own_anus
entries.description: A character reaches [back](#back) and pulls their own buttocks or [anus](#anus) open with their own hands, [presenting](#presenting) it to the viewer.

entries.name: prostate
entries.description: The internal gland in the male pelvis that contributes fluid at [ejaculation](#ejaculation). Drawn in a cutaway view, or noted when its stimulation is the point of the scene.

entries.name: anal_prolapse
entries.description: The rectal lining has been pushed out far enough to hang visibly outside the [anus](#anus). It belongs to the extremes of insertion work, and the [vaginal](#vaginal) counterpart has its own [tag](#tag).

entries.name: x_anus
entries.description: An [anus](#anus) reduced to a small X or asterisk shape, the cartoon shorthand seen especially on [animal](#animal) characters. It covers only that stylised rendering, never a realistically drawn anus.

entries.name: presenting_anus
entries.description: A character spreads or angles their rear so the [anus](#anus) is displayed to a partner or the viewer, a companion pose to [presenting](#presenting) the rest of the body.

entries.name: no_anus
entries.description: The rear is in view and drawn smooth, with [no](#no) [anus](#anus) where one would be expected. The artist has simply left it out.

entries.name: extreme_gaping
entries.description: An orifice held open far beyond the ordinary, wide enough to take a fist. That scale is what separates it from [plain](#plain) [gaping](#gaping).

entries.name: testicles
entries.description: The scrotum and its contents, shown on a male or [futanari](#futanari) character, generally visible below the [penis](#penis). Tag whenever they are drawn, and add [uncensored](#uncensored) or [censored](#censored) as fitting.

entries.name: large_testicles
entries.description: Testicles bigger than usual, though not yet in the huge range. The scale runs on through huge and gigantic.

entries.name: huge_testicles
entries.description: Testicles of very large size against the rest of the body. One step above [large_testicles](#large_testicles) and below [gigantic_testicles](#gigantic_testicles).

entries.name: no_testicles
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) drawn with [no](#no) [testicles](#testicles) under it, whether through anatomical error, mutilation, or on a [futanari](#futanari) whose penis sits above a vulva instead.

entries.name: testicle_grab
entries.description: A hand grips or cups someone's [testicles](#testicles), either in play or as an [attack](#attack). Add role tags for who is acting, and [handjob](#handjob) when the [penis](#penis) is being stroked as [well](#well).

entries.name: testicle_peek
entries.description: Part of the scrotum shows past the edge of clothing or from behind another body part, only just visible rather than fully exposed.

entries.name: bouncing_testicles
entries.description: Testicles [swing](#swing) and jolt along with the body. In a still picture the motion has to be carried by blur or drawn lines.

entries.name: veiny_testicles
entries.description: Testicles rendered with unusually [heavy](#heavy) veining across the skin of the scrotum, a matter of how the [anatomy](#anatomy) is drawn rather than of any particular act.

entries.name: squeezing_testicles
entries.description: Testicles gripped and pressed hard between the fingers, whether rough handling or deliberate [pain](#pain) play.

entries.name: sagging_testicles
entries.description: Testicles [hanging](#hanging) low and loose in a slack scrotum rather than drawn up tight against the body. Often exaggerated for size in [furry](#furry) and hyper art.

entries.name: small_testicles
entries.description: Testicles drawn under the usual size for the [figure](#figure), the bottom rung of a scale that continues through large, huge and gigantic. Purely a proportion call about the visible [anatomy](#anatomy).

entries.name: testicles_on_face
entries.description: Testicles rest against somebody's face, lowered onto the mouth, cheek or [forehead](#forehead). Usually accompanies [oral](#oral) [sex](#sex), though it is sometimes drawn purely as a joke.

entries.name: gigantic_testicles
entries.description: Testicles swollen [well](#well) past what a body could carry, larger even than the huge variant. The top of the small, large, huge, gigantic [progression](#progression).

entries.name: testicles_touching
entries.description: The [testicles](#testicles) of two characters press together, skin against skin. Where both are still covered by clothing, use [bulges_touching](#bulges_touching) instead.

entries.name: large_areolae
entries.description: The areolae are unusually wide, covering more than roughly half of each breast. The [breasts](#breasts) have to be exposed for it to be visible.

entries.name: puffy_nipples
entries.description: Nipples, usually along with the areolae, drawn noticeably swollen and [standing](#standing) proud of the breast's curve. Combine with [nipples](#nipples) for the base [tag](#tag).

entries.name: inverted_nipples
entries.description: Nipples that sit drawn [back](#back) into the breast rather than [standing](#standing) out from it. They are usually seen on bare [breasts](#breasts), and are the opposite case to [puffy_nipples](#puffy_nipples).

entries.name: huge_nipples
entries.description: Nipples drawn much longer or thicker than normal, roughly the length of a thumb or twice its thickness. It applies whether they are bare or pressing through clothing.

entries.name: dark_nipples
entries.description: Nipples in [plain](#plain) view coloured a deep brown to black, or darker than the surrounding skin. Japanese [convention](#convention) reads the [shade](#shade) as maturity or pregnancy against the pink of youth; where only the [ring](#ring) shows, use [dark_areolae](#dark_areolae).

entries.name: small_nipples
entries.description: Nipples and areolae drawn markedly smaller than usual, sometimes to little more than [dots](#dots). It is a shape [choice](#choice) about the areola size, independent of breast size.

entries.name: no_nipples
entries.description: A bare chest is shown clearly and unobstructed, yet the [nipples](#nipples) that should be there are missing. Nothing such as [fog](#fog) or a [shadow](#shadow) is [hiding](#hiding) them.

entries.name: colored_nipples
entries.description: Nipples or areolae in a colour outside the usual human range of pink to brown, such as blue, purple or green. Nearly always on a character who also has [colored_skin](#colored_skin).

entries.name: dark_areolae
entries.description: Areolae drawn a deep brown to black, or darker than the surrounding skin. Used while the nipple itself stays covered and only the [ring](#ring) shows; once the nipple is out, [dark_nipples](#dark_nipples) applies.

entries.name: light_areolae
entries.description: Areolae or [nipples](#nipples) coloured [lighter](#lighter) than the skin around them, most often on dark-skinned characters. The reverse of the usual darker [shade](#shade).

entries.name: long_nipples
entries.description: Nipples drawn noticeably elongated, [standing](#standing) [well](#well) clear of the areola. It says nothing about breast size, which other tags [record](#record).

entries.name: blue_nipples
entries.description: Nipples drawn in a blue [shade](#shade) rather than a [flesh](#flesh) tone, most often on characters whose skin is itself blue or otherwise unnatural. Shade calls are loose here, so pictures drift between this and the aqua or purple versions depending on the lighting.

entries.name: glands_of_montgomery
entries.description: The small raised bumps dotting the areola, drawn in as an anatomical detail. A mark of careful rendering rather than an act or a state.

entries.name: green_nipples
entries.description: The [nipples](#nipples) are drawn green. As [shade](#shade) judgement is loose and lighting shifts it further, the [tag](#tag) blurs into the aqua and yellow variants.

entries.name: purple_nipples
entries.description: Nipples drawn in a purple tone. Lighting and subjective judgement blur the boundaries, so a picture [can](#can) sit between this and the blue or red spellings.

entries.name: nipple_indents
entries.description: The tip of the nipple carries a visible dimple or small [opening](#opening). It differs from an inverted nipple, where the whole thing sits sunk into the breast.

entries.name: mole_on_areola
entries.description: A beauty spot on the darker [ring](#ring) around the nipple. The breast has to be bare for a mark that small to register at all.

entries.name: black_nipples
entries.description: Nipples drawn black rather than pink or brown. Lighting and personal judgement blur the line with grey_nipples, so the two overlap a great deal.

entries.name: nipple_hair
entries.description: Hair growing around the areola as part of the body hair on a shaggy chest. It sits out beyond the sternum on a [hairy](#hairy) [torso](#torso).

entries.name: spread_nipple
entries.description: A nipple held open with the fingers, either by parting the skin around an inverted nipple or by [opening](#opening) it where penetration is involved.

entries.name: glowing_nipples
entries.description: Nipples that shine with light of their own. Drawn as a superhuman or [comic](#comic) flourish, not as a highlight from a [lamp](#lamp).

entries.name: futanari
entries.description: A female character with male genitals, a [fantasy](#fantasy) depiction of hermaphroditism rather than anything to do with real intersex or transgender [people](#people). Confirmed absence of a vagina makes it [futa_without_pussy](#futa_without_pussy), all three [organs](#organs) visible makes it [full-package_futanari](#full-package_futanari), and it never takes [hetero](#hetero), [yuri](#yuri) or [yaoi](#yaoi).

entries.name: multiple_futa
entries.description: More than one [futanari](#futanari) character appears in the picture. The [tag](#tag) counts them and says nothing about what they are doing.

entries.name: full-package_futanari
entries.description: A [futanari](#futanari) possessing vagina, [penis](#penis) and [testicles](#testicles), all three either visible or clearly implied by context such as a [bulge](#bulge) or fluids. Without evidence of all three use [plain](#plain) futanari, and where the vagina is plainly absent use [futa_without_pussy](#futa_without_pussy).

entries.name: futa_without_pussy
entries.description: A character with a female body who has a [penis](#penis) and [testicles](#testicles) and lacks a vagina. It needs visual or source confirmation of that absence; where the matter is unclear, [plain](#plain) [futanari](#futanari) is the right [tag](#tag).

entries.name: implied_futanari
entries.description: A character reads as [futanari](#futanari) without visual proof: a bulging [belly](#belly) with semen, [condom](#condom) wrappers, a penetrating position. Canon status and the artist's word do not settle it, only what the picture [can](#can) support, and it may sit beside futanari.

entries.name: cuntboy
entries.description: Male in body and build, but with female genitals and [no](#no) [penis](#penis). Distinct from a male [futanari](#futanari), who carries both sets, though the appeal overlaps.

entries.name: intravaginal_futanari
entries.description: A [futanari](#futanari) whose [penis](#penis) emerges from the vagina rather than [sitting](#sitting) above it in the usual place. Testicles are absent in this arrangement, and a shaft that reads as a swollen [clitoris](#clitoris) is a pseudo-penis instead.

entries.name: misplaced_genitals
entries.description: Genitals or [breasts](#breasts) drawn in place of, or [standing](#standing) in for, a different body part entirely. A [surreal](#surreal) reshaping of [anatomy](#anatomy) rather than an accidental drawing error.

entries.name: sex
entries.description: Vaginal or [anal](#anal) intercourse with a [penis](#penis) or [strap-on](#strap-on). Not for [oral](#oral) sex, [paizuri](#paizuri), [fingering](#fingering), or other acts without penile penetration; [tentacles](#tentacles) use [tentacle_sex](#tentacle_sex), and two animals mating use [mating_(animal)](#mating_(animal)).

entries.name: vaginal
entries.description: Something penetrates the vagina, whether fingers, a [toy](#toy), [tentacles](#tentacles) or a [penis](#penis). Add [sex](#sex) as [well](#well) only when a penis is what is doing the penetrating; the visible organ itself is a separate [tag](#tag).

entries.name: anal
entries.description: Anything pushed into the [anus](#anus): a [penis](#penis), fingers, a [toy](#toy), a tentacle. Only a penis makes the picture [sex](#sex) as [well](#well), and the narrower cases such as [anal_fingering](#anal_fingering) have their own tags.

entries.name: object_insertion
entries.description: A lifeless item such as a [vibrator](#vibrator), a [dildo](#dildo) or a [vegetable](#vegetable) is pushed into the vagina or the [anus](#anus). A [penis](#penis) instead makes it [sex](#sex), fingers make it [fingering](#fingering), and [tentacles](#tentacles) take [tentacle_sex](#tentacle_sex).

entries.name: male_penetrated
entries.description: A male character on the receiving end of penetration, whether by a partner, a [toy](#toy) or something else. Pair it with [anal](#anal), [sex](#sex) or whichever act is shown.

entries.name: anal_object_insertion
entries.description: An inanimate object, a [vibrator](#vibrator), a [dildo](#dildo), a [vegetable](#vegetable), is pushed into the [anus](#anus). A [penis](#penis) makes it [sex](#sex), fingers make it [anal_fingering](#anal_fingering), and [tentacles](#tentacles) have their own [tag](#tag).

entries.name: double_penetration
entries.description: Two of a character's openings penetrated at once, or one [opening](#opening) taking two penises, [tentacles](#tentacles), toys or objects together. Often occurs alongside [spitroast](#spitroast) and [group_sex](#group_sex), and the moment before it happens is imminent_double_penetration.

entries.name: vaginal_object_insertion
entries.description: An inanimate thing such as a [dildo](#dildo), [vibrator](#vibrator) or [vegetable](#vegetable) is pushed into the vagina. A [penis](#penis) doing so takes [sex](#sex) instead, fingers take [fingering](#fingering), and [tentacles](#tentacles) fall under [tentacle_sex](#tentacle_sex).

entries.name: tentacle_sex
entries.description: Tentacles penetrate a character orally, vaginally or anally in imitation of intercourse. Still [tag](#tag) [vaginal](#vaginal) or [anal](#anal) as fitting, but not [sex](#sex), [object_insertion](#object_insertion), [interspecies](#interspecies) or [bestiality](#bestiality); a tentacle only poised to enter is [imminent_penetration](#imminent_penetration) instead.

entries.name: deep_penetration

entries.name: cum
entries.description: Semen visible in the picture, nearly always drawn opaque white. entries.name: cum_on_breasts

entries.name: cum_overflow

entries.name: cum_on_clothes

entries.description: Pre-ejaculate seen [dripping](#dripping) or stringing from the tip of a [penis](#penis) rather than merely beading there. Tag [precum](#precum) with it.

entries.name: cum_string

A free-hanging strand is [cumdrip](#cumdrip), one still being ejaculated is [projectile_cum](#projectile_cum), and a clear strand is [precum_string](#precum_string).

entries.name: cum_on_tongue
entries.description: Semen [resting](#resting) on an extended [tongue](#tongue), generally with the mouth held open to [display](#display) it. A narrower case of [cum_in_mouth](#cum_in_mouth).

entries.name: ejaculating_while_penetrated

entries.name: cum_on_legs

entries.name: cum_on_penis

entries.name: excessive_cum

entries.name: cum_on_male

entries.name: cum_on_floor

entries.name: cum_on_pussy

entries.name: cum_in_container

entries.name: cum_on_legwear

entries.name: cum_in_cup

entries.name: cum_on_back

entries.name: cum_on_armpits

entries.name: cum_on_chest
