entries.description: Deliberate restraint for sexual purposes with [rope](#rope), cord, [cuffs](#cuffs), chains or straps, from tied wrists to a full rope [harness](#harness). Restraint that is not sexual or is played for laughs is [tied_up_(nonsexual)](#tied_up_(nonsexual)), and being [caught](#caught) in something by [accident](#accident) is [entangled](#entangled).

entries.name: restrained
entries.description: A character held so they cannot move, by ropes, [cuffs](#cuffs), a grip, or a [creature](#creature). Broad: covers [bondage](#bondage), capture, and being [pinned](#pinned) down; use [bound](#bound) and a specific restraint [tag](#tag) for how it is done.

entries.name: cuffs
entries.description: Leather or metal bands fastened round the wrists, arms, ankles or [legs](#legs), made to be [chained](#chained) to each other or to something fixed. Police [handcuffs](#handcuffs) take handcuffs, purely decorative bands [wrist_cuffs](#wrist_cuffs), and [fabric](#fabric) sleeve ends [sleeve_cuffs](#sleeve_cuffs); ankle bands add [ankle_cuffs](#ankle_cuffs).

entries.name: gag
entries.description: An object set into or across the mouth to stop somebody speaking, from a purpose-made [ball](#ball) gag to [tape](#tape) or a strip of [cloth](#cloth). Add [gagged](#gagged) for the person wearing it, and the specific kind where it [can](#can) be told apart.

entries.name: bound_wrists
entries.description: Both wrists tied to each other with [rope](#rope), [cuffs](#cuffs), [tape](#tape) or [ribbon](#ribbon), in front of the body or behind the [back](#back). Where the binding wraps the whole arms, add [bound_arms](#bound_arms).

entries.name: gagged
entries.description: Somebody whose mouth is held shut so they cannot speak, by a purpose-made [gag](#gag) or an improvised one such as [tape](#tape) or [cloth](#cloth). It nearly always accompanies [bondage](#bondage).

entries.name: bound_arms
entries.description: Both arms tied together, behind the [back](#back) or against the sides, the binding [wrapping](#wrapping) the upper arms and not only the wrists. Wrists alone are [bound_wrists](#bound_wrists).

entries.name: shibari
entries.description: Japanese-style [rope](#rope) [bondage](#bondage) built from intricate criss-crossing patterns over the body, often binding the [breasts](#breasts) or passing between the [legs](#legs). Covers any stylized tie in that tradition; over clothing it is [shibari_over_clothes](#shibari_over_clothes) instead.

entries.name: bound_legs
entries.description: Both [legs](#legs) tied together at the thigh, knee or calf with [rope](#rope), straps or [chain](#chain). When only the ankles are joined, [bound_ankles](#bound_ankles) is the narrower answer.

entries.name: handcuffs
entries.description: Linked metal [cuffs](#cuffs) that [lock](#lock) the wrists together, of the [police](#police) issue type; they turn up in arrests and in [bondage](#bondage) alike. Other restraining cuffs take the [plain](#plain) cuffs [tag](#tag), and decorative [wrist_cuffs](#wrist_cuffs) or a sleeve's cuffs are unrelated.

entries.name: ball_gag
entries.description: A rubber [ball](#ball) held in the mouth by a [strap](#strap) buckled behind the head, stopping the wearer speaking clearly. Add [wiffle_gag](#wiffle_gag) when the ball is drilled through with holes.

entries.name: shackles
entries.description: Heavy metal [cuffs](#cuffs) around the wrists or ankles, often [chained](#chained) to a wall or a [ball](#ball), evoking a [dungeon](#dungeon) or [prison](#prison). Wider and more solid than [handcuffs](#handcuffs); [oni](#oni) are commonly drawn wearing them as ornament.

entries.name: improvised_gag
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) made of whatever was to hand: [cloth](#cloth), [tape](#tape), a [scarf](#scarf), an [article](#article) of clothing rather than a purpose-built [device](#device). It marks the restraint as hasty.

entries.name: bound_ankles
entries.description: Both ankles tied to each other with [rope](#rope), [tape](#tape), [cuffs](#cuffs) or a [strap](#strap). Where the whole [legs](#legs) are lashed together rather than the ankles alone, [bound_legs](#bound_legs) is the better fit.

entries.name: suspension
entries.description: A [bondage](#bondage) scene in which the [restrained](#restrained) person hangs from ropes, chains or [cuffs](#cuffs), with or without touching the [floor](#floor). Non-bondage forms of [hanging](#hanging) belong under the [plain](#plain) hanging [tag](#tag) instead.

entries.name: chained
entries.description: Chains bind or restrain a character, whether shackled to a wall, wound around the body or held by chained [cuffs](#cuffs). It covers [prison](#prison) scenes as readily as [bondage](#bondage).

entries.name: crotch_rope
entries.description: Rope tied so that it runs between the [legs](#legs) and presses on the genitals. A [bondage](#bondage) arrangement, often one strand of a larger [shibari](#shibari) [harness](#harness).

entries.name: shibari_over_clothes
entries.description: Shibari-style [rope](#rope) patterns tied over a clothed body rather than bare skin. Implies [shibari](#shibari).

entries.name: wiffle_gag
entries.description: A [ball](#ball) [gag](#gag) pierced with holes like a wiffle ball, letting the wearer breathe more easily than a solid one. Combine with gag and [bondage](#bondage).

entries.name: cloth_gag
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) improvised from a strip of [cloth](#cloth) tied round the head, either stuffed into the mouth or pulled across it. Purpose-made hardware such as a [ball](#ball) gag is something else.

entries.name: tape_gag
entries.description: A strip of [strong](#strong) [tape](#tape) [stuck](#stuck) over the mouth to keep someone quiet.

entries.name: breast_bondage
entries.description: Rope is wound around and between the [breasts](#breasts) so that it squeezes and lifts them. It is a standard component of a [shibari](#shibari) [harness](#harness) rather than a tie in itself.

entries.name: stationary_restraints
entries.description: A character held by rigid [restraints](#restraints) fixed in place, such as [stocks](#stocks), pillories, wall-bolted [shackles](#shackles) or a machine's [cuffs](#cuffs), that do not give when they struggle. Rope, [chain](#chain) tethers and [tentacles](#tentacles) alone do not count.

entries.name: frogtie
entries.description: A tie that binds each ankle to the matching thigh or wrist, leaving the [legs](#legs) [folded](#folded) up and usually held apart. The arms are commonly [bound](#bound) behind the [back](#back) at the same time.

entries.name: over_the_mouth_gag
entries.description: A band of [cloth](#cloth) drawn across the [lips](#lips) and knotted behind the head, muffling speech without filling the mouth. It sits lower on the face than the version that also covers the [nose](#nose).

entries.name: bound_torso
entries.description: Rope or straps wrap the chest and [belly](#belly), so the upper body itself is what is tied. It frequently forms the frame of a fuller [harness](#harness).

entries.name: bit_gag
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) modelled on a horse's snaffle bit: a soft bar held across the mouth by straps buckled behind the head. Common in pony play and other restraint scenes.

entries.name: bondage_outfit
entries.description: Clothing built for restraint play: interlocking [strap](#strap) harnesses, tight corsets, and [leather](#leather) or [latex](#latex) bodysuits and leotards hung with rings and buckles. The garment is what counts, so nobody has to be tied at all.

entries.name: chained_wrists
entries.description: The wrists are [chained](#chained) together, or chained to something else, commonly through [shackles](#shackles). A narrower case of chained.

entries.name: ribbon_bondage
entries.description: A character tied up or restricted with long [ribbon](#ribbon) instead of [rope](#rope), often [giving](#giving) a gift-wrapped or decorative look to the [bondage](#bondage). Tagged with [bound](#bound) and ribbon.

entries.name: wrists_tied_together
entries.description: The wrists are [bound](#bound) to one another with [rope](#rope), [cloth](#cloth) or [cuffs](#cuffs), either in front of the body or behind the [back](#back). A basic restraint that leaves the rest of the body free.

entries.name: straitjacket
entries.description: A long-sleeved [jacket](#jacket) that binds the arms across the body to prevent movement, associated with asylums and Houdini's escape acts. Tag it worn as restraint or as [costume](#costume).

entries.name: holed_ball_gag
entries.description: A [ball](#ball) [gag](#gag) [bored](#bored) through with an [opening](#opening), [holding](#holding) the mouth wide without sealing it. A solid ball gag blocks the mouth completely instead.

entries.name: spreader_bar
entries.description: A rigid bar strapped or [cuffed](#cuffed) to the ankles or wrists to force the limbs apart during [bondage](#bondage). Tagged when the [device](#device) itself is visible in the scene.

entries.name: tape_bondage
entries.description: Someone [restrained](#restrained) with adhesive [tape](#tape) rather than [rope](#rope), with the wrists, ankles or whole body wound in strips and sometimes a strip laid across the mouth. Rope binding instead takes a [shibari](#shibari) or general [bondage](#bondage) [tag](#tag).

entries.name: ring_gag
entries.description: A [bondage](#bondage) [gag](#gag) made of a [ring](#ring) strapped into the mouth to hold it open. Tagged with gag; commonly appears in [oral](#oral) scenes.

entries.name: cleave_gag
entries.description: A strip of [cloth](#cloth) pulled between the [teeth](#teeth) and knotted behind the head, [holding](#holding) the mouth open. The [fabric](#fabric) sits between the jaws rather than filling the mouth, which is what separates it from a stuffed [gag](#gag).

entries.name: box_tie
entries.description: Rope folds the arms behind the [back](#back) and lashes each wrist to the opposite elbow, so the [forearms](#forearms) make a [rectangle](#rectangle) across the [spine](#spine). It is one of the foundation [shapes](#shapes) of Japanese [rope](#rope) work and is often the base for a chest [harness](#harness).

entries.name: stocks
entries.description: Hinged wooden boards closed around the wrists or the ankles to hold someone in place. When the planks trap head and body together instead, the [device](#device) is a [pillory](#pillory).

entries.name: wooden_horse
entries.description: A piece of [bondage](#bondage) furniture built as a large upturned wedge on [legs](#legs), straddled so the rider's own [weight](#weight) presses the edge into the [crotch](#crotch). It should not be [confused](#confused) with a rocking [horse](#horse), a safe [toy](#toy) for children.

entries.name: gag_harness
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) held in place by an elaborate arrangement of straps rather than a single pair at the sides, typically crossing the cheeks and [running](#running) over the [crown](#crown) of the head. Some versions build in a [blindfold](#blindfold).

entries.name: bound_together
entries.description: Two or more [people](#people) are tied to one another by the same [rope](#rope), [chain](#chain) or [strap](#strap), [back](#back) to back, face to face or in a bundle. Add [bondage](#bondage) when the scene is sexual.

entries.name: hogtie
entries.description: A tie in which the wrists and ankles are drawn together behind the [back](#back) and lashed, arching the body and leaving the person unable to move. The [figure](#figure) usually lies on the [stomach](#stomach) or side.

entries.name: armbinder
entries.description: A tapered sleeve that swallows both arms behind the [back](#back) and [laces](#laces) tight, drawing the elbows together. Also called a monoglove.

entries.name: pillory
entries.description: A restraint closing around the [neck](#neck), [torso](#torso) or limbs, classically two hinged boards with cut-out holes. Boards that hold only the wrists or ankles are [stocks](#stocks) instead.

entries.name: nose_hook
entries.description: A [hook](#hook) slipped under the [nostrils](#nostrils) and pulled upward, tugging the [nose](#nose) into a [snout](#snout) shape. It is used in [bondage](#bondage) scenes to make the face look degraded.

entries.name: ball_and_chain_restraint
entries.description: A [heavy](#heavy) iron [ball](#ball) [chained](#chained) to a cuff at the ankle or the wrist, the classic prisoner's shackle. Depending on its [weight](#weight) it either pins the character in place or simply drags behind as they struggle along.

entries.name: predicament_bondage
entries.description: A tie that leaves the [bound](#bound) person able to move, but only by trading one discomfort for another, so easing a pull on the [nipples](#nipples) means [holding](#holding) a harder stance. The dilemma itself is the point.

entries.name: immobilization
entries.description: Bindings drawn tight enough that the captive cannot shift at all, [well](#well) past ordinary restraint. Full-body [wrapping](#wrapping), [encasement](#encasement) and dense [rope](#rope) work are the usual forms.

entries.name: bound_thighs
entries.description: A binding circles both [thighs](#thighs) and holds them against each other, often as one element of a larger tie. Below the knee the [legs](#legs) are usually left loose.

entries.name: over_the_nose_gag
entries.description: A [cloth](#cloth) [gag](#gag) pulled up far enough to [cover](#cover) the [nose](#nose) along with the mouth. An everyday face [mask](#mask) counts only when it is clearly being used to stop the wearer speaking.

entries.name: bound_toes
entries.description: One or more [toes](#toes) are tied, most often the two big toes lashed to one another with thin cord. The rest of the foot may be quite free.

entries.name: unworn_gag
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) appears in the picture but is not in anyone's mouth or strapped to their head, whether held, [hanging](#hanging) around the [neck](#neck) or [lying](#lying) to one side.

entries.name: shibari_under_clothes
entries.description: A [rope](#rope) [harness](#harness) tied onto the bare body and then hidden beneath ordinary clothing, so only its [outline](#outline) through the [fabric](#fabric) or a stray cord gives it away. Implies [shibari](#shibari).

entries.name: cuffed
entries.description: The character's wrists are locked in [handcuffs](#handcuffs), either in front of the body or behind the [back](#back). Covers an [arrest](#arrest) as readily as restraint sought for its own [sake](#sake).

entries.name: linked_collar
entries.description: Two or more collars joined by a [chain](#chain), lead or short [strap](#strap) so the wearers are tethered to each other. A [bondage](#bondage) arrangement rather than a [plain](#plain) accessory; [bound_together](#bound_together) often applies as [well](#well).

entries.name: dildo_gag
entries.description: A mouth [gag](#gag) with a phallus mounted on it, so the wearer's mouth is filled while straps hold the piece in place. Restraint and [toy](#toy) combined in one object.

entries.name: whipping
entries.description: One [figure](#figure) strikes another with a [whip](#whip), usually as [punishment](#punishment) or within a [bondage](#bondage) scene. The lash may be mid-swing, wrapped around the body, or already leaving welts.

entries.name: cuffs-to-collar
entries.description: Wrist [cuffs](#cuffs) [chained](#chained) short to a [collar](#collar), so the hands cannot be lowered below the [neck](#neck). A restraint arrangement out of [bondage](#bondage) practice.

entries.name: upright_restraints
entries.description: Fixed bonds that hold a body vertical, whether suspended, seated or [kneeling](#kneeling), so long as the main mass of the [figure](#figure) stays upright rather than [lying](#lying) or bent over. It does not apply merely because someone happens to be [standing](#standing) while tied and could still lie down; add [standing_restraints](#standing_restraints) separately when they are also on their [feet](#feet).

entries.name: rope_marks
entries.description: Grooves and reddened lines pressed into the skin where [rope](#rope) has been tied, still visible after the binding is gone. They [record](#record) what happened rather than show it happening.

entries.name: plug_gag
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) whose bulbous insert fills the mouth, held in by a [strap](#strap) buckled behind the head. Its shape, often modelled on a [penis](#penis), sets it apart from a [plain](#plain) [ball](#ball) gag.

entries.name: separated_legs
entries.description: The [legs](#legs) are [forced](#forced) apart and held there by hardware such as a bar or spread ropes, so they cannot be closed. It is the restraint being recorded, not merely the open stance.

entries.name: snake_bondage
entries.description: A [snake](#snake) or [lamia](#lamia) [wrapping](#wrapping) its coils around a character, pinning the arms and body in place. Add [constriction](#constriction) when the squeeze is clearly hurting them.

entries.name: anal_hook
entries.description: A curved metal rod ending in a [ball](#ball), pushed in anally and usually roped to a [collar](#collar) or to [bound](#bound) wrists so the body is held in a [forced](#forced) posture. It works as a restraint rather than as a [toy](#toy) in itself.

entries.name: bondage_mittens
entries.description: Bag-shaped coverings that [buckle](#buckle) shut at the wrist and hold the hand closed, with [no](#no) separate thumb. Stiff [leather](#leather) or a similar material stops the wearer gripping anything through them.

entries.name: human_dog
entries.description: A [bondage](#bondage) arrangement binding the arms and [legs](#legs) at elbow and knee so that the submissive [can](#can) only crawl. Padded [mittens](#mittens) usually do the binding and [cushion](#cushion) the [joints](#joints).

entries.name: gag_around_neck
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) of any type [hanging](#hanging) loose at the throat instead of [sitting](#sitting) in the mouth. It shows the gag has been taken out, or has not been put in yet.

entries.name: encasement
entries.description: Enclosed by something closely enough that moving or getting free is impossible: slime, rubber, resin, [ice](#ice) or a sealed [suit](#suit). The material wrapped around the body is what matters, not a cord tied about it.

entries.name: gimp_mask
entries.description: A tight [hood](#hood) enclosing the whole head, generally rubber or [leather](#leather) with small openings for the eyes and mouth. Normally worn with a matching full-body [suit](#suit).

entries.name: clothes_gag
entries.description: A garment has been stuffed into somebody's mouth to silence them, improvised rather than purpose-made. Where the item used is [panties](#panties), that carries a [tag](#tag) of its own as [well](#well).

entries.name: single_handcuff
entries.description: One shackle of a pair locked around a wrist with the other cuff [hanging](#hanging) loose or fastened to something. Suggests an escape, an [arrest](#arrest) half made, or a deliberate tether.

entries.name: gimp_suit
entries.description: A glossy rubber [suit](#suit) sealing the wearer from [neck](#neck) to [feet](#feet), made for [bondage](#bondage) rather than for sport or [swimming](#swimming). Often completed by a matching [hood](#hood).

entries.name: sensory_deprivation
entries.description: A [blindfold](#blindfold) and [headphones](#headphones) worn together so the character [can](#can) neither see nor hear. The point is shutting off both senses at once, deliberately.

entries.name: reverse_prayer
entries.description: A [bondage](#bondage) tie with both arms drawn behind the [back](#back) and the [palms](#palms) pressed together as if [praying](#praying), fingers [pointing](#pointing) up between the shoulder blades. The position forces the chest forward and is considered a demanding [shibari](#shibari) hold.

entries.name: unworn_blindfold
entries.description: A [blindfold](#blindfold) is visible in the picture but [no](#no) longer covering the eyes, pushed up onto the [forehead](#forehead), held in a hand or [lying](#lying) nearby. Different from [no_blindfold](#no_blindfold), where none appears at all.

entries.name: hobble
entries.description: The [legs](#legs) are [bound](#bound) with a short tether between them, leaving the person able to shuffle but not to stride or run. It is a restraint rather than a garment.

entries.name: panty_gag
entries.description: Panties bunched up and pushed into the mouth to silence someone, held there or tied in place. Underwear brought to the mouth willingly to suck or chew on is eating_panties.

entries.name: restraints
entries.description: Devices built to hold a character in place, such as [cuffs](#cuffs), [shackles](#shackles), straps, or [bound](#bound) wrists, shown in use or ready for it. A character merely held down by a hand, or [stuck](#stuck) somewhere by [accident](#accident), is [restrained](#restrained) but not in restraints.

entries.name: bound_feet
entries.description: Both [feet](#feet) are tied together with [rope](#rope), straps or [tape](#tape), joined at the ankles or bundled into one. Walking is out of the question either way.

entries.name: panel_gag
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) made from a flat panel of [leather](#leather) or rubber strapped over the mouth and buckled behind the head. It seals the [lips](#lips) rather than filling the mouth.

entries.name: ungagged
entries.description: A [gag](#gag) that had been in someone's mouth is removed or pushed aside while the rest of a [bondage](#bondage) scene continues, leaving the mouth free to speak. The [device](#device) itself typically stays visible nearby or around the [neck](#neck).

entries.name: mummification_(bound)
entries.description: A [figure](#figure) wound head to foot in [bandages](#bandages) or [cloth](#cloth) so that the arms and [legs](#legs) are [pinned](#pinned) inside the [wrapping](#wrapping). Where the wraps leave the limbs free to move, the non-bound version of the [tag](#tag) applies.

entries.name: bound_knees
entries.description: A binding wraps the [legs](#legs) at knee [height](#height), clamping them against one another. The legs [can](#can) still bend, but they cannot be parted.

entries.name: public_bondage
entries.description: Someone tied, [cuffed](#cuffed), or otherwise [restrained](#restrained) for sexual purposes somewhere others could see them, such as a [street](#street), [park](#park), or [train](#train). The risk of exposure is the point, so the setting matters as much as the ropes.

entries.name: tentacle_around_neck
entries.description: A tentacle wraps around someone's throat, either loosely draped or drawn tight. How much slack it leaves decides whether the picture reads as restraint or as [threat](#threat).

entries.name: handcuff_dangle
entries.description: One cuff still locked on a wrist while its twin swings loose and unattached. The look suggests either a fresh escape or a pair about to be closed.

entries.name: self_bondage
entries.description: Someone has tied or [cuffed](#cuffed) themselves with nobody else present to do the binding. The ropes or straps are arranged so the character ends up [restrained](#restrained) by their own hand.

entries.name: dental_gag
entries.description: A metal frame borrowed from dentistry that props the [jaw](#jaw) wide apart. The mouth is [forced](#forced) open rather than stopped up, which is what separates it from a [ball](#ball) [gag](#gag).

entries.name: rope_gag
entries.description: Rope drawn between the [teeth](#teeth) and knotted behind the head so the wearer cannot speak clearly. A simple improvised [gag](#gag) compared with a [ball](#ball) or [cloth](#cloth) one.

entries.name: standing_restraints
entries.description: Bonds that hold a captive upright on their own [feet](#feet), able in principle to [bear](#bear) their own [weight](#weight) without them. A captive who is [hanging](#hanging), [kneeling](#kneeling) or [bound](#bound) to a slab instead takes [upright_restraints](#upright_restraints).

entries.name: bound_leg
entries.description: One leg alone is tied, [folded](#folded) against itself, lashed to furniture or fixed to another limb. The other leg stays free, which is what separates it from ties taking both.

entries.name: x-cross_(bdsm)
entries.description: An X-shaped frame fitted with [cuffs](#cuffs) or tie points at all four ends, [holding](#holding) someone spread-eagled across it. It is normally bolted to a wall for stability; a [plain](#plain) X-shaped graphic with [no](#no) restraining purpose is a saltire instead.

entries.name: strappado
entries.description: A [bondage](#bondage) position with the arms tied behind the [back](#back) and then hauled upward by a [rope](#rope) or [chain](#chain) from above, forcing the body to bend forward. The strain across the shoulders is the point of it.

entries.name: tied_nipples
entries.description: Cord or thin [rope](#rope) wound around the base of one or both [nipples](#nipples) and knotted tight. Not the same as [nipple_clamps](#nipple_clamps), where a metal clip does the [pinching](#pinching).

entries.name: spider_gag
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) [gag](#gag) fitted with hooks or prongs that catch on the [teeth](#teeth) or [lips](#lips), keeping it from being turned [sideways](#sideways) once inserted. Holds the mouth [forced](#forced) open.

entries.name: bdsm
entries.description: The [umbrella](#umbrella) term for [bondage](#bondage), discipline, dominance, submission and sadomasochism: [restraints](#restraints), gags, collars and leashes, [spanking](#spanking) and other rough treatment between partners. Add the specific practice, such as bondage, [femdom](#femdom) or spanking.

entries.name: femdom
entries.description: A scene in which the dominant [party](#party) is female, whatever the [sex](#sex) of the submissive one. Milder bossiness with [no](#no) [bdsm](#bdsm) framing is better called [assertive_female](#assertive_female).

entries.name: assertive_female
entries.description: A woman takes the lead, sexually or romantically: on top, plainly in charge, or the one starting the affection, usually with a knowing look. A milder relative of [femdom](#femdom), and where both are visibly enjoying themselves, [happy_sex](#happy_sex) may [suit](#suit) better.

entries.name: humiliation
entries.description: A character is degraded and plainly upset or ashamed by it: [forced](#forced) exposure, [abuse](#abuse), body [writing](#writing), being treated as a [pet](#pet) or recorded in a compromising state. It covers [bullying](#bullying) as [well](#well) as fetish work, and enthusiastic consent generally rules it out.

entries.name: spanked
entries.description: A character's buttocks show the aftermath of a [spanking](#spanking), whether reddened skin or a hand-shaped mark. Use it on its own when [no](#no) spanking is actively happening, and add spanking when the act itself is shown.

entries.name: spanking
entries.description: One character strikes another's buttocks with a hand or an implement, whether as [punishment](#punishment) or as erotic play. Add [spanked](#spanked) when the skin is already marked or reddened.

entries.name: dominatrix
entries.description: A woman presented as the dominant partner in a scene, typically in a [latex](#latex) or [leather](#leather) outfit with a crop or [whip](#whip) in hand.

entries.name: viewer_holding_leash
entries.description: A POV picture in which the viewer holds the [leash](#leash) attached to a character's [collar](#collar). The far end must be on the character; if the viewer's hand is drawn, add [holding_leash](#holding_leash) too.

entries.name: mind_break
entries.description: A character's outlook on [sex](#sex) [forced](#forced) to change under pressure, usually shown as someone who once resisted now craving it. Marked visually by a vacant or fixated expression.

entries.name: domination
entries.description: One partner [holding](#holding) command over another through restraint, posture or spoken instruction. Names the power dynamic rather than any particular act.

entries.name: cbt
entries.description: Pain deliberately applied to a male character's [penis](#penis) or [testicles](#testicles) as a sexual practice, through [kicking](#kicking), [squeezing](#squeezing), clamping and the like. Short for cock and [ball](#ball) [torture](#torture), a [branch](#branch) of the wider [bdsm](#bdsm) [tree](#tree).

entries.name: masochism
entries.description: A character taking pleasure in [pain](#pain) or [humiliation](#humiliation), whether self-inflicted or given by another. It needs a [plain](#plain) signal such as dialogue or a delighted expression; an ordinary [bondage](#bondage) scene without that does not qualify.

entries.name: sadism
entries.description: A character taking pleasure, usually sexual, in causing someone else [pain](#pain). Shown through a gleeful expression while [whipping](#whipping), hurting or humiliating a partner.

entries.name: futasub
entries.description: A [futanari](#futanari) in the submissive role — dominated, [restrained](#restrained) or teased by a partner, by [tentacles](#tentacles) or by machines. Gentler [domination](#domination) without any restraint counts as [well](#well).

entries.name: zenra
entries.description: A fetish that treats nudity as entirely unremarkable: characters go about ordinary activities with [no](#no) clothing on and nobody around them reacts. It differs from [exhibitionism](#exhibitionism), where the exposure itself is the thrill, and does not [cover](#cover) ordinary [bathing](#bathing) or [beach](#beach) nudity.

entries.name: pervert_female

entries.name: presenting_foot
entries.description: A foot held out toward the viewer or another character, sole forward, as an offer or tease. Common in foot-focused art; [tag](#tag) [feet](#feet) and [foot_focus](#foot_focus) as fitting.

entries.name: uncommon_stimulation
entries.description: A character [aroused](#aroused) through an unusual body part or method, such as a horn, [tail](#tail), wing or another erogenous zone humans do not have. The stimulated part should be clear in the picture.

entries.name: incest
entries.description: Romantic or sexual activity between [blood](#blood) relatives, most often [siblings](#siblings) or parent and [child](#child). Adoptive relatives and in-laws take [inseki](#inseki) instead.

entries.name: netorare
entries.description: A lover, friend or relative of the viewpoint character is seduced or taken away by somebody else. The wronged [party](#party) must be present or clearly referred to in the picture itself; a partner who seeks out the affair is [cheating_(relationship)](#cheating_(relationship)), and taking somebody else's lover is netori.

entries.name: cheating_(relationship)
entries.description: A character in a monogamous relationship sleeps with, or secretly meets, somebody other than their partner. Dishonesty in a contest is [cheating_(competitive)](#cheating_(competitive)).

entries.name: pet_play
entries.description: Role-play in which one participant acts as another's [pet](#pet) [animal](#animal), typically on all fours with a [collar](#collar), a [leash](#leash), fake ears, a [tail](#tail) and a [bowl](#bowl). Headpat, [paw_pose](#paw_pose) and [viewer_holding_leash](#viewer_holding_leash) often come with it.

entries.name: harem

entries.name: prostitution
entries.description: Sexual services traded for [money](#money), shown through dialogue or through props such as cash held, tucked into clothing, or left beside the character. Covers both the act itself and a solicitation scene where nothing further happens.

entries.name: public_use

entries.name: inseki

entries.name: pony_play
