entries.name: tentacle_in_mouth
entries.description: A tentacle is pushed into someone's mouth, filling it or [reaching](#reaching) further down the throat. It sometimes appears as a [gag](#gag) [holding](#holding) the [jaw](#jaw) open rather than as an ongoing act.

entries.name: tentacle_grab
entries.description: A hand closes around a tentacle, either guiding a willing one or shoving it away. When the tentacle is doing the [holding](#holding) instead, the ordinary grabbing tags run the other way.

entries.name: anal_fisting
entries.description: A whole hand, closed or partly closed, is worked into the [anus](#anus). It appears in [dominatrix](#dominatrix) scenes and in male-male work alike.

entries.name: aphrodisiac
entries.description: A drug that drives up desire and sensitivity, shown as a [vial](#vial), a [pill](#pill) or something slipped into a [drink](#drink). It usually sets up a scene where a character loses hold of their own arousal.

entries.name: unbirthing
entries.description: A whole character shown taken inside a vagina, usually drawn far smaller than the one receiving them. A size-play [fantasy](#fantasy) closer to [vore](#vore) than to ordinary penetration.

entries.name: sounding
entries.description: Inserting an object into the [urethra](#urethra) of a [penis](#penis), sometimes taken far enough to fill the [bladder](#bladder). Insertion into a female urethra falls under the broader [urethral_insertion](#urethral_insertion) [tag](#tag) instead.

entries.name: change_in_common_sense
entries.description: What [everyone](#everyone) in the scene treats as normal has been rewritten, so something outlandish, going to [school](#school) undressed for instance, passes without comment. A [branch](#branch) of the mind control fetish.

entries.name: navel_insertion
entries.description: An object pushed into the [navel](#navel) and through the [belly](#belly) wall, generally handled as gore. Where a [penis](#penis) does it, navel [sex](#sex) is the [tag](#tag) instead.

entries.name: rope_walking
entries.description: Being made to walk along a [rope](#rope) pulled taut and drawn up between the [legs](#legs), so it presses with every step. Cables and chains serve the same purpose; [balancing](#balancing) on top of a rope instead is tightrope.

entries.name: tentacle_clothes
entries.description: Tentacles grow out of a garment, or the garment is made entirely of them, ranging from a few strands [slipping](#slipping) past a [collar](#collar) to a whole [suit](#suit) of writhing limbs. Swimsuits and bodysuits are the usual base, and the wearer may or may not be in control of them.

entries.name: hypnosis_app
entries.description: An invented [phone](#phone) program used to put somebody under, drawn as a [spiral](#spiral) or [sigil](#sigil) filling the [screen](#screen) against a lurid ground. It became a stock [device](#device) for mind-control scenes from the late 2010s onward.

entries.name: imminent_bestiality
entries.description: The scene is arranged so that [sex](#sex) between a person and an [animal](#animal) is plainly about to start, whether through an obvious approach or an animal placed in a charged situation. Such pictures normally carry the [bestiality](#bestiality) [tag](#tag) as [well](#well).

entries.name: imminent_vore
entries.description: A character held at open jaws and about to be swallowed whole. The [swallowing](#swallowing) has not started.

entries.name: kankaku_shadan
entries.description: Tentacles work on a victim whose senses have been switched off by [magic](#magic) or a paralysing [poison](#poison), so the assault goes entirely unnoticed. Sensation usually floods [back](#back) all at once afterwards, and swelling or expansion often comes with it.

entries.name: implied_bestiality
entries.description: Signs that [sex](#sex) between a person and an [animal](#animal) has already happened, such as the animal still in frame afterwards or a pregnancy laid at its [door](#door). Explicit cases normally carry [bestiality](#bestiality) as [well](#well).

entries.name: egg_implantation
entries.description: Eggs pushed into a body, usually through the vagina or the [anus](#anus) and into the womb or rectum. The reverse case, a character [pushing](#pushing) eggs out, is [egg_laying](#egg_laying).

entries.name: body_control
entries.description: A character's body moves without their consent while their mind stays their own. A thought [bubble](#bubble) or a [horrified](#horrified) face is often the only [sign](#sign) that they know what is being done with them.

entries.name: robot_sex
entries.description: Sexual activity involving a [machine](#machine) partner, humanoid, animal-shaped or otherwise. Androids that pass as human are treated separately from robots for this purpose.

entries.name: sex_toy
entries.description: Any [toy](#toy) or [device](#device) made for sexual use, such as a [dildo](#dildo), [vibrator](#vibrator), or onahole, whether used alone or with a partner. Add the specific toy [tag](#tag) where it [can](#can) be identified.

entries.name: condom
entries.description: A condom in any state: still wrapped, held out, worn or spent. Numerous narrower tags [cover](#cover) the specifics, among them [condom_wrapper](#condom_wrapper), [condom_on_penis](#condom_on_penis) and [used_condom](#used_condom).

entries.name: dildo
entries.description: An artificial [penis](#penis) meant for [masturbation](#masturbation) or play, sometimes doubling as a [vibrator](#vibrator) or fitted into a [strap-on](#strap-on) [harness](#harness). Reserve it for a purpose-made [toy](#toy): an ordinary object that merely looks phallic is [phallic_symbol](#phallic_symbol).

entries.name: vibrator
entries.description: A vibrating [sex](#sex) [toy](#toy), typically egg- or bullet-shaped, used on the [clitoris](#clitoris), [nipples](#nipples) or [penis](#penis) or inserted into the body. Add placement tags such as [vibrator_under_clothes](#vibrator_under_clothes), [vibrator_in_thighhighs](#vibrator_in_thighhighs) or [vibrator_on_nipple](#vibrator_on_nipple) as needed.

entries.name: used_condom
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) after use, typically knotted and filled with semen, [lying](#lying) discarded or held up for view. One still worn on the [penis](#penis) is [used_condom_on_penis](#used_condom_on_penis) instead.

entries.name: anal_beads
entries.description: A [string](#string) of [beads](#beads) made to be pushed into the [anus](#anus) one at a time. Where they are actually inserted rather than simply held or displayed, add [anal](#anal).

entries.name: condom_wrapper
entries.description: The small sealed [packet](#packet) a [condom](#condom) comes in, unopened or [torn](#torn), held in a hand or the [teeth](#teeth) or dropped beside the [bed](#bed).

entries.name: butt_plug
entries.description: A flared [sex](#sex) [toy](#toy) made to sit inside the [anus](#anus), shown inserted or [lying](#lying) to one side. Jewelled ends and fake tails are common [decorations](#decorations).

entries.name: egg_vibrator
entries.description: A small egg- or bullet-shaped [vibrator](#vibrator), usually on a cord [running](#running) to a separate control. Often taped to the body or slipped under clothing.

entries.name: anal_tail
entries.description: A plug or [string](#string) of [beads](#beads) finished with an [animal](#animal) [tail](#tail), worn so the character appears to have one. It reads as a [costume](#costume) piece and a [toy](#toy) at once.

entries.name: condom_in_mouth
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) held between the [teeth](#teeth) or [lips](#lips), either still in its wrapper or already used. Usually an invitation to [sex](#sex), or the first move in [rolling](#rolling) it on by mouth.

entries.name: condom_on_penis
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) worn on a [penis](#penis), before, during or after [sex](#sex). Once pulled off and set aside it is [used_condom](#used_condom).

entries.name: remote_control_vibrator
entries.description: A [vibrator](#vibrator) operated through a remote, wired or [wireless](#wireless), often shown worn under clothing while someone else holds the control. Tag with vibrator; the remote itself may be in another character's hand.

entries.name: strap-on
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) mounted on a [harness](#harness) worn at the [crotch](#crotch), [giving](#giving) the wearer a [penis](#penis) to use on a partner.

entries.name: hitachi_magic_wand
entries.description: A [wand](#wand) [vibrator](#vibrator): a microphone-shaped massager with a large rounded white or grey head. It is a vibrator, and quite distinct from [denki_anma](#denki_anma), which is an act rather than a [device](#device).

entries.name: holding_condom
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) is in the hand, still packaged or already unwrapped, often held out or about to be put on. It generally sets up a [sex](#sex) scene.

entries.name: artificial_vagina
entries.description: A tubular [masturbation](#masturbation) sleeve, its [opening](#opening) moulded as a vulva, an [anus](#anus) or a mouth. Also known as an onahole or fleshlight.

entries.name: sex_machine
entries.description: A mechanical [device](#device) that thrusts a [dildo](#dildo) to simulate intercourse, a motorised step up from a [vibrator](#vibrator). Often appears in BDSM scenes with the subject [restrained](#restrained).

entries.name: vibrator_cord
entries.description: The [wire](#wire) [running](#running) from a [vibrator](#vibrator) to its [controller](#controller) is visible, often trailing out from under clothing or between the [legs](#legs). Usually indicates a hidden [egg](#egg) vibrator in use.

entries.name: condom_packet_strip
entries.description: Several individually sealed condoms still joined together in one perforated strip. It may be dangled from a hand, hung from the [teeth](#teeth) or simply left [lying](#lying) within reach.

entries.name: milking_machine
entries.description: A suction [device](#device) fitted with cups over the [nipples](#nipples) that draws out [milk](#milk), whether a breast [pump](#pump) used on a lactating woman or an [industrial](#industrial) milker applied to a person or [animal](#animal). Usually paired with [lactation](#lactation).

entries.name: multiple_condoms
entries.description: Several condoms visible at once — a heap of used ones, a strip still sealed in its wrappers, or a scattering across the scene. The number rather than the use is what is recorded.

entries.name: lube
entries.description: Sexual lubricant, shown either as its [bottle](#bottle) or as the slick gel spread over genitals, toys or hands. It nearly always appears in explicit scenes.

entries.name: condom_belt
entries.description: Used condoms strung around the waist or body like a [belt](#belt), kept as a [tally](#tally) or shown off as a [trophy](#trophy). Worn on the leg instead it becomes [condom_thigh_strap](#condom_thigh_strap).

entries.name: pointless_condom
entries.description: A [condom](#condom), its used remains, or its wrapper is present, yet the act still finishes without it [serving](#serving) its purpose. Applies to deliberate carelessness, not to a condom that broke by [accident](#accident).

entries.name: nipple_clamps
entries.description: Small sprung clips pinched onto the [nipples](#nipples) for stimulation or for [pain](#pain). They are sometimes weighted or joined to one another by a [chain](#chain).

entries.name: double_dildo
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) shaped for penetration at both ends, used either for double penetration or by two [people](#people) [sharing](#sharing) the one [toy](#toy).

entries.name: chastity_cage
entries.description: A [cage](#cage) locked over the [penis](#penis) to prevent [erection](#erection) and contact, worn for erotic [denial](#denial). A chastity [belt](#belt) wraps the whole [crotch](#crotch) instead.

entries.name: holding_sex_toy
entries.description: A [sex](#sex) [toy](#toy) such as a [dildo](#dildo) or a [vibrator](#vibrator) is held, shown off or about to be used. Once it is in use on a body, the act itself is what gets tagged.

entries.name: vibrator_in_thighhighs
entries.description: A [vibrator](#vibrator) or its remote is tucked into the top of a thigh-high stocking to keep it from [slipping](#slipping). When it is held by a [strap](#strap) around the thigh instead, use [vibrator_in_thigh_strap](#vibrator_in_thigh_strap).

entries.name: dilation_tape
entries.description: Strips of adhesive [tape](#tape) [stuck](#stuck) across the skin to hold a woman's labia pulled apart. Keeping the genitals held open on [display](#display) is the whole purpose, so the tape is drawn stretched taut to either side.

entries.name: condom_box
entries.description: A retail [box](#box) of condoms in the picture, often left on a [nightstand](#nightstand) as a hint of what is coming.

entries.name: cock_ring
entries.description: A [ring](#ring) worn around the base of the [penis](#penis) to hold [blood](#blood) in and keep an [erection](#erection); some versions vibrate. Not to be mixed up with a genital [piercing](#piercing) or a [chastity_cage](#chastity_cage).

entries.name: used_condom_on_penis
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) filled with semen while still worn on the [penis](#penis). Once removed, the correct [tag](#tag) becomes [used_condom](#used_condom) instead.

entries.name: huge_dildo
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) much larger than an average [penis](#penis), whether in use, held or simply [lying](#lying) about. Ordinary sizes take [plain](#plain) dildo.

entries.name: chastity_belt
entries.description: A locking covering over the [crotch](#crotch) that blocks sexual contact, built for long wear and now mostly a [device](#device) for erotic [denial](#denial). A chastity [cage](#cage) encloses the [penis](#penis) alone rather than [wrapping](#wrapping) the waist.

entries.name: pearl_thong
entries.description: A [thong](#thong) whose [crotch](#crotch) is a strand of [beads](#beads) that rides between the labia, worn for the stimulation it gives as the wearer moves.

entries.name: jewel_butt_plug
entries.description: An [anal](#anal) plug whose flared base holds a faceted stone, so all that shows between the buttocks is a bright [gem](#gem). The rest of the [toy](#toy) stays inside.

entries.name: vibrator_in_thigh_strap
entries.description: The [toy](#toy), or more usually its remote control, tucked into a band around the thigh so it cannot slip. When a stocking does that job instead, the legwear wording applies.

entries.name: condom_left_inside
entries.description: The [condom](#condom) has stayed behind inside a vagina or [anus](#anus) instead of on the [penis](#penis) or [toy](#toy) it was rolled onto. Nearly always drawn after the act.

entries.name: dildo_under_clothes
entries.description: An inserted [dildo](#dildo) kept hidden under ordinary [dress](#dress), given away only by a ridge or a [bulge](#bulge) in the [fabric](#fabric). The [clothes](#clothes) stay on and the [toy](#toy) is never seen directly.

entries.name: too_many_sex_toys
entries.description: A [pile](#pile) of toys [well](#well) past use: roughly four or more in the picture, three or so for each person present, either laid out ready or already used.

entries.name: public_vibrator
entries.description: A [vibrator](#vibrator) worn or used somewhere open to view, often hidden under clothing while its wearer tries to keep composure. A remote-controlled [model](#model) being triggered by someone else is a common variation.

entries.name: penis_ribbon
entries.description: A [ribbon](#ribbon) tied round a [penis](#penis), usually near the base, to hold [back](#back) [ejaculation](#ejaculation). It turns up most often on [otoko_no_ko](#otoko_no_ko) characters.

entries.name: flat_chastity_cage
entries.description: A locking chastity [device](#device) built as a flat perforated [plate](#plate) rather than a [tube](#tube), [holding](#holding) the [penis](#penis) pressed down against the body.

entries.name: dildo_under_panties
entries.description: Panties pulled up over an inserted [dildo](#dildo), the [fabric](#fabric) pressing it into place. If the [toy](#toy) also vibrates, the [vibrator](#vibrator) spelling of this applies alongside it.

entries.name: colored_condom
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) tinted a visible colour instead of the usual near-clear [latex](#latex). The colour is what the [tag](#tag) records; the condom may be worn, held or discarded.

entries.name: breast_pump
entries.description: A suction [device](#device) that draws [milk](#milk) out of human [breasts](#breasts) into an attached [bottle](#bottle). Gear built for animals is a [milking_machine](#milking_machine), though every breast [pump](#pump) is one of those too.

entries.name: dildo_harness
entries.description: Straps buckled around the hips that hold a [dildo](#dildo) jutting forward, the mount that turns a [toy](#toy) into a [strap-on](#strap-on). The rig itself is what the [tag](#tag) names, fitted or empty.

entries.name: speculum
entries.description: A hinged medical [instrument](#instrument) used to hold a body cavity open for examination, most often the vagina. Frequent as a prop in Japanese adult media, where it is used to [display](#display) an internal [ejaculation](#ejaculation).

entries.name: horse_dildo
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) modelled on an equine [penis](#penis), notably long and thick with a flared shape. It turns up mostly in [furry](#furry) and hyper-scaled work.

entries.name: spiked_dildo
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) whose shaft is covered in [studs](#studs), [ribs](#ribs), or barbs rather than left smooth. Includes toys modeled on [animal](#animal) [anatomy](#anatomy).

entries.name: rabbit_vibrator
entries.description: An insertable [vibrator](#vibrator) with a small branching arm partway up the shaft, angled to press against the [clitoris](#clitoris) while the main body sits inside. The side attachment is what separates it from a [plain](#plain) [dildo](#dildo).

entries.name: condom_wrapper_in_clothes
entries.description: An unopened [condom](#condom) [packet](#packet) tucked into clothing, into a waistband, a stocking top or a [bra](#bra) [cup](#cup). Used condoms strung through [clothes](#clothes) are [condom_belt](#condom_belt).

entries.name: dilation_belt
entries.description: A [strap](#strap) fitted with hooks or clamps at each end, used to hold the [anus](#anus) or vagina open. Restraint gear rather than something inserted.

entries.name: urethral_beads
entries.description: A linked [string](#string) of [beads](#beads) made to be pushed into the [urethra](#urethra) for stimulation. The [device](#device) itself is what earns the [tag](#tag), whether shown in use or [resting](#resting) on its own.

entries.name: sex_toy_pull
entries.description: A [string](#string) of [beads](#beads) or a similar [toy](#toy) is being drawn [back](#back) out of an orifice, the [tug](#tug) [caught](#caught) in mid-motion.

entries.name: wireless_sex_toy_controller
entries.description: A handheld remote that drives a [vibrator](#vibrator) or similar [toy](#toy) from a distance with [no](#no) [wire](#wire) connecting the two. It is often held by a second person while the toy itself stays hidden under clothing.

entries.name: broken_condom
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) that has [split](#split) or [torn](#torn), generally by [accident](#accident). Where the damage was done on purpose, the sabotage [tag](#tag) covers it instead.

entries.name: ball_bra
entries.description: A small [harness](#harness) cut like a brassiere but fitted around the scrotum, cupping and lifting the [testicles](#testicles). It is fetish hardware rather than a garment.

entries.name: suction_cup_dildo
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) fitted with a flat suction base, made to [stick](#stick) to a wall or [floor](#floor) so it [can](#can) be ridden without needing to be held. Implies dildo.

entries.name: condom_thigh_strap
entries.description: Used condoms threaded onto a [strap](#strap) worn around the thigh and displayed like trophies. It is the leg-worn form of the [condom_belt](#condom_belt) [idea](#idea).

entries.name: used_artificial_vagina
entries.description: A sleeve-style [masturbation](#masturbation) [toy](#toy) shown after use, [wet](#wet) or [leaking](#leaking). The spent state of the [device](#device) is what the [tag](#tag) records.

entries.name: sex_doll
entries.description: A life-size [doll](#doll) shaped like a person and built for sexual use, either inflatable or firm-bodied. It may be posed as a partner or simply left [lying](#lying) in the scene.

entries.name: breeding_mount
entries.description: A padded [dummy](#dummy) that a stallion is trained to mount so semen [can](#can) be collected. In art it serves as an oversized [toy](#toy) for characters with very large genitals, often fitted with handles at the sides for a humanoid user.

entries.name: aneros
entries.description: A small curved [toy](#toy) shaped to press against the [prostate](#prostate) from inside, used without hands. Japanese work generally calls it by a local trade name instead.

entries.name: implied_vibrator
entries.description: No [vibrator](#vibrator) is visible, yet enough points to one being in use: a stray remote or cord, a shape under [cloth](#cloth), a character reacting to something unseen. The paraphernalia does the work.

entries.name: implied_tail_plug
entries.description: An [animal](#animal) [tail](#tail) worn as though held on by a plug, with the plug itself out of sight. The way the tail meets the body is the only clue.

entries.name: used_condom_in_clothes
entries.description: A spent [condom](#condom) has been tucked into or under clothing, very often into the band of [thighhighs](#thighhighs). Where it instead hangs from a [strap](#strap) or the ties of [crotchless](#crotchless) [panties](#panties), [condom_belt](#condom_belt) is the right [tag](#tag).

entries.name: condom_on_nipples
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) fitted over a nipple, either knotted round its base or stretched across the breast so it fills with [milk](#milk). Related tags are [tied_nipples](#tied_nipples) and lactation_into_condom.

entries.name: sabotaged_condom
entries.description: A [condom](#condom) deliberately tampered with so it will fail, usually pierced with a [needle](#needle). It counts even while still sealed in its wrapper, before use.

entries.name: lubrication
entries.description: A slippery substance has been worked over skin or genitals to cut friction, leaving everything [shining](#shining) and slick. It marks the act of applying it or the state it leaves behind.

entries.name: sybian
entries.description: A saddle-shaped [riding](#riding) [machine](#machine) with a vibrating attachment set into the seat. The rider straddles and sits down onto it while the motor does the work.

entries.name: dragon_dildo
entries.description: A [dildo](#dildo) moulded after something other than a human [penis](#penis): an [animal](#animal) shape, a tentacle, a ridged or knotted [fantasy](#fantasy) form. Usually oversized and in bright colours.

entries.name: condom_in_hair
entries.description: A [condom](#condom), generally a spent one, [caught](#caught) or draped in a character's hair. It reads as aftermath rather than as use.

entries.name: food_dildo
entries.description: A [vegetable](#vegetable), [fruit](#fruit) or sweet used in place of a manufactured [dildo](#dildo). Cucumbers, bananas and carrots are the usual stand-ins.

entries.name: censored
entries.description: Part of the picture, most often genitals and sometimes [nipples](#nipples), has been hidden under an added obstruction: mosaics, black or shaded [bars](#bars), blank white light, inverted colour. Something already in the scene that happens to fall across the area, such as a [lock](#lock) of hair, is [convenient_censoring](#convenient_censoring) instead.

entries.name: uncensored
entries.description: Genitals, [sex](#sex) acts or fluids are drawn plainly with [no](#no) mosaic, bar or other covering applied by the artist. Concerns only what would ordinarily be covered, not [nipples](#nipples) or hidden parts; a third-party removal of an original [cover](#cover) is [decensored](#decensored) instead, and both tags [can](#can) apply if just one [figure](#figure) in a scene is left [plain](#plain).

entries.name: mosaic_censoring
entries.description: Explicit detail hidden beneath a block of coarse pixels, the standard Japanese method of censoring. A solid opaque stripe laid over the same area is a bar censor instead.

entries.name: bar_censor
entries.description: A solid [rectangle](#rectangle), most often black or white, laid over genitals or another part to hide it. It is also used as a joke or to conceal who somebody is; other methods include [mosaic_censoring](#mosaic_censoring) and [convenient_censoring](#convenient_censoring).

entries.name: convenient_censoring
entries.description: Smoke, an object, a limb or a fall of hair happens to sit exactly where genitals or [nipples](#nipples) would be, [hiding](#hiding) them against all odds. A character deliberately covering up does not count, and added [bars](#bars) or mosaics are [censored](#censored) instead.

entries.name: pointless_censoring
entries.description: Censoring that hides nothing: a bar too thin to [cover](#cover) anything, a mosaic so fine the detail stays visible, or a censor placed where there is nothing to hide. Such token censoring gets around publishing rules while still showing everything.

entries.name: heart_censor
entries.description: A [heart](#heart) placed over genitals, [nipples](#nipples) or another explicit spot so that it does the covering. That makes it censoring, unlike a heart drawn purely for decoration.

entries.name: out-of-frame_censoring
entries.description: Nudity is hidden by the crop itself, the genitals or a nipple [falling](#falling) just past the edge of the picture. The framing does the work a censor bar would.

entries.name: hair_censor
entries.description: Long hair arranged so it covers the [nipples](#nipples) or [crotch](#crotch) of an otherwise exposed body, a form of convenient censoring.

entries.name: cropped_censoring
entries.description: The picture is trimmed so that genitals or other explicit detail fall outside the frame. The crop does the [hiding](#hiding), with [no](#no) bar, blur or mosaic laid over anything.

entries.name: maebari
entries.description: An adhesive strip or [sticker](#sticker) [stuck](#stuck) over the vulva, the [crotch](#crotch) counterpart of [pasties](#pasties). Once a crude way to satisfy censors, it now appears as an item in its own right; a plaster stuck there is [bandaid_on_pussy](#bandaid_on_pussy), a different object.

entries.name: convenient_hair
entries.description: Hair falls precisely across the chest or [crotch](#crotch) so that nothing is actually exposed. The concealment reads as luck rather than as modesty.

entries.name: convenient_leg
entries.description: A leg is placed so that it hides the [crotch](#crotch), whether [underwear](#underwear) is worn beneath or not. One of the chance forms of censoring.

entries.name: censored_nipples
entries.description: Nipples are covered by a bar, mosaic or comparable overlay laid on top of the drawing. Pasties, [tape](#tape) and anything else the character actually wears belong to the outfit and take different tags.

entries.name: novelty_censor
entries.description: Censoring done with something silly in place of a bar or mosaic, such as a cartoon face, a [mascot](#mascot) or an unrelated object pasted over the genitals.

entries.name: blur_censor
entries.description: Explicit [anatomy](#anatomy) is hidden under a smear of blur instead of [bars](#bars) or a mosaic. Softness from a shallow focus that happens to fall in the same place is not censoring.

entries.name: steam_censor
entries.description: Clouds of [steam](#steam) positioned to hide nudity, the classic bath-scene [cover](#cover). A form of [convenient_censoring](#convenient_censoring) that keeps the image looking natural.

entries.name: convenient_arm
entries.description: An arm, hand or fingers land across the [breasts](#breasts) or another intimate area and hide it, without the character meaning to [cover](#cover) up. One of the accidental forms of censoring.

entries.name: censored_identity
entries.description: A face or a pair of eyes is hidden behind a bar, blur or mosaic so the person cannot be recognised, in the manner of [news](#news) footage. It conceals who somebody is rather than anything sexual.

entries.name: blank_censor
entries.description: A whole body part, usually the genitals, replaced by a featureless [blob](#blob) of flat white or black. It differs from a bar or mosaic laid over [anatomy](#anatomy) that is still drawn underneath.

entries.name: tail_censor
entries.description: A [tail](#tail) positioned so it conveniently hides genitals or [nipples](#nipples) from view.

entries.name: light_censor
entries.description: Nipples or [crotch](#crotch) are hidden behind a shaft or glare of light. Rays from a real source in the scene, dappled [sunlight](#sunlight) included, count and are also [convenient_censoring](#convenient_censoring); a flat white or black cutout is [blank_censor](#blank_censor).

entries.name: character_censor
entries.description: A character, a character's head or a [mascot](#mascot) is dropped over the genitals or another sensitive area as a joke covering. One of the novelty censors.

entries.name: soap_censor
entries.description: Bath [foam](#foam) positioned over the [nipples](#nipples) or genitals of a [nude](#nude) character, a form of [convenient_censoring](#convenient_censoring) made specifically from [soap_bubbles](#soap_bubbles).

entries.name: scribble_censor
entries.description: Genitals or another explicit area hidden under quick, irregular scribbled lines. Often [confused](#confused) with [bar_censor](#bar_censor), but once the strokes carry two or more sharp turns it counts as [scribble](#scribble) instead.

entries.name: censored_text
entries.description: Writing is blocked out, commonly to hide swearing, using strikethroughs, [bars](#bars), mosaics or the [circle](#circle) that stands in for a syllable in Japanese. It covers lettering only, never body parts.

entries.name: transparent_censoring
entries.description: Censorship that is not fully opaque, leaving whatever it covers still readable on a close look. Most often shaped like a bar; if it hides essentially nothing, it edges into [pointless_censoring](#pointless_censoring) instead.

entries.name: censored_by_text
entries.description: Lettering is laid across part of the picture and does the [hiding](#hiding) itself, [blocking](#blocking) whatever sits beneath it. The reverse case, [writing](#writing) that has been blanked out, is [censored_text](#censored_text).

entries.name: ofuda_on_pussy
entries.description: A [paper](#paper) [talisman](#talisman) is pasted over the [crotch](#crotch) as a [maebari](#maebari), the single strip [hiding](#hiding) the vulva and nothing more. A [staple](#staple) of [shrine](#shrine) maiden and exorcism-themed pictures.

entries.name: tape_maebari
entries.description: A single strip of [tape](#tape) [stuck](#stuck) over the [crotch](#crotch) as the only covering, with everything around it left bare. Functions like a pastie for the [groin](#groin) and shows up in gravure-style [poses](#poses) and [swimsuit](#swimsuit) parodies.

entries.name: ofuda_on_nipples
entries.description: Paper talismans are [stuck](#stuck) over the [nipples](#nipples) in place of [pasties](#pasties), covering those and nothing else. The rest of the chest is left bare, so it usually accompanies otherwise [nude](#nude) figures.

entries.name: convenient_skirt
entries.description: A [skirt](#skirt) or [dress](#dress) hangs so the [crotch](#crotch) and backside stay hidden, in a way the pose or the movement would never really allow. The [cloth](#cloth) behaves exactly as the artist needs it to.

entries.name: star_censor
entries.description: A star shape laid over genitals or [nipples](#nipples) to hide them, in place of a [plain](#plain) bar or mosaic. Playful rather than discreet, and often coloured to match the rest of the picture.

entries.name: censored_food
entries.description: A dish is [pixelated](#pixelated) or blacked out as a joke about how appalling it looks, sparing the viewer the sight. Where the covering is really about a sexual resemblance or use, [sexually_suggestive](#sexually_suggestive) suits better.

entries.name: fake_censor
entries.description: A bar, mosaic or [sticker](#sticker) is laid over something that needs [no](#no) covering at all: a face, a hand, a [snack](#snack). The pointlessness is the joke.

entries.name: censored_with_cum
entries.description: So much semen coats the genitals or [breasts](#breasts) that nothing underneath [can](#can) be made out, the fluid doing the work a mosaic would. No bar or blur has been added on top of the drawing.

entries.name: censored_anus
entries.description: The [anus](#anus) is covered by a bar, mosaic or pasted-over [patch](#patch). Japanese censorship does not usually count it among the parts that must be hidden, so covering it here is the artist's own [choice](#choice).

entries.name: censored_gesture
entries.description: A hand [sign](#sign) is blanked out, generally a rude one such as a raised middle finger or a fig sign. Nothing sexual sits behind the covering, only the offensive [gesture](#gesture) itself.

entries.name: hair_over_crotch
entries.description: Long hair [falling](#falling) across the [groin](#groin), sometimes [hiding](#hiding) it completely. Where the strands do the hiding, [hair_censor](#hair_censor) belongs alongside it.

entries.name: censored_profanity
entries.description: A swear word in the picture is blanked out with symbols, a solid strip or a bleep mark. Everything around it stays perfectly readable, so only the one word disappears.

entries.name: convenient_head
entries.description: Another person's head, or a pair of [animal](#animal) ears, sits in the line of sight to somebody's private parts. The [blocking](#blocking) is arranged for the viewer, not by the characters.

entries.name: emoji_censor
entries.description: Emoji stickers pasted over part of the picture to hide what is beneath, in the manner of a [phone](#phone) screenshot. Laid across faces or bare skin, often as a joke rather than out of need.

entries.name: flower_censor
entries.description: Blossoms or loose [petals](#petals) laid over the parts of a body that would otherwise be exposed. One of the decorative ways of covering, as against a bar or a blur.

entries.name: wing_censor
entries.description: A wing positioned to hide the genitals or chest, [blocking](#blocking) explicit detail while still [reading](#reading) as a natural part of the scene. It belongs to the [family](#family) of convenient-censoring tags.

entries.name: censored_violence
entries.description: Gore is [pixelated](#pixelated) or blacked out the way broadcast [television](#television) masks a shot too grisly to show. Under the covering there is generally [heavy](#heavy) [bleeding](#bleeding), an open wound or exposed innards.

entries.name: tape_censor
entries.description: Strips of [tape](#tape) laid over [nipples](#nipples), genitals or another part of the picture so they cannot be seen. Reads as an object inside the scene rather than an overlay added afterward, and the strips often carry printed words.

entries.name: convenient_hand
entries.description: A hand, the character's own or somebody else's, ends up exactly where it blocks the view of bare skin. Nothing in the pose suggests it was meant to [cover](#cover) anything.

entries.name: peeing
entries.description: A character passing urine, shown in the act. Done for sexual purposes it goes by watersports, which is the same [tag](#tag); wetting oneself through clothing is [peeing_self](#peeing_self).

entries.name: pee
entries.description: Urine present in the picture as a [puddle](#puddle), a [stain](#stain), a [stream](#stream) or [liquid](#liquid) in a vessel, whether or not the act itself is shown. The act in progress is [peeing](#peeing).

entries.name: peeing_self
entries.description: Urinating into one's own [clothes](#clothes) rather than moving them aside first, whether from fear, laughter, desperation or as a fetish. The mark left behind is [wet_panties](#wet_panties) or a similar [tag](#tag).

entries.name: have_to_pee
entries.description: A character badly needs the [toilet](#toilet): [legs](#legs) crossed or clamped together, a hand at the [crotch](#crotch), a strained face, sometimes a [gauge](#gauge) drawn in to show how desperate. It often leads into wetting.

entries.name: toilet_use
entries.description: A character seated on or otherwise actively using a [toilet](#toilet). Add [peeing](#peeing) or [scat](#scat) when the act itself is shown.

entries.name: pee_stain
entries.description: A [wet](#wet) or yellowed [patch](#patch) left by urine on clothing, bedding, a [cushion](#cushion) or the ground. Deliberate marking counts as much as an [accident](#accident).

entries.name: urinal
entries.description: The wall-mounted or floor-standing fixture for urinating from a [standing](#standing) position, usually found in men's toilets. Female and unisex designs exist in real life but are rarely drawn.

entries.name: enema
entries.description: Fluid pushed into the rectum through a nozzle, [bag](#bag) or [syringe](#syringe). Drawn either as a clinical procedure or as play, with the recipient bent over or [lying](#lying) on one side.

entries.name: golden_shower
entries.description: One person urinating onto another. Where somebody urinates without a [target](#target), the [plain](#plain) [peeing](#peeing) tags apply instead.

entries.name: fart
entries.description: Intestinal [gas](#gas) is released, drawn as a puff, a stink [cloud](#cloud) or emphatic lettering. It appears both as [toilet](#toilet) humour and as a fetish subject.

entries.name: drinking_pee
entries.description: Urine being swallowed, the character's own or a partner's, taken straight from the source or out of a [container](#container).

entries.name: peeing_in_cup
entries.description: Urinating into a [cup](#cup) or a similarly small vessel, whether as a sample or as part of the scene.

entries.name: vomiting
entries.description: A character [throwing](#throwing) up, doubled over with their [stomach](#stomach) emptying through the mouth. Reserved for the act being drawn rather than merely suggested.

entries.name: vomit
entries.description: The expelled [stomach](#stomach) contents themselves, leaving the mouth or pooled on a surface. Add the act [tag](#tag) as [well](#well) when somebody is [caught](#caught) mid-heave.

entries.name: poop
entries.description: Droppings drawn for [comic](#comic) effect, typically as a neat brown [swirl](#swirl) with a curl on top. When the treatment turns sexual or genuinely repellent, [scat](#scat) is the [tag](#tag).

entries.name: urine_meter
entries.description: A drawn [gauge](#gauge) showing how full a character's [bladder](#bladder) is, common in desperation scenes. It may take the shape of a bar, [dial](#dial), percentage readout, [faucet](#faucet), filling [glass](#glass), or a detached bladder rendered as a [balloon](#balloon).

entries.name: bedwetting
entries.description: Urinating while asleep, shown as a [wet](#wet) [patch](#patch) [spreading](#spreading) across the sheets or pyjamas. The character is normally still in [bed](#bed) and [old](#old) enough for it to be mortifying.

entries.name: scat
entries.description: Faeces treated as the point of the picture: [watching](#watching) somebody defecate, handling or smearing it, or play built around it. Sits alongside watersports as a bodily-function fetish.

entries.name: bladder
entries.description: The organ that holds urine, shown as a swollen internal shape or through a cutaway view. It nearly always appears in the context of desperation or wetting rather than as [plain](#plain) [anatomy](#anatomy).

entries.name: catheter
entries.description: A slim medical [tube](#tube) fed into the body, in practice nearly always the urinary sort threaded up the [urethra](#urethra) to drain the [bladder](#bladder). Usually drawn taped down with a collection [bag](#bag) [hanging](#hanging) from it.

entries.name: burp
entries.description: Gas coming up noisily from the [stomach](#stomach) and out of the mouth, usually after a [heavy](#heavy) [meal](#meal) or a fizzy [drink](#drink). Drawn with the mouth open and often a lettered [sound](#sound) effect.

entries.name: pee_in_container
entries.description: Urine gathered in a [bottle](#bottle), [cup](#cup), [bag](#bag) or [jar](#jar), either [standing](#standing) full or being filled. The vessel and its contents together are what the [tag](#tag) names.

entries.name: vomiting_rainbows
entries.description: Bands of [rainbow](#rainbow) colour [pouring](#pouring) from an open mouth, either as an outright [fantasy](#fantasy) image or as a cheerful stand-in that hides real [vomit](#vomit). Comedy or cuteness is generally the point.

entries.name: menstruation
entries.description: The monthly [shedding](#shedding) of the uterine lining, drawn as [blood](#blood) along with the cramps and mood that come with it. Distinct from [bleeding](#bleeding) tied to a first sexual experience.

entries.name: menstrual_pad
entries.description: A disposable absorbent pad worn inside [underwear](#underwear) to catch menstrual [blood](#blood). Shown in its wrapper, already in place, or being changed.

entries.name: peed_self
entries.description: A character has [wet](#wet) themselves, the urine soaking through their [clothes](#clothes) and [running](#running) down their [legs](#legs). It names the aftermath rather than the act.

entries.name: pee_pad
entries.description: An absorbent [mat](#mat) laid on the [floor](#floor) for an [animal](#animal), or for a person in a [pet](#pet) role, to urinate on. Often placed under or around a litter [tray](#tray).

entries.name: hetero
entries.description: Romantic or sexual content between a male and a female character, mutual or one-sided. A feminine boy or a masculine girl still counts by [sex](#sex); add [couple](#couple) when the feeling runs both ways.

entries.name: yuri
entries.description: Romantic or sexual interaction between female characters, whether the feeling is shared or one-sided; add [couple](#couple) when both sides are involved. Pairings that include a [futanari](#futanari) character or a bisexual woman use their own dedicated tags instead.

entries.name: yaoi
entries.description: Romantic or sexual content between male characters, one-sided or mutual; add [couple](#couple) when it is mutual. Covers every male pairing including more masculine designs and [otoko_no_ko](#otoko_no_ko), with rating filters [standing](#standing) in for finer distinctions some readers draw.

entries.name: interracial
entries.description: Sex or romance between characters whose skin colours plainly differ, such as a pale partner with a dark-skinned one. Leave it off when the difference is slight or unclear, whatever the characters' stated backgrounds.

entries.name: interspecies
entries.description: Sex or romance across species, typically a human with a humanoid such as a [furry](#furry) character, a [robot](#robot), an [orc](#orc) or a monstrous humanoid. Pairings with [plain](#plain) animals count as [bestiality](#bestiality), not this.

entries.name: futa_with_female
entries.description: A [futanari](#futanari) and a female engaged in [sex](#sex) together. It is not combined with [yuri](#yuri) unless separate yuri interactions also appear, and a partner whose genitals cannot be seen is taken to be female.

entries.name: bestiality
entries.description: Sexual contact between a humanoid character and an [animal](#animal), [monster](#monster) or other non-humanoid [creature](#creature), judged purely on how the partner looks rather than on how clever it is in its own story. Sex with a humanoid of another species is [interspecies](#interspecies); [tag](#tag) both only when both occur.

entries.name: onee-shota
entries.description: A young boy paired with an older girl or woman in a romantic, risque or sexual scene. The name joins the words for an elder sister and a little boy.

entries.name: kodomo_doushi
entries.description: Sexual or romantic interaction between prepubescent children, with [no](#no) adult taking part. The name comes from a Japanese phrase meaning between children.

entries.name: furry_with_non-furry
entries.description: A [furry](#furry) and a human or humanoid character engaged sexually or romantically, a subset of [interspecies](#interspecies). A furry paired with a [plain](#plain) non-anthropomorphic [animal](#animal) is [bestiality](#bestiality) instead.

entries.name: bisexual_female
entries.description: A romantic or sexual grouping in which a woman is involved with both a man and another woman. The girl-on-girl element does not make it [yuri](#yuri), since a male takes part.

entries.name: futa_on_male
entries.description: A [futanari](#futanari) taking the dominant part with a male partner, generally as the one doing the penetrating. Belongs alongside [futa_with_male](#futa_with_male).

entries.name: futa_with_male
entries.description: A [futanari](#futanari) and a male engaged in [sex](#sex) together. Add [futa_on_male](#futa_on_male) or [male_on_futa](#male_on_futa) to say which of them is taking the dominant part.

entries.name: onee-loli
entries.description: A young girl paired with an older girl or woman in a romantic, risque or sexual scene. The name puts together the words for an elder sister and a small girl.

entries.name: futa_with_futa
entries.description: Two [futanari](#futanari) characters having [sex](#sex) with each other. It stands in place of [yuri](#yuri), since futanari pairings take none of [hetero](#hetero), yuri or [yaoi](#yaoi).

entries.name: furry_with_furry
entries.description: Two [furry](#furry) characters engaged with each other sexually or romantically. Any furry picture that would otherwise take [hetero](#hetero), [yuri](#yuri) or [yaoi](#yaoi) should carry this or [furry_with_non-furry](#furry_with_non-furry).

entries.name: selfcest
entries.description: A romantic or sexual pairing between two versions of one character, most often a character with their genderswapped self or a [split](#split) persona. Identical [twins](#twins) fall under [twincest](#twincest) instead, and non-sexual self-admiration is [narcissism](#narcissism).

entries.name: implied_yaoi
entries.description: A romantic or sexual relationship between men is pointed to without being shown, such as a man alone [carrying](#carrying) the marks of an offscreen encounter or picturing another man. The second man need only be referred to.

entries.name: implied_yuri
entries.description: A romance between women is referred to without being depicted: affection aimed at an absent girl, a [fantasy](#fantasy) about her, or doting on an object that stands in for her. The other woman need not appear at all.

entries.name: onii-shota
entries.description: A young boy paired with an older man in a romantic, risque or sexual scene. The name joins the words for an elder brother and a little boy.

entries.name: muscular_uke
entries.description: A big, heavily built man taking the submissive part opposite a noticeably smaller partner. It wants a clear size gap, and it does not apply to male-female scenes, where assertive female covers the same reversal.

entries.name: bisexual_male
entries.description: A grouping in which a man is involved with both a woman and another man. Do not add [yaoi](#yaoi) or [hetero](#hetero) on top unless a separate pairing in the picture earns one on its own.

entries.name: josou_seme
entries.description: A crossdresser or [otoko_no_ko](#otoko_no_ko) takes the active, penetrating role with a partner. The gap between the feminine presentation and the dominant part is the whole point.

entries.name: male_on_futa
entries.description: A male partner takes the active part with a [futanari](#futanari), which in practice means he does the penetrating. The reverse arrangement has its own [tag](#tag).

entries.name: queen_of_spades_symbol
entries.description: A black spade marked with a Q, or the letters QoS, worn as a [badge](#badge) signaling a sexual preference for black men. Commonly drawn as a [tattoo](#tattoo) or [sticker](#sticker) on the body, and the counterpart to the [queen](#queen) of hearts symbol.

entries.name: cuntboy_with_male
entries.description: A [cuntboy](#cuntboy) having [sex](#sex) with a male partner who is not one himself. Deliberately kept apart from [yaoi](#yaoi).

entries.name: newhalf_with_male
entries.description: A male character paired sexually with someone who has a [penis](#penis) and [no](#no) vagina. Yaoi does not follow automatically; add it only when male-on-male contact is shown as [well](#well).

entries.name: power_bottom
entries.description: The receiving partner runs the encounter, setting the pace and pinning or [riding](#riding) the other. The [label](#label) is about who holds control, not about the position used.

entries.name: newhalf_with_female
entries.description: A sexual scene between a female character and a partner who has a [penis](#penis) but [no](#no) vagina. Neither [hetero](#hetero) nor [yuri](#yuri) should be added unless those pairings also appear in the same picture.

entries.name: implied_bisexual
entries.description: Only one [sex](#sex) is on [screen](#screen), yet the scene points to contact with the other as [well](#well). Several women [playing](#playing) with semen is the stock example.

entries.name: other_with_male
entries.description: A pairing [label](#label) for a male character together with a partner outside male and female, such as a genderless [creature](#creature) or a construct. The counterpart to [other_with_female](#other_with_female).

entries.name: other_with_female
entries.description: A pairing [label](#label) for a female character together with a partner who is neither male nor female, such as a genderless being, a [creature](#creature) or a construct.

entries.name: reversible_couple
entries.description: A pair who trade the dominant and submissive roles between them instead of each sticking to one, whether or not the depiction is sexual. It [can](#can) appear within a single picture, across a related set of images, or without any [sex](#sex) act at all; two characters who [switch](#switch) roles only with different partners do not count.

entries.name: newhalf_with_newhalf
entries.description: Two partners who each have a [penis](#penis) and [no](#no) vagina, engaged with one another. Both bodies share the same configuration.

entries.name: naughty_face
entries.description: A smirking, mischievous look that says the character knows exactly what effect they are having. It is the expression of the [cat](#cat) that got the [cream](#cream).

entries.name: ahegao
entries.description: Eyes rolled [back](#back), mouth [hanging](#hanging) open and [tongue](#tongue) out, usually with [blush](#blush), drool and [sweat](#sweat) and sometimes a double V [sign](#sign). It stands for pleasure pushed past control, though it also serves for madness, [drugs](#drugs) or choking. The softer, trance-like version is [torogao](#torogao).

entries.name: orgasm
entries.description: A character is visibly climaxing, shown through the face, [trembling](#trembling), an arched [back](#back) or fluids. Applies to any [sex](#sex); [ejaculation](#ejaculation) and [female_ejaculation](#female_ejaculation) [cover](#cover) the physical side.

entries.name: fucked_silly
entries.description: A character so worn through by [sex](#sex) that their face shows nothing but euphoria or exhaustion. Reserved for extremes; an ordinary [ahegao](#ahegao) or similar face [tag](#tag) covers the rest.

entries.name: female_orgasm
entries.description: A woman at the peak of sexual climax. The usual signs are [ahegao](#ahegao) or a melted expression, deep [blush](#blush), an open mouth, [tears](#tears), drool and sometimes [female_ejaculation](#female_ejaculation).

entries.name: penis_awe
entries.description: A character stares in astonishment at a [penis](#penis) or something shaped like one, [wide-eyed](#wide-eyed) and often blushing or [drooling](#drooling). Size is usually the cause.

entries.name: torogao
entries.description: A [dazed](#dazed), [melting](#melting) look of quiet pleasure: flushed cheeks, drooping brows, half-lidded moist eyes and often drool, with the limbs gone slack. Usually a sexual reaction but sometimes just a food-tasting expression; the wilder, more frantic version is [ahegao](#ahegao).

entries.name: female_pervert
entries.description: A girl or woman behaving openly lecherously: leering, [groping](#groping), [drooling](#drooling) over somebody. The female form of [pervert](#pervert).

entries.name: aroused
entries.description: A character is visibly turned on, with flushed skin, quickened [breathing](#breathing) and a needy or unfocused look, whether from touch, kissing or being watched. Tag whatever is causing it as [well](#well).

entries.name: after_ejaculation
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) shown going soft in the seconds after it has finished, the semen already released. It marks the calm past climax rather than the spurt itself.

entries.name: forced_orgasm
entries.description: A character brought to climax against their will, typically [bound](#bound) and worked over with a [vibrator](#vibrator) or a [machine](#machine). It pairs naturally with [bondage](#bondage) and dominance scenes.

entries.name: in_heat
entries.description: A female overtaken by [animal](#animal) rut: flushed face, panting, [sweat](#sweat) and unfocused eyes. It is used for characters with animal traits such as ears and a [tail](#tail), or for anthro ones.

entries.name: afterglow
entries.description: The warm, drowsy contentment two [people](#people) share once [sex](#sex) has wound down, shown through [cuddling](#cuddling), [spooning](#spooning), held hands, steady eye contact or dozing off together. It rests on their mood rather than on physical traces, and once they have separated the encounter is simply over.

entries.name: aroused_nosebleed
entries.description: Blood runs from the [nose](#nose) as shorthand for sudden arousal, a [convention](#convention) with [no](#no) basis in [anatomy](#anatomy). Played straight in erotic scenes and turned into a [gag](#gag) when the flow is absurd.

entries.name: premature_ejaculation
entries.description: A man climaxes almost as soon as he is touched, sometimes before penetration happens at all. Usually staged for his embarrassment or his partner's exasperation.

entries.name: mutual_orgasm
entries.description: Both partners climaxing at the same instant, shown through matched [expressions](#expressions) or simultaneous release. The shared timing is what sets it apart.

entries.name: happy_facial
entries.description: A character looks pleased or delighted with semen on their face. The cheerful expression is the whole point of the [tag](#tag), as against a shocked or reluctant one.

entries.name: wet_dream
entries.description: Someone asleep and plainly [aroused](#aroused), with an [erection](#erection), an [ejaculation](#ejaculation) or dampness happening as they dream, often leaving the sheets stained. The dream itself is sometimes drawn alongside the sleeper.

entries.name: no_panties

Not for [nude](#nude) or [bottomless](#bottomless) figures, nor for clothing that takes [no](#no) [underwear](#underwear) anyway; where it is only hinted at rather than shown, the [tag](#tag) is best left off.

entries.name: no_bra
entries.description: A top worn with nothing under it, made [plain](#plain) by sheer [fabric](#fabric), a lifted hem or an open [shirt](#shirt). Not for [nude](#nude) or [topless](#topless) figures, nor for clothing that would never be worn with a [bra](#bra).

entries.name: clothing_aside
entries.description: A garment that would normally [cover](#cover) the genitals has been dragged to one side and held there, baring them while still being worn. Generally shown during or just before [sex](#sex); [panties_aside](#panties_aside) and [swimsuit_aside](#swimsuit_aside) are the narrower spellings.

Panties lowered to the [thighs](#thighs) instead are [panty_pull](#panty_pull), and hauling on the waistband to shift them over is a [panty_lift](#panty_lift).

entries.name: panties_around_one_leg
entries.description: Panties pulled entirely off one leg and left [hanging](#hanging) around the other's ankle, knee or thigh. A common state during [sex](#sex) or [undressing](#undressing); merely lowered on both [legs](#legs), they are [panty_pull](#panty_pull).

entries.description: A nipple comes into view by [accident](#accident), typically when a loose top or [vest](#vest) worn without a [bra](#bra) falls open as the wearer leans forward. See-through or soaked [fabric](#fabric) is a different matter.
