entries.description: The [bra](#bra) has been shoved up above the [breasts](#breasts), which hang bare underneath it. Pulling it down below them instead is [bra_pull](#bra_pull), and a [camisole](#camisole) or similar top treated the same way is [shirt_lift](#shirt_lift).

entries.name: wedgie
entries.description: Underwear or another garment pulled up so the [fabric](#fabric) catches between the buttocks, either as a [prank](#prank) played on someone else or a provocative act performed on oneself. Thongs and [fundoshi](#fundoshi) sit there by design and aren't tagged this way; a garment wedged at the front instead is [frontal_wedgie](#frontal_wedgie).

entries.name: wardrobe_malfunction
entries.description: Clothing fails on its own, such as a [bra](#bra) [slipping](#slipping) or [fabric](#fabric) tearing, and exposes part of the body. Exposure caused by an outside force like a gust of [wind](#wind) is [accidental_exposure](#accidental_exposure) instead.

entries.name: crotchless
entries.description: Garments made with an [opening](#opening) at the [crotch](#crotch) that leaves the genitals or [underwear](#underwear) exposed. The gap must be by design: a tear is [torn_clothes](#torn_clothes) and a [fly](#fly) meant to stay shut is [open_fly](#open_fly). Add the narrower [tag](#tag) such as [crotchless_panties](#crotchless_panties) where it fits.

entries.name: bikini_pull
entries.description: The top or bottom of a [bikini](#bikini) pulled down or away from the body so what it covered comes into view. Narrow it to [bikini_bottom_pull](#bikini_bottom_pull) or [bikini_top_pull](#bikini_top_pull) where the picture allows.

entries.name: bra_pull
entries.description: The [bra](#bra) has been tugged down under the [breasts](#breasts) so the [nipples](#nipples) are uncovered. This is displaced clothing, not a [shelf](#shelf) or cupless bra that bares them by design, and lifting it upward instead is [bra_lift](#bra_lift).

entries.name: leotard_aside
entries.description: The [crotch](#crotch) panel of a [leotard](#leotard) is pulled to one side, baring the genitals for [sex](#sex) or [display](#display). Pulled down rather than [sideways](#sideways) it is [leotard_pull](#leotard_pull).

entries.name: bikini_bottom_aside
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) bottom pushed to one side so the vulva is exposed or within reach. The swimwear counterpart of [panties_aside](#panties_aside).

entries.name: swimsuit_aside
entries.description: The [crotch](#crotch) of a [swimsuit](#swimsuit) pulled to one side to expose the genitals beneath it, the swimwear counterpart to [panties_aside](#panties_aside).

entries.name: bikini_top_lift
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) top pushed up above the [breasts](#breasts), baring them while it remains around the chest. The swimwear equivalent of a [shirt](#shirt) or [bra](#bra) lift.

entries.name: breastless_clothes
entries.description: Clothing tailored to leave the [breasts](#breasts) fully exposed, such as a cupless [corset](#corset), a [bodysuit](#bodysuit) open across the chest or [bondage](#bondage) [lingerie](#lingerie). Smaller openings that show skin without baring the whole breast are [breast_cutout](#breast_cutout).

entries.name: crotchless_panties
entries.description: Panties made without a [crotch](#crotch) panel, leaving the genitals uncovered while the waistband and hips stay in place. For other garments cut this way, use [crotchless](#crotchless).

entries.name: breast_slip
entries.description: A whole breast has escaped a top, [bra](#bra) or [swimsuit](#swimsuit) by [accident](#accident), through movement or a loose fit. Only the nipple or areola showing is [nipple_slip](#nipple_slip) or [areola_slip](#areola_slip), and taking them out on purpose is [breasts_out](#breasts_out).

entries.name: heart_maebari
entries.description: An adhesive [crotch](#crotch) [cover](#cover) cut to a [heart](#heart) [outline](#outline), [stuck](#stuck) straight onto the skin. It is the only thing over the genitals, so nothing else is worn below the waist.

entries.name: crotch_cutout
entries.description: An [opening](#opening) built into a garment that leaves the [crotch](#crotch) exposed, often shaped as a [heart](#heart). Only for openings put there by design; a rip is [torn_clothes](#torn_clothes).

entries.name: cupless_bra
entries.description: A [bra](#bra) with [no](#no) cups, its frame encircling and lifting the [breasts](#breasts) while leaving them largely or entirely exposed. A bare underwire [shelf](#shelf) is [shelf_bra](#shelf_bra), and a nursing bra with access slits is a different thing again.

entries.name: penis_out
entries.description: A [penis](#penis) pulled out of clothing that would otherwise [cover](#cover) it, over a waistband or through a leg [opening](#opening), while the garment stays on. Only the base or the tip showing is [penis_peek](#penis_peek).

entries.name: nippleless_clothes
entries.description: A garment with openings through which the [nipples](#nipples) poke out while the [breasts](#breasts) stay otherwise covered. Baring the whole breast instead is [breastless_clothes](#breastless_clothes).

entries.name: accidental_exposure
entries.description: A character's body is uncovered by mistake, often without them noticing, whether through [slipping](#slipping) clothing, their own clumsiness or somebody else's. Baring oneself on purpose is [exhibitionism](#exhibitionism) instead.

entries.name: penis_peek
entries.description: Clothing pulled or cut low enough that the base or part of the shaft shows, or brief enough that only the tip or some of the [testicles](#testicles) appears. Once the whole shaft and head are out it becomes [penis_out](#penis_out).

entries.name: crotchless_pantyhose
entries.description: Pantyhose manufactured with an open [crotch](#crotch) rather than [torn](#torn) through, leaving whatever is beneath on show. One of the [crotchless](#crotchless) [family](#family).

entries.name: bikini_bottom_pull
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) bottom being dragged down, by the wearer or by somebody else, uncovering the hips or [crotch](#crotch). The swimwear form of [panty_pull](#panty_pull).

entries.name: buruma_aside
entries.description: Gym [shorts](#shorts) dragged to one side so the genitals are uncovered while the garment stays on. The [buruma](#buruma) counterpart of [panties_aside](#panties_aside) and [swimsuit_aside](#swimsuit_aside).

entries.name: nipple_cutout
entries.description: A garment cut with holes that leave the [nipples](#nipples) bare while the rest of the chest stays covered. The clothing is intact rather than pulled aside.

entries.name: penis_in_panties
entries.description: Somebody wearing [panties](#panties) whose [penis](#penis) is inside them and showing, past the waistband or through a leg [opening](#opening). Where nothing shows, [bulge](#bulge) covers it; panties wrapped around an unworn penis are [panties_on_penis](#panties_on_penis).

entries.name: bikini_top_pull
entries.description: The upper half of a [bikini](#bikini) dragged down below the [breasts](#breasts), which are left bare with the [fabric](#fabric) bunched beneath them. The wearer or another character may be doing the [pulling](#pulling).

entries.name: crotch_zipper
entries.description: A [zipper](#zipper) set directly over the [crotch](#crotch) whose job is to open or close that area rather than to hold the garment on. Common on bodysuits, often paired with one at the chest; an ordinary trouser [fly](#fly) is not this.

entries.name: thong_aside
entries.description: A [thong](#thong) is pulled to one side to expose the wearer's genitals, the thong equivalent of [panties_aside](#panties_aside).

entries.name: backless_panties
entries.description: Panties with a front panel over the [crotch](#crotch) and [no](#no) seat whatever, so the buttocks stay bare; the stated excuse is sometimes avoiding visible lines. The [swimsuit](#swimsuit) equivalent has its own [tag](#tag), and a seat with a single [hole](#hole) in it is an [ass](#ass) cutout.

entries.name: pants_around_one_leg
entries.description: Trousers dragged down and left bunched around a single leg, the other already pulled free. Typical of hurried [undressing](#undressing).

entries.name: frontless_outfit
entries.description: Clothing cut away along the centre line so the body is bare from chest to [crotch](#crotch) while [fabric](#fabric) remains at the sides. If the [back](#back) and flanks are opened just as far, some other [tag](#tag) fits better.

entries.name: panties_around_ankles
entries.description: The [panties](#panties) have been pushed all the way down and hang slack around both ankles, still on the wearer. Slipped off one foot and left [dangling](#dangling) from the other, they are [panties_around_one_ankle](#panties_around_one_ankle).

entries.name: panties_around_one_ankle
entries.description: Removed [panties](#panties) left looped around a single ankle, the other leg already clear of them. Around both ankles they are [panties_around_ankles](#panties_around_ankles).

entries.name: presenting_removed_panties
entries.description: A pair of [panties](#panties), just taken off, is dangled or held out toward the viewer. The wearer is often still dressed otherwise, with the garment itself the subject.

entries.name: pussy_cutout
entries.description: An [opening](#opening) cut into a garment so the vulva shows through while the rest stays covered. Crotchless [underwear](#underwear) and a [bodysuit](#bodysuit) with a gap at the [crotch](#crotch) are the usual forms.

entries.name: crotchless_pants
entries.description: Trousers built with the [crotch](#crotch) left open. Where the gap is the result of damage instead, reach for [torn_clothes](#torn_clothes).

entries.name: clitoris_slip
entries.description: Clothing has shifted just enough for the [clitoris](#clitoris) or its [hood](#hood) to peek out while the rest of the vulva stays covered. If [no](#no) clitoris shows, it is some other kind of slip.

entries.name: bikini_top_aside
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) top shoved to one side so a breast comes free while the garment stays on the body. Pulling it down instead uncovers both and is [bikini_top_pull](#bikini_top_pull).

entries.name: bikini_around_one_leg
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) bottom pulled down far enough to hang from a single leg, leaving the [crotch](#crotch) uncovered. When it stays stretched across both [legs](#legs), [bikini_pull](#bikini_pull) is the right [tag](#tag).

entries.name: cupless_bikini
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) top with [no](#no) cups, made from bands that [ring](#ring) the [breasts](#breasts) and push them up and outward. Designs vary a great deal and may or may not leave the [nipples](#nipples) covered.

entries.name: no_male_underwear
entries.description: A man wearing trousers or [shorts](#shorts) with nothing beneath them. With [no](#no) lower garment at all use [bottomless](#bottomless); the female counterparts are [no_panties](#no_panties) and [no_bra](#no_bra).

entries.name: crotchless_leotard
entries.description: A [leotard](#leotard) cut away at the [crotch](#crotch), so the genitals are bare while the garment still clings to the [torso](#torso) and shoulders. The [opening](#opening) is deliberate.

entries.name: fundoshi_aside
entries.description: A [fundoshi](#fundoshi) pushed [sideways](#sideways) to uncover the genitals while the garment itself stays on. Dragging it down the [legs](#legs) instead is [fundoshi_pull](#fundoshi_pull).

entries.name: male_underwear_aside
entries.description: Men's [underwear](#underwear) pushed to one side so the genitals are out while the garment stays on, letting [sex](#sex) happen without taking it off. Dragging it down to the [thighs](#thighs) instead is [male_underwear_pull](#male_underwear_pull).

entries.name: dress_aside
entries.description: The [skirt](#skirt) of a [dress](#dress) pulled to one side to expose what is under it while the garment stays on. The dress-specific form of [clothing_aside](#clothing_aside).

entries.name: backless_pants
entries.description: Trousers cut away at the seat so that the buttocks are exposed while the [legs](#legs) stay covered. Chaps-like fetish wear is the usual form.

entries.name: breastless_leotard
entries.description: A [leotard](#leotard) cut away over the chest so the [breasts](#breasts) are left uncovered by design. An open-bust cut is a different thing, since it frames and supports them from below.

entries.name: buruma_around_one_leg
entries.description: Gym [shorts](#shorts) pulled off far enough to hang around a single leg, left half worn. Almost always part of an [undressing](#undressing) or sexual scene.

entries.name: crotchless_swimsuit
entries.description: A [swimsuit](#swimsuit) whose seat stays intact while the panel over the [crotch](#crotch) is missing, baring the genitals from the front only.

entries.name: crotchless_bikini
entries.description: A [bikini](#bikini) whose bottom has [no](#no) [crotch](#crotch) panel, so the genitals stay bare while the rest of the garment sits normally. Cut that way rather than pulled aside.

entries.name: anus_cutout
entries.description: A garment carries an [opening](#opening) over the [anus](#anus), leaving it bare while everything around it stays covered. The clothing is made that way rather than pulled aside.

entries.name: anal_ball_wear
entries.description: A scanty garment, often a slingshot [swimsuit](#swimsuit), that stays on only because it is tied to [beads](#beads) or a plug pushed into the [anus](#anus). The insertion does the work a [strap](#strap) would normally do.

entries.name: breast_drop
entries.description: The [breasts](#breasts) come free of whatever was [holding](#holding) them, a [bra](#bra), a [shirt](#shirt), a [swimsuit](#swimsuit) or a pair of hands, and [swing](#swing) into place as they fall. It is that instant of release the [tag](#tag) records.

entries.name: bikini_bottom_around_leg
entries.description: The lower piece of a [bikini](#bikini) slipped off and left [dangling](#dangling) around one leg rather than worn or removed. The same displacement that [bikini_around_one_leg](#bikini_around_one_leg) records.

entries.name: cupless_babydoll
entries.description: A short sheer nightdress built without cups, so the [breasts](#breasts) sit bare above the [fabric](#fabric) while the rest hangs loose from beneath them. Lingerie designed to [display](#display) rather than [cover](#cover).

entries.name: loincloth_lift
entries.description: The [hanging](#hanging) flap of a [loincloth](#loincloth) is raised at the front or the [back](#back), uncovering what it normally conceals. The garment itself stays on; only the panel moves.

entries.name: underwear_around_one_leg
entries.description: Underwear has been pulled off one leg entirely and dangles from the other ankle, knee or thigh. Typical of a partial [undressing](#undressing) during [sex](#sex), leaving the [crotch](#crotch) fully exposed while the garment stays on the wearer.

entries.name: crotchless_bloomers
entries.description: Bloomers made with the [crotch](#crotch) open, leaving the genitals exposed while the loose [legs](#legs) still [cover](#cover) the [thighs](#thighs). The gap is part of the design.

entries.name: guro
entries.description: Extreme graphic [violence](#violence), mutilation or disfigurement in the grotesque tradition. Reserved for real brutality: mere [blood](#blood), body horror or visible [organs](#organs) without extreme violence should use blood or a similar [tag](#tag) instead.

entries.name: asphyxiation
entries.description: A character cannot breathe, whether choking on something, [drowning](#drowning), being strangled or otherwise cut off from air, including those who have died of it. Tag whatever causes it as [well](#well).

entries.name: ryona
entries.description: A woman shown in extreme [pain](#pain), [beaten](#beaten) or bruised, with the suffering itself presented as the sexual appeal. Common in [wrestling](#wrestling) art; not the same as [guro](#guro) or [plain](#plain) [abuse](#abuse). Male victims go under [reverse_ryona](#reverse_ryona).

entries.name: corpse
entries.description: A dead human body in the picture, whether freshly killed, left on a [battlefield](#battlefield) or laid out in a horror scene. A dead [animal](#animal) takes a [tag](#tag) of its own.

entries.name: torture
entries.description: Deliberate infliction of severe [pain](#pain), physical or psychological, on someone helpless. Add [restrained](#restrained), [blood](#blood) or the specific method for a fuller description of the scene.

entries.name: impaled
entries.description: A body run right through by something long and sharp: a blade, a [spear](#spear), a spike, a horn. The harmless magical version, where a [weapon](#weapon) is simply drawn out of somebody, is [human_scabbard](#human_scabbard).

entries.name: severed_head
entries.description: A head cut off from its body, shown [lying](#lying), held, or displayed. The act itself is [decapitation](#decapitation); [tag](#tag) [guro](#guro) where the gore is graphic.

entries.name: holding_detached_head
entries.description: A head that is off its body is carried, either the character's own in the manner of a [dullahan](#dullahan) or somebody else's severed one. Gripping a head still attached is [head_grab](#head_grab).

entries.name: decapitation
entries.description: A head being severed from a body, with the character [dying](#dying) of it. A head detached while its owner carries on living is [disembodied_head](#disembodied_head), and the loose body part on its own is [severed_head](#severed_head).

entries.name: hanged
entries.description: A body suspended by a [noose](#noose) around the [neck](#neck), as an [execution](#execution) or a [suicide](#suicide). Non-lethal [dangling](#dangling) is [hanging](#hanging), and [rope](#rope) [suspension](#suspension) as a [bondage](#bondage) posture is suspension.

entries.name: intestines
entries.description: Bowels are on show, generally [spilling](#spilling) from an opened [belly](#belly) or laid bare in a deep wound. A cut-away or [x-ray](#x-ray) view of them inside an intact body counts as [well](#well).

entries.name: severed_limb
entries.description: One or more limbs detached from a body and visible in the picture. A character who lacks a limb is [amputee](#amputee); the two combine when both the person and the cut-off limb are shown.

entries.name: ero_guro
entries.description: Gore combined with [pornography](#pornography) — [sex](#sex) or nudity alongside mutilation, wounds or [death](#death). Violence without the sexual side is [plain](#plain) [guro](#guro).

entries.name: murder
entries.description: One character deliberately killing another, or [standing](#standing) over someone already killed. Deaths in a fair fight, accidents and mercy killings fall outside it, and a killing kept off the page is implied murder.

entries.name: cannibalism
entries.description: A character [eating](#eating) its own kind: a human eating a human, or a humanoid eating a humanoid. It also covers a person butchered, cooked or laid out on a [table](#table) to be eaten.

entries.name: organs
entries.description: Internal viscera on show: [brain](#brain), [heart](#heart), lungs, [intestines](#intestines) and the like. Anatomical illustration, characters designed with their insides visible and organs simply [lying](#lying) about are not automatically gore, which is for displaced organs where the [pain](#pain) or the fetish is the point.

entries.name: execution
entries.description: Somebody is being put to [death](#death) as a formal [punishment](#punishment), [bound](#bound) and helpless before a [noose](#noose), a block, a [firing](#firing) squad, a [stake](#stake) or a [guillotine](#guillotine). It need not have happened yet, so long as it plainly will.

entries.name: severed_arm
entries.description: An arm cut free of the body, [lying](#lying) loose, carried, or still [falling](#falling). Applies whether the scene shows the [violence](#violence) itself or only the detached limb.

entries.name: exposed_muscle
entries.description: Muscle [tissue](#tissue) visible with [no](#no) skin over it: flayed, [torn](#torn) open, or on a character drawn skinless or with see-through skin. It belongs to gore and to body-horror designs alike.

entries.name: exposed_bone
entries.description: Bone showing through [torn](#torn) [flesh](#flesh), at a wound, a severed stump or across a partly stripped body. It belongs with gore and [serious](#serious) [injury](#injury).

entries.name: flesh
entries.description: Loose lumps of [meat](#meat) or [tissue](#tissue) with [no](#no) recognisable body attached to them. Where skin has been stripped from an intact [figure](#figure) and the muscle beneath shows, [exposed_muscle](#exposed_muscle) fits better.

entries.name: dismemberment
entries.description: Limbs or other parts cut away from a body, shown mid-severing or [lying](#lying) apart from it. Violent by [nature](#nature) and normally drawn with [blood](#blood).

entries.name: exposed_brain
entries.description: The [brain](#brain) lies open to view, outside the [skull](#skull) or through a cranium that has been opened up. It turns up in body horror, dissection scenes and [monster](#monster) designs.

entries.name: severed_hand
entries.description: A hand parted from the body at the wrist. It may lie on the ground, be held by someone else, or still be gripping something.

entries.name: bisected
entries.description: A body cut clean into two halves, lengthwise from head to [groin](#groin) or straight across the waist. Both severed halves are shown, which puts it with the heavier gore.

entries.name: reverse_ryona
entries.description: Ryona in which the character taking the beating is male. Much of this art pairs him against a female fighter, with the framing often centred on her rather than on the man being hurt.

entries.name: pile_of_corpses
entries.description: Dead bodies heaped into a mound, generally the aftermath of a [battle](#battle) or a massacre. It sets a scene rather than showing one person's [death](#death).

entries.name: guillotine
entries.description: An upright [execution](#execution) frame with a [heavy](#heavy) angled blade that drops between two posts onto a [restrained](#restrained) [neck](#neck). Add execution when someone is shown fastened into it, and the gore tags once the blade has fallen.

entries.name: severed_torso
entries.description: The trunk of a body separated from the rest, whether [sliced](#sliced) across the middle or left behind once the head and limbs are gone. If only the [neck](#neck) was cut, use [headless](#headless) or a loose [severed_head](#severed_head) instead.

entries.name: entrails
entries.description: Intestines and other viscera [spilling](#spilling) out or laid open to view. It belongs to gore scenes and to the aftermath of a deep wound.

entries.name: severed_leg
entries.description: A leg cut free of the body and shown separately from it. Covers the loose limb alone as [well](#well) as the maimed owner shown in the same frame.

entries.name: sword_in_head
entries.description: A blade driven through someone's [skull](#skull), or a severed head left [impaled](#impaled) on one. The wound itself is the focus rather than the [sword](#sword) as a [weapon](#weapon).

entries.name: bath_of_blood
entries.description: A tub filled with [blood](#blood), or with [water](#water) so heavily stained that the whole [bath](#bath) runs red. A character usually sits or lies in it.

entries.name: severed_finger
entries.description: A finger cut from the hand and shown apart from its owner. Turns up in [yakuza](#yakuza) penance scenes as [well](#well) as in outright gore.

entries.name: candy_gore
entries.description: Violence drawn in bright sugary terms: [sweets](#sweets), [cake](#cake) or [fruit](#fruit) [standing](#standing) in for [organs](#organs), [blood](#blood) in pastel or neon shades that may [glitter](#glitter). The unreality is the whole point, so a [realistic](#realistic) wound in an odd colour is ordinary gore.

entries.name: dangling_eye
entries.description: An [eyeball](#eyeball) [hanging](#hanging) out of its socket on the optic nerve while still joined to the head. Gore imagery, and not to be mixed up with extra eyes or with eyeball jewellery.

entries.name: iron_maiden
entries.description: An upright coffin-shaped [cabinet](#cabinet) whose [door](#door) is lined on the inside with [spikes](#spikes), a [torture](#torture) [device](#device) out of [dungeon](#dungeon) and horror settings. It may stand closed or hang open to show the spikes.

entries.name: holding_organ
entries.description: A detached body organ is carried in the hands, as a rule bloody. Horror and [surreal](#surreal) imagery is where it belongs.
